rdo rje 'dzin pa yid kyis bkug(17 /rdo rje khu tshur khu tshur gyis/ /bsnun na rnam par 'jig par 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying po'i khang pa der/ /g.yon logs nas ni 'jug par bya/ /de ni g.yas logs skor tshon ba yang / /'jig rten dag tu bshad par bya/ /'khor kun dang ni lhan cig tu/ /rdo rje sgrog kyang gzhag par bya / /klu yi gtso bo nor rgyas bu/ /gzi can gnyis kyang grwa /ru gzhag /'di gnyis klu kun bdag po ste/ /klu kun gyi ni gnas kyang yin/ /bram ze las byung dug can de/ /'di gnyis sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan/ /'di gnyis kyi ni mdun logs su/ /mkha' lding rnam par 'dud pa'i bu/ /mkha' lding gi ni cho ga bzhin/ /rkang dang byis pa la casogs bskor/ /de nas 'byung po'i tshogs bdun dag /cho ga bzhin du gzhag par bya/ /gnod sbyin kun dang ku be ra/ /de yi be con nga byang phyogs gzhag /de nas klu chen tshogs rnams dang / /bya ba sgrub po g.yog dang bcas/ /klu yi g.yog rnams mthu stobs ldan/ /de dag shar phyogs ngos su dgod/ /de nas phyi rol rig sngags tshogs/ /thams cad bzhag ste 6)dbang phyug che/ /chos kyi ngang can grags ldan ma/ /lha mo dka' zlog zham ring 7)ldan/ /lag na rdo rje lha chen dang / /dka' 8slog gnyis kyi bar dag tu/ /rig sngags rigs dag gzhag par bya/ /der ni lag na rdo rje yi / /rdo rje 'bar bas rab tu gzir/ /de nas grwa logs 9lha mo ni/ /ka ta ya na log 'dren dang / /sna yon sum cu rtsa gnyis po/ /de dag las ni gang 'dod dang / /de yi 'og tu dri za ni/ /skal chen brtson nga'agrus che ba rnams/ /shar du dbang po rdo rje dang / /de bzhin 11dbang po lha yi tshogs/ /de yi 'og tu lha yi gza'/ /de nas khyab 'jug 'khor lor bcas/ /me dang drug ma 95—441

bstan pa yi/ /me dang mdung thung grwa 1)ru gzhag /lho phyogs dang por lho phyogs kyi/ /'byung po'i bya ba bsgrub pa gzhag /de yi 'og tu gshin rje dang / /gshin rje 2dbyug pa grul bum rnams/ /grul bum la 55)sogs tshogs kun dang / /ma mo rnams dang 'jig rten ma/ /bden bral grwar ( skuni 'phags ma'i mdun95ni/ /'byung po'i tshogs kyis 6bskor bar bya/ /nub phyogs dang por skem byed ni/ /drag mo tshogs rnams mang por bcas/ /klu dang mkha' lding grags ma ༷ rnams/ /de yi 'og tu gtor ma'i gnas/ /tshul li zhes bya rgya chen yang / /der ni nges par gzhag par bya/ /de ltar de dag thams cad du/ /tshogs rnams thams cad bkod pa'i dbus/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor nang dag tu/ /rdo rje dbyibs kyi stegs 8bu ni/ /shar nub phyogs su blta ri9ba'i dbyibs/ /de yi dbyibs legs gzhag par bya/ /de yi nub phyogs gnas su yang / /rig sngags 'chang ni gus gnas shing / /lag na rdo rje'i snying po ni/ /rab tu bsgrims te bzlas brjod bya/ /tsan+dan phye ma la 7sogs spos11/ /nas dang yungs kur la nyu sogs dang / /yang na de dag re re yis/ /lag na rdo rje thog mar bris/ /bdag nyid g.yon phyogs ngos la 'dug /lha mo lho nub mtshams su gzhag /g.yas pas dri dang phreng bas mchod/ /bdug pa sna tshogs dag kyang bsreg /shin tu bkra shis tshigs bcad kun/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'am/ /yang na 'dus pa chen po'i 1 mdo/ /the tshom med par gdon par bya/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mkhas pas bris/ /dpal dang ldan pa lha yi lhaska/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs glu'od can bri/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu yi/ /rig sngags gus pas mchod cing bzlas/ /lha mo stobs chen de nyid dang / /rdo rje ri 95—442

bo bri bar bya/ /snying po lag na rdo rje ni/ /mtshon rtse gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi/ /tshul bzhin bri zhing rigs rnams kyi/ /blon 1mo bdun gyis bskor bar bya/ /pho nya ma (na bcu dpung gi mchog /drug cu rtsa bzhis rjes 'brang dang / /rig sngags tshogs ni thams cad dang / /rdo rje khro bo yan chad bri/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba dang / /skal daldan mchog sbyin gzugs bzang 'dra/ /'jig rten kun gyi thabs su ni/ /dus kun du ni phyag bya ba/ /lha kun rig sngags chen mo ste / /gnod sbyin 'byung po klu 'jigs byed/ /gdon chen dag ni stong phrag rnams / /gcig pus gsod par byed pa ste/ /de yi ming ni brjod byas shing / /me tog bdug pas mchod byas na/ /gdon rnams bye ba stong phrag dag /'khyam par 'gyur zhing g.yo bar 'gyur/ /de yi dngos grub gzugs bzang bzhin5/ /dpal dang ldan par mngon sum 6gnas/ /thams cad don ni sgrub pa pos/ /'di la the tshom 7med par bsgrub/ /bsgrub pas rab dang 'bring la nasogs/ /bshos dang bdug (pa la 1 sogs mchod/ /a ga ru spos du ru ma11/ /yungs kur gu gul 12shu dag dang / /dir kun di 1 dang shu la si/ /pad 'dra ma dang sbrang rtsi mar/ /ma hā byi 7sha la dang bcas/ /'dir ni las kyang bya ba yin/ / thams cad 'jug pa'i sgo dag tu/ /sathams cad kyang ni 'byung bar bya /sgo ma yin pa gzhan dag tu/ /'dir ni ci yang mi bya'o/ /zhe sdang gti mug rgyags dang myos/ /'dod chags mi shes dbang gis kyang / /'di la 'jug dang 'byung byas na/ /mi rnams myur du nad kyis 'debs/ /gdon rnams myos shing rgyags pa yis/ /rdo rje dag la brdzi 7byed dam/ /rkang pas rdo rje ri mo brdzis/ /myur du dam tshig nyams 'gyur te/ /de dag rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /myur du rdo 95—443

rje chen pos 'joms/ /de dag gi ni rigs rnams kyang / /rdo rje rig sngags tshogs kyis gzhag /slob dpon yang na dam tshig shes/ /gdon gang dag gis brnyas 1byed na/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i bzlas brjod dang / /sbyin sreg dag gis de yi rigs/ /skad cig gis ni bcom (5par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rdo rje rigs chen las/ /rig sngags 'dor gyur gang yin pa/ /de yang sngar ni bsgrub byas la/ /myos la sogs pas gdon rnams bskrad ca/ /gang phyir sgor (5skuyang 'grub pa'i phyir/ /rtag tu 'di ni nang dag tu/ /mchod pa'i (phyinatshogs ni brjod 7pa dang / /brdeg pa la nasogs las mi bya/ /gzhan yang nad gtang mang po dang / /yi dgas 'byung po sha za dag /dkyil 'khor spong bar byed pa dag /de dag 'dir ni bshig ngopa yi/ /drag po'i las la 'jug par bya/ /gzhig par bya ba gang yang rung / /thams cad lho phyogs nang du bya/ /kun la me ni 'bar bar 1 bya/ /bdug pa'i snod 1 ni phyi rol gzhag /lha bshos sna tshogs mdzes pa dag /ci 'dod kun ni thams cad du/ /thams cad zad mi shes par bya/ /gdon gyi dkyil 'khor pha rol gyi/ /byang shar mtshams su gang 'dod pa'i/ / lha yi 1 phyag rgya'i tshogs kyang bri/ /pad+ma 'khor lo rgyal mtshan mdung / /mdung thung dbyug pa be con ri/ /zhags pa rtse gsum kha gdeng dung / /gdon drag 7rnams la gnas par bya/ /gang na rig sngags gdon drag pa / /mthu drag gnas pa de dag ni/ /mthu nyid kyis ni bsgrub bya zhing / /'di la dpyad par mi bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor de yi skaphyogs kun du/ /'byung po'i tshogs kun gnas kyang bya/ /gtor tsham dang ni bdug pa rnams/ /rab tu rgyas par 1 mchod par bya/ /de nas gdon ni dul ba yis/ /thems par gyur na 95wa 444

mchod par bya/ /mi bzad 1la ni snar blugs dang / /mig bsku /ba dang btung ba dang / /sbyin sreg sogs pas gzhig par bya/ /gdon gyis drag tu btab pa la / /dal nas bzung bas yongs mi bya/ /dal nas byas pa sman pa nyid/ /mi bzad 4)gdon gyis bcom par 'gyur/ /de phyir sman pa mi bzad 5pa/ /gtum zhing spyod pa /tsho rig pa dang / /brtan mchog dga' zhing spro ba dang / /snying snyoms rig sngags brtson pa yis/ /khros nas mthu ni gnas 7bya zhing / /brdeg pa'am yang ni bsdigs ring ra bya/ /dul ba'i gdon ni dang ba yis de ma thag tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor phyi nang bcas par yang / /gtor ma'i las ni bya ba dang / /khur 9ba dang ni gzhibs 7pa dang / /kha zas ci 'byor rim bzhin dbul/ /dam tshig ci rigs sbyin par bya/ /rig sngags 'byung po la (7sogs kyi/ /gtor ma kun 12ni ci snyed sbyin/ /gdon kun la ni mchod par 32bya/ /bcom ldan nyid kyis bshad pa bzhin/ /bden par smra zhing dam tshig shes/ /slob dpon phyir ni 'dir brtson pa'i/ /slob ma dam tshig 'dzin du gzhugs /thams cad kyi ni phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /skrag par bya dang mchod bya dang 7/ /de dag thams cad g.yon pa yis/ /rnam pa thams cad bstan par bya/ /rdo rje gom par tsha'ador dang 'jig /cig char 1 yongs su bsgyur hunyeb dang / /g.yon pas brdab par bya ba dang / /rgyags pa'i seng ge sgra bsgrags dang / /mdzub mo bstan te hūṃ zhes bya/ /shin tu sgra yang rab tu bskyed / /rdo rje rigs can skyes pa yis19/ /slob dpon gyis ni bstan par bya/ /lha yi gdon ni thams cad kyi/ /rtags kyi phyag rgya tshogs bshad pa/ /rkyen du bab pa gang yin pa'i/ /so so'i phyag rgya'i tshogs 'di yin/ /tshangs pa'i pad+ma 95—445

lha chen mdung / /gshin rje'i dbyug chen dam pa yin/ /khyab 'jug 'khor lo sman pa'i mi/ /nam mkha' 1ldeng gi sna dang 'dab(5)/ /dbang po rdo rje me yi (gelce / /chu lha yi ni zhags pa bstan/ /rlung ni dar gyis ( tshoshugs can te/ /ta na ta yi be con sogs/ /'byung po'i gdon rnams thams cad kyi/ /lag pa g.yon pas de dag 5bzung 6/ /'jug byed kyi ni 'khor lo rdzing / /lta ba dang ni di ri ri/ /dri za dag ni thams cad kyi/ /gling bu pi wang la 575sogs bstan/ /gar mkhan dag ni lhag par yang / /gar dang rol mo'i cha byad bstan/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi cher bgad 9 pa/ /rab gtum gyi ni sgra 7chen te/ /ku be ra yi mtshon mang dang / /yang na phyag rgya'i tshogs kun yin/ /klu chen gdengs ka ches 11pa ste/ /lag pa g.yon pas mgo bor gzhag /dbugs 12ni rgyun ring nyunyergyu ba dang / /mig dmar dug dang bcas pa yinang/ /klu rnams gdengs ka mang po dag /gcig tu gzhibs nas ci dgar gzhag /bya ba sgrub pa thams cad ni/ /sbrul yod pa 15yi gdengs ku'i dbyibs/ /tshangs pa srin po gnyis kyi ni / /sngags kyi ril ba nor bu dang / /o brjod pa yi dbyug pa dang / /mchod phyir thogs la 7sogs par bstan/ /srin po rnams kyi so gtsigs dang / /rdzu 'phrul dag kyang rab tu bstan/ /bza' ba dang ni bca' ba dang / /mtshon cha dag kyang 'dra ba yin/ /sha za rnams ni 'tshe ba dang / /ha rer lta zhing sha la sred / /'jigs pa sna tshogs ston pa dang / /kun tu yang ni lta 1 bar byed/ /skem byed dang ni rang bzhin tshul/ /mdung thung la //sogs dpung la brten/ /ma mo'i gdon ni thams cad ni/ /rang gi lha yi 19mtshon mchog byed/ /pad+ma phyir dang thor tshugs dbyug /sngags ni nor bu bskor bar bya/ /ril ba 'dzin 95wa 446

pa 'phags pa rnams/ /tshangs pa'i phyag rgya bdun pa yin/ /mdung rtse gsum pa zla phyed dzo17dang / /thor tshugs mig dang rgyal mtshan dang / /khyu 2mchog skad 'byin ral gri rnams/ /dbang phyug chen po'i phyag rgya bdun/ /mdung thung dril bu ba dan dang / /de bzhin ra dang bya gag dang / /rma bya yi ni mjug ma rnams / /gzhon nu'i phyag rgya bdun po yin/ /'khor lo dung dang be con dang //ral gri dang ni phub zlum dang / /nam mkha' lding dang phag rnams ni/ /khyab 'jug phyag rgya bdun po yin/ /mche ba dang ni sprin dang sa/ /de bzhin bum pa gtun shing dang / /gshol dang rkang pa g.yon pa rnams/ /phag mo yi ni phyag rgya bdun / /nam gru dag ni gnyer ma gdong / /rgyan skad la gsogs ston pa dang / /skem pa nam gru'i phyag rgya ste/ /rang bzhin nyid du bstan pa yin/ /zas su mdangs za rnams kyi ni/ /lhung bzed ral gri lag snyogayon bcum / /lha min rnams kyi mi yi nagazugs/ /hūṃ dang bcas par bstan par bya/ /'phags pa rnams ni 'khor dang bcas/ /kun la mdung rtse gsum pa yin/ /dri ba byas na lhag par yang / /gdon rnams mtshan nyid gsal bar shes/ /log 'dren sna tshogs brjod pa gang / /de dag tshul ltas bstan par bya/ /de dag la rang gi lag pa bskum pa dang / brkyang ba dang / rkang pa tha mal par brkyang 9ba dang / smrar gzhug pa de dag las gsang sngags kyi las bstan te/dri ba dang / brdeg 1 7pa dang / dgrol ba'i tshul rnam pa gsum bya'o/ /las rgya che ba rig sngags kyi 11tshogs kyis bshad pa phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi las grub pa 'di ni shin tu ngo mtshar che ba ste/ sdebs su 12bya ba'i mdo bstan 15pa dang sngags kyi tshogs rnams kyang bshad do/ /'dus pa chen po'i mdo las 95—447

shin tu bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa dang / rdo rje'i rigs las rig sngags kyi tshogs rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams kyang bshad do0ri/ /lag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po las (gelag na rdo rje dang / lha chen po dang / dka' zlog mas bshad pa'i las kyi dkyil 'khor phyag rgya dang bcas par bshad pa rdzogs so// //dkyil 'khor chen po la'adi dag las/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor ci bstan (gedang / /rig sngags kyi ni dkyil 'khor rnams/ /so sor rgyas par bstan pa dang / /gdon gyi las kyi phyag rgya dang / /phyag rgya nyi tshe byed pa dang / /rig sngags bsgrub 6pa'i sa rnams dang / /khrus kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu yang / /dri dang me tog phreng ba dang / /bdug pa dang ni mchod pa dang / /gtor ma sna tshogs de dag kun/ /dbul bas kun tu rnam (medakun gyis/ /don kun rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /spyan drang na 'di ni nges par bya/ /'byung po thams cad bder 'gyur ba/ /'byung po kun dga' zhes bya ba'i/ /gtor ma rig sngags ldan bya zhing / /g.yas g.yon nas ni sbyin par bya/ /rtag tu 'di dag thams cad kyang / /phyogs kun bltas 9pas 'di skad brjod/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags brgyad tebargyar skyes pa yi/ /gdon gyi srog gi rten gyur dang / /rgyu ba rab tu bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor spyan drang mchod pa dang / /dkyil 'khor ris gsum mchod pa la/ /gdon rnams kyi ni gdon las mchog /gdon gyi gdon stobs rmugs bya / dang //95wa 448

nges par rtag tu bzlas bya bshad/ /bye ba phrag stong gdon rnams ni/ /sa steng dag na rgyu ba yod/ /dus tshigs sna tshogs bab pa na/ /de dag rgyu ba sna tshogs pa / /gdon mchog dam pa 'grub pa'i phyir/ /de dag bdag gis bshad par bya / /gdon rnams nyan par byed pa dang / /gtor ma len cing grub sbyin pa/ /de dag tshul dang gnas byas pa/ /dben pa dag tu rgyu bar byed/ /ri bo yid du 'ong rnams dang / /rtse mo rnams dang khyim rnams dang / /'bras bu me tog rgyas rnams dang / /drang srong dag gi tshoganas rnams dang / /dka' 2thub tshal dang gzhal med khang / /rig byed rjes su slob pa dang / /me tog sna tshogs mchod ldan dang / /gnas dang kun dga' yid 'ong dang / /bya rnams skad chen 'byin nipa dang / /'jig rten mar me byed kun dang / /nyi ma'i gnas na 5dga' byed cing / /nyi ma lhan cig 'gro bar byed/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang kha dog mnyam / /gza' dang rgyu skar skar ma la/ /de dag rtag tu rgyu bar byed/ /zla ba nya ba'i 'od zer gyi/ /phung po rgyas pa dag la gnas/ /rin chen kun gyis rab brgyan chunyecing / /rtse 7nas ngos ni lda ldi dang / /phug brgya nadag gis gang ba yis79) / /lhun po ri la de dag gnas/ /gangs ri ri bo 7rtse mo dang / /gangs kyi sul 3)ni stong 32pa dang / /sman kun gyis ni rgyas pa yi/ /gsang rnams dang ni nags tshal dang / /sman brgyas 1 yongs su gang ba yis/ /spos ngad ldan la de dag gnas/ /spos kyi ngad ni zhim pa yisad/ /phyogs rnams dang ni rgyas byed dang / /dpag 8bsam shing gis brgyan ’ pa yi/ /skyed 18mos tshal chen dga' byed dang / /lha rnams gzhal med khang rnams su/ /lha yi gzugs kyis 19gnas par byed/ /de dag sprin phung gseb na gnas/ /sprin phung gi ni sgra 95wa 449

dag 'dra/ /sprin 1phung dag dang 'grogs nabyed cing / /sprin phung lhan cig dga' bar byed/ /rgya mtsho nang gi chu la gnas/ /chu yi shugs kyis rjes 'brang zhing / /de dag rgya mtsho'i chu klung dang / /lhan cig tu ni rgyu bar byed/ /mun nag gi ni klong chen dang / /rgya mtsho yi ni sgra rnams dang / /rgya mtsho chen po 'khrugs pa la/ /de dag rtag tu 'khrugs par byed/ /dpyid zla'i dus la bab pa na / /shing rnams kun la gdon de dag /khu byug bung ba'i gzugs su gnas / /chu klung chen po'i 'gram dag na/ /gling ma rnams dang rdzong rnams dang / /chu mar gdag gis rgyas pa yi/ /mjing 6rnams na ni gnas par byed/ /chu rgyun yid du 'ong ba dang / /chu rnams rab tu 'byung ba dang / /khron pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /ri bo dag dang chu rnams dang / /sprul gyi tshogs kyis gang ba yi/ /nags khung chen po dag na yang / /de dag sbrul du gzugs bsgyur 7nas / /sbrul dang lhan cig dga' bar byed/ /ljon shing chen po mi bzad dang //'byung po dag ni tshogs chen dang / /khang stong dang ni yul stong nadang / /ba lang gnas ni gang ba dang / /rgyal po dag gi 9dkor khang dang / /pad+ma rnams dang gzhan dag kyang / /glang chen gnas na 7yid 'ong dang / /rta rnams kyi ni bres dag dang / /gzhan yang grong khyer rnams 11dang gzhan/ /tshong 12dus dag na gnas par byed/ /chang 'thung gnas dang khyim dang gzhan/ /srang dang lam dang shing rta dang / /rgyu ba dag gi gnas rnams dang / /bu mo la sogs lta ba'i rnams / /skyed namos tshal snying r+sāmi bzad dang / /lha yi gnas ni zhigs pa dang / /bu btsa' dab yi gnas gzhan dang / /'chi la thug tshapa'i khyim dag dang / /dga' ston sa dang 'dus pa dang / /'dus ston sa dang 'thab 1 mo'i 95wa 450

sa / /g.yul gyi sa ni thams cad ni/ /gdon rnams rtag tu gnas par byed/ /drug cu rtsa ༷1)bzhi'i gdon bshad pa/ /yid ltar mgyogs shing 'dod dgur bgrodarin / /'dod dgur /sgyur ba'i gzugs can de/ /thams cad rang dgar rtsen ( par byed/ /lha tshogs ma mo'i gdon drug bcas/ /tshangs pa srung bar byed pa ste/ /bar snang gza' ni nyi ma yang / /gdon rnams kyi ni gtso bor bshad / /skem byed la sogs srin po'i bar/ /rdzong 5ldan ma dang klu gnyis dang / /srin po bcu dang lha mo dang / /nor bu mgul neni bar ma yin / /grul bum la sogs yi dgas dang / /brjed byed bcas dang srul por 8bcas/ /mdangs 'phrog de bzhin smyo byed dang / /thams cad gdon gyi tha mar bshad/ /de dag gi ni khyad par bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor mngon par mchod byas nas/ /mngon par dga' bar bya ba yi/ /bstod pas mchod pa dag kyang bya/ /dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par 9byas te phyag kyang 1 'tshal/ /me ste 11bsreg bya bzhes 12pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /me 1 mtshams gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par 1 byas te phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje dbyug pa 'chang ba'i lha/ /sa yi bdag po gdon gyi bdag /brnab sems bdag nyid gdon bcas la/ /mchod par dbyas te phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i bdag po gdon gyi bdag /sna tshogs gdon gyi sa tshogs bcas 1 la/ /mchod par 1 byas te phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi 19lha/ /bden pa bsrung ba gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon dang bcas pa la/ /mchod par byas te phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin 95—451

pa'i lha/ /tshig srung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /rlung gi tshogs kyi gdon bcas la /mchod par 1byas te phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin lag na be con thogs/ /nor srung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /byang phyogs gdon dang bcas pa la /mchod par dbyas te phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /dbang ldan phyogs kyi gdon ( bcas la/ /mchod par 5byas te phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi klu dang che ba'i lha/ /rgyal po chen po glang po che/ /dam tshig 6shes pa'i gdon 7cibacas la/ /mchod par (8)byas te phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi lha tshogs thams cad dang / /zla ba nyi ma gza' chen dang / /gza' skar rgyu skar bcas pa dang 1 tsho/ /skar ma'i 'khor 'o/'i dkyil 'khor dang / /rig sngags tshogs dang gsang sngags dang / /de bzhin phyag rgya'i tshogs kun dang / /dam tshig shes dang slob dpon dang / /tshangs pa la sogs lha chen dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa tshe yi lha/ /las na rdo rje stobs po che/ /gtum/ po 'jis rten gsum gyi bdas /'jigs byed lag na rdo rje thogs/ /thams cad zhi brngo byed pa ste/ /'byung po'i tshogs ni kun gyis mchod / /rnam nga/ kun gyis 'byung po kun/ /dus kun du ni srung ba po/ /ris sngalas bcas nga/ de das dang / /'byung po'i tshogs ni thams cad la/ /bcos dang dri so gas sna tshogs rnams/ /des ni dga' zhing dbul bar bya/ /dam tshig shes pa rnams dang ni/ /'byung po'i tshogs kyis mabadag la bsrungs/ /de yi rgyas pa 'phel ba yang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad par gsol/ /sna tshogs tshig gis smra bar bya/ /zhi ba'i tshig ni yang dang yang / /bdag gi bla ma'am yang na gzhan/ /dam tshig shes pa gzhan gyis byas/ /'di ni 'byung po 95—452

kun la phan phyir bshad pa ste/ /'byung po'i tshogs kun 'dus la rtag tu mchod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag las gtor ma'i las ni rgyas pa 'di/ /rgyu ba dag gi gnas dang rten gyur dpal bskyed 1phyir/ /'dir ni thams cad dus su phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /yongs su dag pa'i yid dang rnam 2pa thams cad kyis/ /thams cad zhi bar byed pa gsum du rab bshad pa/ /don rnams bsgrub pa'i phyir ni bla mas bya ba yin/ /las kyi dadakyil 'khor rdzogs so(4)// //kun rig sems can kun gyis mchod/ /rig sngags bdag po kun gyis brjod5) / /mtshungs pa med pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rnam gsum nyi ma'i 'od dang ldan / /mtshan med mang po mnga' ba ste/ /'dom tsigang 'od chen 'chang ba dang / /rig sngags ston pa chen po ste/ /mchog chen 'chang zhing sbyin byed dang / / dag pa'i 57chos kyi nges nagasungs pa/ /zhi ba'i grong khyer zhi ba'i lam / /gang gis thub rnams 9shes pa dang / /gzhan yang sngon gshegs gshegs gyur dang / /ya mtshan gnas ldan dge 'dun rnams/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong 'jug pa/ /shin tu rgyas pa de kun la/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal zhing / /thub pa sangs rgyas gnyis pa ni/ /'phags pa sha ngor dwa ti'i bu/ /lha dang lha min dri zar bcas/ /klu dang gnod sbyin tshogs kyis 11mchod/ /de bzhin dam pa grub pa de12/ /rig sngags 'chang kun dbang phyug rje/ /dpa' bo gcig pu dgra thul ba/ /lag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin rdo rje lcags minakyu yum/ /rdo rje thog thog bzang mo dang / /de nas lag na rdo rje'i mthus/ /95—45 3

tī li tī li tsho1gtum po dang / /rdo rje sgrog gi nyi ma bzhin/ /blo (0gros rdo rje pas mi thub/ /'od dadapag khro bo dril bu can/ /de bzhin rdo rje nag mo la/ /ci ste shes rab can dag gis/ /gzhan don grub par 'dod pa na/ /mchod cing phyag kyang byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gzung 4bya legs par bshad/ /grub pa lag na rdo rje yi/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub 5)byed cing / /dngos grub thams cad rab rdzogs pa/ /ji skad du ni rab bstan 56pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor ci 'dra gang yin dang / /de yi yon tan sna tshogs gang / /tshogs kyang ji ltar bstan pa dang / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dam tshig dang / /cho ga dam pa grub pa dang / /phan dang mi phan don rnams dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i yon tan dang / /nyams pa'i gnas ni gang yin pa/ /de dang gzhan yang gang mthong ba//de dag thams cad legs par bshad/ /lag na rdo rje'i sras gtum pa / /rdo rje sde la phyag byas nas/ /zla phyed yud tsam zhag 8rigacig dang / /rgyu skar 9dag ni bzang ba la/ /gtsang zhing gos gtsang bgos pa dang / /bsdams shing nges par gnas pa dang / /grogs po gtsang mar ldan pa dang / /gtsang ma'i las kyi 'irjes 'brang 11pas/ /yar gyi ngo yi tshes gcig gam/ /tshes gnyis de bzhin lnga yang rung / /tshes drug dang ni brgyad dang bcu/ /bcu gnyis yang na bcu gsum mam na/ /yang na nya yi 1 nyin par ni/ /yongs su gzung ngabar bya ba ste/ /de dag brtsam gyis 15gzhan la min/ /dkyil 'khor gnas ni sbyang 9byas la/ /zla ba nya yi nub mo ni/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya/ /bsgrims 1 te lag na rdo rje dang / /rgyal dbang la ni phyag byas nas/ /zhi zhing sngan 1 chad las byas pa'i / /sar ni mkhas pas 'gro bar bya/ /tshong dus kun dga' gtsug lag 95wa 454

khang / /grong ngam yang na grong khyer gyi/ /byang shar mtshams ni gang mthong ba/ / de yi (1)lho nub mtshams dag tu/ /zla ba re re brtul zhugs bya/ /mdangs dga' tshal 95ldan gtsang ma dang / / tshwa sgo rdo gseg rus pa dang / /mtho dman ri skyon rnams rnam spangs pa/ /de 'dra'i sa de rnyed na ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu dran byas la/ /shar phyogs nas ni gom pa 'dor5/ /ha cang mi drag dgod 6mi bya/ /de nas rig sngags gang 'dod pas/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bsrung bar bya / /de nas dkyil 'khor gnas der yang / /dge ba'i ltas 7rnams blta 8bar bya/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i chu dag gis/ /thams cad legs par gtor bar bya/ /ba lang lci bas legs par sbyang 9/ /ku sha dag kyang gding bar bya/ /mnyam pa'i dbus kyi dkyil dag tu/ /dkyil 'khor byed pa 'dug nas ni/ /phyogs mtshams steng dang thad kur yang / /kho ra khor yug blta bar bya/ /bsrung zhing yid dga' dri dag gis/ /khrus byas zhag gsum smyung bar bya/ /spos ngad ldan pa'i ri bzhin du/ /spos kyis 1 phyogs kun rgyas par bya/ /thig skud gsar 11zhing rab gtsang dang / /tshad dang ldan zhing mdzes pa dang / /dri zhim reg na 'jam pa dang / /sra zhing legs par gzabs 12pa dang / /thung dang sbom sogs ma legs dang / /mdud pa rnams ni med pa yis/ /thig ni shes rab can gyis gdab/ / de yi 15tshad kyang bshad par bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen dga' ba yi/ /dang po'i gnas ni rdzogs gyur nas/ /de las gzhan pa'i dkyil 'khor che/ /grangs rnams kyang ni bshad par bya/ /lag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i rgyal po ste gnas dang po'o// //bu dag chog khushes dben pa bde/ /chos la mi smod dbade ba yin/ /'tshe slo95—455

ba spangs pas 'jig rten bde/ /srog chags rnams la sdom pa dang / /'dod chags bral ba 'jig rten bde/ /'dod chags rnams las 'das lhanapa dang / /nga snyam nga rgyal zhi ba dang / /dul ba 'di ni mchog tu bde/ /bu dag rgyun las bzlog 57pa yi/ /lam bgrod zab cing blta dka' (5)ba/ /mun nag thibs pos bsgribs pa dang / /'dod la chags pas rtog 'dami 'gyur/ /ngas ni dka' bas rtogs 5byas nas/ /skye bo rgyun bzhin 'khyam (6)pa dang / /'dod pa dag gi mdud 7pa yis/ /bcings pa'i bar du bshad pa ste/ /'di ni lag na rdo rje yi//yid 'ong ched du brjod pa brjod/ /rtsed 9shemo can gyis bsrung byas nas/ /nges par kun tu 'jigs pa med/ /dkyil 'khor khru ni bcu drug tu/ /ci nas rab tu tshang bar bya/ /srid du yang ni ci nas kyang / /sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa dang / /gtsang mas gtsang ma'i gos bgos la/ /thig 97skud de ni bdag gis gzung 7/ /lha la dga' ba'i grogs po yis/ /kho ra khor yug drang bar bya/ /thig drangs de yi 1 steng dag tu/ /thig ni snyoms par legs par bri/ /rig sngags rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /rmad du byung tshab de nyid brjod/ /thub chen gnas par gyur pa yi/ /khor yug brag nyurteni rgya che ba/ /rang 'byung ngagis ni bstan pa bzhin / /blo can dag gis zlum por dbya/ /thung sbom la gesogs skyon bral zhing / /thig ni legs shing bsnyams / par bya/ /sbom ches pa ni sngar bshad zin / /thung ches pas 18ni nad kyis 'debs/ /gang zhig dngos grub mchog 'dod pas/ /de ni yungs kur dag gis bri/ /gang zhig tsan+dan phye mas 'dri/rte/ /des ni 'jig rten nges par 'jomasazhu / /nas rnams kyi ni ma 'dres pa'i/ /sā sa1lu bzang por byas na ni/ /de yi nor dang 'bru rnams dang / /dbyig rnams 95wa 456

rtag tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig dngos grub mchog 'dod pas/ /der ni gsum char gyis kyang bri/ /yang na de dag gcig pu yis/ /shes rab can gyis bri bar bya/ /de nas ri yi rgyal po ni/ /rin chen kun las grub pa ste/ /nyi ma bzhin du rtag tu yang / /rang gi 'od kyis rab 'bar zhing / /bang rim yod pa'i ri rab de/ /thog ma nyid du gzhag par bya/ /sngar bstan pa yi khor 1yug ni / /gru bzhi tshad du bya ba yin/ /de nyid khongs su rim pa gsum/ /khru re tsam du bri bar bya/ /gzhan yang mtho ni do do dang / /sor bzhi bcas par bri bar bya/ /gnyis pa dang ni lhag ma rnams/ /cha drug mdzes dang ldan par bya/ /gzhan ni mtshams la thug napa'i bar/ /ci rigs par ni bri bar bya/ /ngu 'bod chen po zhes bya ba'i/ /dmyal ba bden bral phyogs su gzhag /bstan pa bzhin du de byas nas/ /gzhan yang bshad pa bzhin bya ba / /ras gsar pa ni sā 4lu'am/ /tsan+dan bzang po'i phye ma yis/ /rdo rje srid du khru gang ba/ /rtse drug yang na 5rtse gsum bri/ /de yang ci ste mi 'byor na/ /grog mkhar dzogyi ni sa dag 7gis/ /sor bzhi tsam du bya ba yin/ /gang gis gdon ni stong phrag rnams / /khyad par 'dir ni sgrub byed pa/ /de nyid 'jig rten gsum dag gi / /'jigs byed drag po yin par nges/ /de nyid ngo mtshar bye ba snyed/ /ya mtshan rnams kyang ston pa yin/ /gcig pu 9rdo rje gnyis ldan pa/ /de nyid kyi ni drung dag tu/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi po dag /byin gyis brlabs 1 pa'i cho ga bya/ /bden dang gtor ba rgya che ba/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba ya mtshan ldan / /yang na gang gis 'di dag kun/ /thub pa'i shes rab byin brlab bya/ /bden dang nges par 12gnas byas nas/ /bden bral phyogs su bri ba dang / /95—457

chu lha'i phyogs su song nas kyang / /rgya chen don rnams bya ba na/ /si ta ku ni bu dang bcas/ /bzhi pa de ni legs par gnas/ /grong khyer mchog gi drung dag tu / /gru ni byang phyogs blta 1bar bya/ /de nas 'jug par rab bstan tel/ /dkyil 'khor dag pa gzhan mi bya/ /gzugs gnas sgo mchog de nyid ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dgyes pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor 'dod pa gang yin pa/ /de yi sgo yi byang phyogs drung / /lho phyogs kyi ni drung dag tu/ /bstan pa gang yin gzhag par bya/ /gur gum yid du 'ong ba dang / /ldan pa'i rgya skyegs (༄khu ba dang / / le brgan partsi yis bsgyur 6ba yi/ /sar ni dmar zhing yid 'ong ba/ /bug rdol med cing ma nyams la/ /dri nga ba dag med pa yi/ /gdan dag kyang ni nges byas shing / /shing rings 7la ni legs par gdags/ /de nas logs shig rtse mo yi/ /cha byad sna tshogs khyad par du/ /rnam par mdzes (8)pa gzhag bya ste/ /rgya skyegs las ni legs byas pa'i/ /pho long chen po ri mo can/ /gzhan yang dril dang sgo nga'i 9dbyibs/ /ste'u 'khor gyi ni mtshogs rnams dang / /gzhan yang rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag /ku ran+ta ku'i me tog phreng / /rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'phyang rta du gzhug /yang na me tog dmar ba yi/ /phreng ba bzang po sna tshogs gdags12/ /de dag bstan pas shes pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rol gzhag /de nas ri dbang khor yug gi/ /nang du yang sna ni 'gro bar bya/ /de ltar mtshungs med ces bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni thig gdab pa/ /gnas gnyis pa ni rgyas par bstan/ /lag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po las gnas gnyis pa rdzogs so// //rig sngags rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /rmad 'du byung ba de dran zhing / /g.yon 95—458

phyogs dag tu go rims 0)bzhin/ /lha rnams kyang ni dgod par bya/ /chu lha'i phyogs kyi sgo dag ni/ / kār+sā pa ṇa narabargyad dag gi )/ /'gron 4bu rnams ni shar nub tu/ /mnyam zhing mdzes par dgod par bya/ /de yi lho phyogs rdo rje yi / /rig sngags bla ma'i rigs 5rnams dgod/ /de ni rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /rig sngags rgyal mo 76)dbus su gzhag /dregs shing stobs kyis rgyags pa yi/ /sngon mo 57)chen mo rin)sngon mo 59gnyis/ /der ni rig sngags rigs rnams kyi/ /sgo srung dag tu gzhag par bya/ /rig sngags rdo rje'i rigs skyes rnams/ /shar phyogs su ni blta 7bar bya/ /'dod pa'i rdo rje dang por bshad11/ /rdo rje khro bo mjug tu gzhag32 /me tog yid 'ong rtse mo can/ /lug rgyusdo gtum mo ser mo rnams / /pho nya ma 1snyedag grangs bzhin du/ /thams cad de yi pha rol dgod/ /bung 8ba ma dang lta ba ma/ /dga' ma thub dka' byang phyogs gzhag /rdo rje ka lota ya na dang / /'di dag g.yas phyogs bri bar bya/ /rdo rje sde yi 'khor rnams kyang ske/ /de yi lho phyogs dgod par bya/ /de nas klu rgyal nor rgyas bu/ /bzhi pa dag la gzhag par bya/ /'byung po sna tshogs bskor ba yi/ /gzhon nu tshogs dang bcas pa yang / /dkyil 'khor lnga par gzhag par bya/ /mdung thung yang ni mdun du gzhag /de nas drug la bden bral phyogs/ /'byung po rengs oṃbyed mi bzad pa/ /'phags pa yi ni mdun 1 bris la/ /'phags ma yi ni mdun du gzhag /ma mo rnams kyi rigs lnga po/ /tshangs ma dang ni dbang phyug ma / /skem byed khyab 'jug phag mo zhes/ /bya ba dkyil 'khor bdun par gzhag /grong khyer de yi nang dag tu/ /chu 1 klung 'gram dang ldan par bri/ /grwa 19rnams shar byang grwa tshadag dang / /lho dang nub phyogs phyin par bya/ /sdig can 95wa 459

chu na gnas pa'i nang / /ngoms mi shes pa'i ri dgas shig /nang du mchu btsugs phyogs gcig gnas1/ /de nang khyu mchog 'gro bar bya/ /rlung lha'i phyogs kyi gnas gcig tu/ /bde byed lha mo khyu mchog dang / /de bzhin ra dang bum rna gnyis/ /grong khyer gyi ni sgo srung gzhag /klung gi g.yas rol 'gram dag tu/ /rig sngags chen po dbu smad bcas/ /dbang ldan phyogs su gzhag bya ste / /dkyil 'khor bdun pa 'das pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa sngar bshad pa'i/ /'byung po'i bya ba sgrub pa bdun/ /'byung po sna tshogs bskor ba gzhag /dgu par yang ni rim bzhin bri/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bcu par ni/ /tshangs pa'i drang srong snye rnams kyang gzhag /de nas gshin rje tshogs mang bcas / /bcu gcig par ni gzhag par bya/ / me lce 'bar bas bskor ba yi / /6me lce lha mo'i 7tshogs kyis bskor / /me de mthu las skyes pa ste/ /de ni bcu gnyis shes par bya/ /yi dgas rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas/ /yi 9 dgas dag kyang gzhag par bya/ /lag na rdo rjes bshad pa bzhin/ /de ni bcu gsum shes par bya/ /zla ba phyogs bzang 1 stobs po che/ /khyab 'jug dbang po nye dbang gnyis/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas kyi/ /blo gros lha mo gnyis kyang gzhag /gang na lha dbang gnyis gnas pa/ /de ni bcu bzhir shes par bya / /bcwa lnga pa yi 1 dkyil 'khor du/ /klu chen rigs brgyad dgod par bya/ /bka' stsol pa zhes bya ba yi/ /tshangs pa'i srin rnams bcu drug tu/ /bcu bdun pa yi 1 dkyil 'khor du/ /ka ta ya na gzhag par bya/ /de yi 'khor ni gang yin pa/ /de yang drung du gzhag par bya/ /dbang phyug chen po'i chochung mar bcas/ /dbang ldan phyogs su gzhag bya ste/ /de ni bcwa skabargyad shes par 95wa 460

bya / /de nas phyi rol rig sngags rigs/ /rig sngags kyi ni sna tshogs dge/ /bcu dgu par ni gzhag par bya/ /de nas kyang ni rig sngags rnams/ /ming smos 'di dag la 1sogs bri/ /dri gshed 2thabs kyis dri gshed dang / /ro langs mar ni grags pa dang / /dkar mo chen mo dkar mo dang / /gzhan yang sa steng riganas rnams gzhag /rdo rje'i mnga' bdag dgyes 5pa yi/ /gzhan gyi rig sngags mchog 'ching ba/ /rab tu gsal zhing 'bar ba de/ /dbus der mkhas pas gzhag par bya/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin chen rje/ /nyi shu par ni gzhag par bya/ /gang na rdo rje 'dzin gnas te/ /ming ni rdo rje pho brang yin/ /nyi shu gcig pa'i byang phyogs su/ /ku be ra ni tshogs bcas bri/ /ku be ra ni gar gnas pa/ /grong khyer lcang lo can zhes bya/ /klu yi bya ba sgrub pa brgyad/ /grong khyer nyi shu gnyis par gzhag /bya ba sgrub bcas klu chen rnams / /lnga po nyi shu gsum par gzhag /dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa bzhir ni/ / klu yi sgyu dkyil 'khor gzhag par bya/ /klu mgo yi ni gdengs ka can/ /klu chen gyis ni g.yas su bskor / /dkyil 'khor de yi nang dag tu/ /klu chen kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /mtha' yas nor rgyas pad+ma dang / /de bzhin nor bu la sogs klu/ /kulpa la dang rab mgyogs gnyis/ /de bzhin gzhan yang klu rnams kyi / /ma dang rgyal tshab 'jog po yang / /dkyil 'khor nang du gzhag par bya/ /shar sgor 7'od ma'i rtse mo gzhag /dga' skyed pa ni lho phyogs su/ /nub phyogs su ni legs mthong gzhag /byang phyogs su ni stobs kyis 1 rgyu/ /de nas rlung lha'i phyogs dag tu/ /'byung po'i tshogs ni bdun rnams dgod/ /de ni nyi shu lnga pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor du yang grags pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ /'di dag kyang ni 95—461

mkhas pa (17yis/ /ci rigs par ni bri bya zhing / /rdzogs byed rnams kyang legs par bri/ /chu lha'i phyogs su nyi ma bri/ /shar phyogs su ni zla ba gzhag /ku ( ru na ni gling bzhir ni/ /phyogs mtshams dag tu gzhag par bya/ /lhag ma dag ni byang phyogs su/ /nges par yang ni dgod par bstan/ /'di dag rnams ni mdor bsdu na/ /khor yug gi ni khong nas dbyung (4)/ /de nas rdo rje shugs kyis ni/ /der ni stobs chen 'gro bar bya/ /bang rim la ni song nas kyang / /dang po legs 5par dgod par bya/ /rdzong gi 'phags ma don grub ( por pa / /dur khrod gnas 7na drag mo ni/ /bden bral phyogs su gzhag bya zhing / /ma yang drung du gzhag par bya/ /phyogs kyi lha ni bye ba rnams/ /dbang ldan phyogs su dgod par bya/ /log 'dren drag po chen po yang / /dkyil 'khor du ni legs par dgod/ /rlung lha'i phyogs su mkha' lding gzhag /de nas dang po skyong ba yi/ /rdzong gi 8'phags ma gnyis pa yang / /yongs su rdzogs par gzhag par bya/ /bang rim dag ni gnyis pa la/ /rdo rje'i 9༄shugs kyis bsgom 7bya zhing 1 / /klu rigs nor bu gzhag par bya/ /mtha' yas bden bral phyogs su gzhag /de nas phyogs kyi lha nyid ni/ /gshin rje'i phyogs su legs par gzhag /de nas yi dgas tshogs rnams kyang / /me yi phyogs su gzhag par bya/ /de nas cho ga shes pa yis/ /yi dgas kyi ni rigs rnams dgod/ /brjed byed kyi ni rigs rnams dang / /nam gru dag gi rigs kyang gzhan12/ /dbang ldan 'byung po rnams dang ni/ /'byung po'i chang khyu rnams kyang gzhag /tshangs pa'i srin po zhes bya rnams/ /dkyil 'khor byang phyogs dgod par bya/ /phyi rol klu yi rigs rnams kyang / /rlung lha'i phyogs su legs par dgod/ /dkyil 'khor 95—462

dam pa gnyis pa las/ /bang rim 'di ni yongs su rdzogs/ /rdo rje rim gyis bsgoms 6)nas ni/ /gsum pa yang ni bden bral phyogs/ /sha za bzhag ste risong na yang / /rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gzhag /yi dgas kyi ni khyim rnams kyang / /gshin rje'i phyogs su legs dpar dgod/ / me yi laphyogs su dkyil 'khor du/ /stobs chen lha ma yin rnams gzhag /de nas dpal ldan 'jig rten skyong / /'jig rten chos las phyir phyogs pa/ /yul 'khor srung ni dpag med pa'i/ /dri zar lhan cig kun tu dgod/ /dbang phyug chen mor bcas pa yi/ /dbang ldan phyogs su gnas par bya/ /de nas rig sngags rnams kyi bdag /lag na rdo rje rnal 'byor che/ /grogs bcas rdo rje 'dzin pa yi / /rdo rje pho brang dga' bar gzhag /de nas stobs chen 'jig rten skyong / /dpal ldan 'jig rten chos spangs pa/ /lag na rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dbang ldan byang gi phyogs su gzhag /de bzhin lcang lo can dag tu/ /nor sbyin tshogs dang bcas par bri/ /klu rnams ma ni su ru pas/ / rlung lha'i 6phyogs su gnas par bya/ /de dag bu dang bcas par ni/ /de yi drung du dgod par bshad / /mkha' lding rnam par 'dud pa'i bu/ /mthu rtsal shin tu rdzogs pa'ang gzhag /de nas 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dgod/ /chu lha yang ni nub phyogs gzhag /gsum pa dag kyang 'das pa yin / /bzhi pa dag gis bshad par bya//bang rim bzhi pa'i steng dag tu/ /rdo rje shugs kyis nasong nas ni/ /nyi ma rnams ni g.yog dang bcas/ /chu lha'i phyogs su gnas par bya/ /bden bral phyogs su srin rnams dgod/ /de yi pha 9rol grul bum gzhag /de nas grul bum lcags can yang / /lho phyogs su ni gzhag par bya/ /me yi phyogs su rlung 95—463

lha gzhag /shar phyogs 1zla ba 'khor dang bcas/ / thags bzangs ris nakyang de bzhin te/ /de gnyis kyis ni bzhi pa dgang 4/ /de nas bang rim ldan pa la/ /rdo rje shugs kyis 5'gro bar bya/ /lha bsrung phyir ni klu rnams kyang / /chu lha'i phyogs su dgod par bya/ /dbang ldan dang ni shar mtshams su//lha yi mdzod kyang gzhag par bya/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje che/ /dbang ldan phyogs su gzhag par bya/ /de nas rdo rje'i drung dag tu/ /gnas gtsang ris tsho 7kyi lha chen gzhag / lha yi 7sungs ma gnod sbyin che/ /byang phyogs dag tu gnas par bya/ /rdo rje shugs kyis /drug pa la/ /song nas chu lha'i phyogs dag tu / /klu rgyal rgya mtsho chen po'i bu/ /drag cing shugs dang ldan pa gzhag /der ni g.yog dang bcas par bya/ /gzhan dag gis ni sprul pa la/ /dbang byed lha ‘ ni gang yin rnams/ /bden bral phyogs su gnas par bya/ /tshangs ris k+ṇi kyi ni tshogs rnams kyang / /me yi phyogs su dgod par bya/ /tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa yi/ /lha rnams shar phyogs gzhag par bya/ /shin tu mthong lha dbang ldan du/ /srid rtse de yi pha rol dgod/ /de bzhin dka' zlog byang phyogs gzhag /drug pa dag kyang 'das pa yin/ /bang rim dag ni bdun pa la / /rdo rje shugs kyis rdo rje 'chang / /song nas khru 12yi gtso bo ni/ /rgya mtsho chen po rmad byung gzhag /byang phyogs bya ba zin nas ni/ /grags shing bsod nams che ba yi/ /'phrul dga' ba yi lha chen rnams/ /gshin rje'i phyogs su gnas par bya/ /de nas rdo rje shar phyogs kyi/ /gnas kyi sagatso bor gzhag par bya/ /sum cu gsum pa'ang shar phyogs su/ /bzhag cing bdun pa yongs su dgang / /lha rnams sna tshogs rgyas pa yis/ /ri yi dbang po dam pa 95wa 464

yi / /bang rim dag ni yongs su rdzogs/ /de yi 'og tu bya ba bshad/ /ri rab steng du thams cad mkhyen/ /rig sngags snying po 'chang ba po/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten rtogs mdzad pa/ /thar pa'i grong khyer dbang phyug gzhag /gang gi 'od zer de dag gi(1/ /phyogs rnams thams cad rgyas mdzad dang / /gang gi nasku la mtshan kun gyi/ /mdzod rnams thams cad 'byung ba dang / /mtshan dang gzhon dang brtson 'grus dang / /gzhan yang zhi labar ldan pa dang / /mchog rnams mchog sbyin byed pa la/ /gang gis mchog gi mchog sbyin dang / /thugs rje che dang ldan pa'i mgon/ /nyi ma 'char 5ka'i 'od dang 'dra / /'od zer nyi ma bye ba yis/ /gang gis mun pa bsal 7ba dang / /chos dang mtshan nyid rigs na pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs mnga' 9gang / /gang gis bskal pa grangs med par/ /sems can rnams ni rab tu bsrungs/ /rin chen in+d+ra 7nī la ltar/ /gang gi gtsug tor 11mdzes pa dang / /nor bu yi ni rgyal po bzhin / /zla mdog can gyi 12mdzod srung sna1 / /gang gi bdud rtsi gtong 1 ba'i zhal / / pad+ma rā loga'i mdog 'dra dang / /dus mtshams gser gyis bsgyur 1 ba yi / /gser gyi ri ltar sku mdog mdzes/ /'khor lo chen po rtsibs 1 stong bas / /phyag dang zhabs ni legs spras 1 pa/ / skyil mo krung 19ni mdzes pa yis / /thub pa chen po legs par bzhugs/ /chos kyi chu klung chen po'i mchog /de yi zhal nas kun tu 'bab/ /rmad 2 du byung bar 'bab pa ste/ /bdag gis kha ni stong phrag rnams/ /stong snyed kyis 21ni brjod pa 'am/ /khong du chud par nus mi 2'gyur/ /de ni rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / /ye shes pha mtha' bla na med / /shin tu rmad byung gsang bar bshad/ /tshig ldan gyi ni lha mo de/ /95—465

'jig rten mgon po sangs rgyas kyi1/ /gsung la rab tu gnas pa yin/ /'jig rten gsum ma 2bdag mchog sbyin/ /'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas pa//'di ni gnas dang 'gro ba yi/ /'jig rten thams cad 'dzin pa yin/ /che zhu'eba'i che mchog stobs chen te/ /dga' zhing kun gyi tshig la gnas/ /gzhan gcig sangs rgyas 'dra ba 4med/ /gud na yang ni gnas ma yin/ /de yi bsngags 5pa sangs rgyas sam/ /lha rnams nyid kyis brjod par nus/ /mchog sbyin 'jig rten gsum gyi ma/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /mdor na 'gro ba 'di kun ni/ /khyod kyi rang bzhin nyid yin te/ /lha dang dri za klu dbang dang / /gnod sbyin lha min tshogs bskor ba'i/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu rnams kyi gter / /ya mtshan las kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /der gtogs der ni brtson zhing spro / /de dang 'brel bar 6the tshom med/ /chos klung bsod nams ldan pa de/ /bsod nams rin chen dag gis rgyas/ /lag na rdo rje'i bsod nams kyi ri/ /las kyi rgya mtsho dag las 'byung / /chu klung rgya mtshor 'bab pa na/ /skye bos bsten 8nas 'bab 9par 'gyur/ /de bzhin chos kyi chu klung 'di/ /'di dag gis bsten 7byas nas kyang / /lag na rdo rje'i mgo bo dang / /rna gnyis dang ni gsum du dbab/ /zer ma 'phros pas lha mo dang / /dbang phyug tshogs bcas rdzog par 'gyur/ /de phyir chos kyi chu 1 klung 'di/ /sangs rgyas las ni 'byung byas la/ /lag na rdo rje'i mgo bor yang / /rab tu dbab cing bdug par bya'i12 / /bsod nams ldan pa'i chu klung rgya chen de nyid las/ /skye bo mtha' dag gcig tu sems btud 1 nyan par byed/ /de nyid la ni lha rnams thams cad mngon par dga'/ /de nyid la ni rig sngags grub pa'i tshogs kun 95—466

brten0) / /gnas rnams gsum pa 'di ni lha yi gnas yin te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga ( yi dgongs pa bzhin du rdzogs/ /de nas dam tshig mkhyen pas dkyil 'khor rgyal po yi/ /gsang ba gang dang gang gsungs dga' rgyas bdag gis bshad / /lag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po las gnas gsum pa rdzogs so// //ri rab kyi ni byang phyogs su/ /chos kyi klung chen 'dzin pa yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen rab gtum pa/ /stobs chen lag na rdo rje gzhag /de yi rkang pa g.yon pa yis/ /dbang phyug chen po mnan 4par bya/ /g.yas pa yi ni rkang pa yis / /lha mo dka' zlog mnan 5par bya/ /ri yi dbang po 'khor 6yug dang / /bang rim dag gi bar dag tu/ /gling chen rnam pa bzhi po dang / /gnas rnams ji bzhin gzhag par bya/ /de nas chu klung bdun yang gzhag /lho phyogs su ni dbyibs legs pa'i/ /'dzam bu gling ni gzhag par bya/ /chu klung dang ni shing dang yul/ /sna tshogs kyis 7ni shin tu rgyas/ /de yi mngon mtshan chen po ni/ /'dzam bu'i shing mchog skyes pa de/ /'phang nadu dpag tshad brgya yod do/ /'og logs su ni gzhag par bya/ /de nas chu klung bdun yang gzhag /nags tshal yang ni bdun dag dang / /yid du 'ong ba'i ri bdun dang / /yul bdun dag kyang gzhag par bya/ /dang po byang nas brtsam bya zhing / /lho phyogs logs su thur 95du drang bo/ /shar nas nub tu drang bya zhing / /kho ra khor yug bsgrubs nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab 11yid 'ong ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rjes bsgrub pa / /'phags pa sha 12ra dwa ti'i bu/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid pad+ma'i mchog /dge slong dge slong ma rnams dang / /rgyal po dag gis bsten pa gzhag /95—467

'dzam bu gling gi lho phyogs su/ /khri 1shing dag kyang bri bar bya/ /nub phyogs su ni ba lang spyod/ /chu bo brgyas 2ni gang ba dang / /yul dang skye bo stong dag dang / /ban lang khyu ni stong gis rgyas/ /de bzhin shar gyi lus 'phags kyang //shar phyogs su ni gzhag par bya/ / yul rnams dang ni ri dag gis/ /kun tu rab tu rgyas par gnas/ /de nas gnas brtan 5chos skyong ba/ /bcu gnyis dag dang lhan cig tu/ /sgra tshogacan 'dzin 7zhes 8grags pa ste/ /sangs rgyas sras ni mngon sum 9gnas/ /gnod sbyin lha min lto 'phye rnams/ /nyin mtshan du ni der song nas/ /dri dang phreng ba dpe 1 med pas/ /mchod pa byed cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /de nas byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /lhun po yi ni byang phyogs gzhag /gtsang zhing gru bzhi lham 1 pa ste/ /chu klung dag 12gis rab tu brgyan/ /gang dag gi nani tshe yi tshad/ /chig 1 stong tshang bar 15brjod pa dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 1 gsungs nga/ yi/ /sems can ya mtshan 17de na gnas/ /rgya mtsho'i sa ni bskor 1 ba yi/ /ri yi dam pa ri rab la/ /phyogs kyi lha ni bzhi po rnams / /kun nas nges par gzhag par bya/ / kār+sā pa ṇa 19brgyad dag gis/ /dkyil 'khor dang ngo/ra rdo rje bri/ /de yi gnas rnams de dag tu/ /gser gyi gdu bu dag kyang bya/ /sgo rnams re rer don sgrub pa/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'jig rten gsum// /thub par 21nus pa 2 gang yin pa'i/ /sgo srung gnyis kyang gzhag par bya/ /de yang sngags dang ldan bya zhing / /kun tu gzhal yas rgyas par bya/ /rdo rje thog thog 25lho phyogs bri/ /rdo rje khu tshur byang phyogs gzhag /de nas der ni lha bshos rnams/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bkra ba dang / /bla med rab mdzes rgyas par bya/ /dri dang me tog phreng bas mchod/ /zhib de'i tha 2gelu 95—468

sna tshogs pa/ /sbrang rtsis 1byugs shing gzabs 2pa dang / /legs byas a shwa ka brti/ /de bzhin be reg nas khur dbul/ /ji tsam du ni rgyas pa phul/ /de tsam du ni 'grub par bshad/ /'bras kyi 'o thug tshu cal 15 /thug pa sbyar thug sa mi ta/ /'bras chan 'tshod ma sna tshogs pa/ /kha dog sna tshogs sor lngar ldan / /de la 75sogs pa gang 'dod pa/ /lo ma sna tshogs skyon med pa/ /yang na kham por sar 87pa 'am/ /pad+ma'i lo ma dag la gzhag9 /nas dang gro dang mon 7sran gre'u/ /sā 11lu dang ni til 'bru rnams/ /snod sar 1 dag gi nang du gzhag /yang na gzhan du de bzhin gzhag /hwags dang kha ras 1 gang ba dang //btung 〉ba bsil zhing zhim pa dag /snod sar skadag gi nang dag tu/ /bzhag nas rab tu dbul bar bya/ /des na su la'ang rka'atshe mi 'gyur/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis za 'dod la/ /kha zas dag kyang sbyin par bya/ /de nas dga' bar bya ba'i phyir/ /ta la'i lo ma bsil yab dbul/ /dri zhim pa yi k+ṇi dri kun gyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni mchod par bya/ /spos 1 kyi phye ma sna tshogs pa/ /mchog rnams kyis kyang de bzhin mchod/ /dza ya mu sa na la 19sogs/ /dri zhim thams cad sbyar bas mchod/ /a ga 2 ru dang du ru ska / /shing gi thang chu gsar sbyar rnams / /bdug pa'i rgyur 2 ni bsngags pa yin/ /dngos grub sgo drung 'dug par bya/ /yang na nang du song nas ni/ /de ni byang phyogs kha blta zhing / /lag na rdo rje tshul bzhin bod da/ /shin tu bkra shis tshigs bcad dang / /de bzhin bde legs rdzogs pa gdon/ /de nas der ni rig sngags ma/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rtse mo can/ /rdo rje'i rigs las byung ba yi/ /rig sngags bstan pa gang yin pa/ /des ni bdag nyid bsrung bar bya/ /de nas thog mar spyan drang 95—469

ba / /ri rab de yi rtse mor ni/ /'dug nas sgra chen gdon 6)par bya/ /chos kyi chu klung spyan drang ba/ /dam pa 'di ni brjod par bya/ /bkra shis 50tshigs bcad brjod pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /'dus pa chen po'i mdo dag dang / /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po (5)dang / /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba de/ /ma nyams the tshom med pa dang / /'phags pa sha 54)ra dwa ti'i bu'i5 / /seng ge'i sgra ni dpe med gdon/ /de nas rdo rje rigs kyi yum/ /rig sngags rdo rje lcags kyu bzlas56/ /de nas kyang ni rtse mo can/ /de nas rdo rje rigs skyes kyi/ /rig sngags dag ni gang 'dod dang / /snying po 'gro lding gtum po dang / /de yi steng dang 'dod pa yi/ /rdo rje ma dang 'og pag (7༄can/ /lu gu rgyud dang gtum namo dang / / ser gtum 59chirdo rje thog thog tsham/ /de bzhin rdo rje khu tshur ma/ /rdo rje thub dka' pho nya ma1nyu/ /chen mo bcu dang drug cu bzhi/ /dang po blo gros rdo rje ma/ /gnyis pa rdo rje dril bu ma/ /gsum pa rdo rje nag mo dang / /bzhi pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /lnga pa rdo rje rol pa dang / /drug pa yang ni rgod bag can/ /bdun pa rdo rje shugs yin te/ /brgyad pa rdo rje nyi ma yin/ /dgu pa rdo rje dbyug pa ste/ /de ni sna tshogs gzugs zhes logrags / /bcu pa rdo rje bden pa 12ste/ /ci dga' bar ni bzlas thubarjod bya/ /rdo rje dbyug pa 15blta bar bya/ /rdo rje khro bo 'joms byed dang / /bung ba blta tshab chu klung dang / /rdo rje kā t+yā 1 na ya 18dang / /bdug pas 'jil dang srung ma dang / /yon tan chen mo de la 19sogs/ /nges pa nyid du bzlas brjod bya/ /des na dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur/ /nges par gnas pas rig sngags na //mchog 'gyur rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /bdug 21pa kun gyis rgyas pa yis/ /dkyil 95wa 470

'khor du ni brgyad brgya (1)bzlas/ /des na las su bsgrub pa yisan/ /rig sngags des ni grub par 'gyur/ /rig sngags gang la dga' ba des/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bzlas brjod bya/ /lag na rdo rjes bshad pa yi ri/ /rig sngags mang po de nyid ni/ /mchog 'dod ri dngos grub 'dod pa yis5/ /ci nas skyo bar mi 'gyur spyad/ /de nas rdzogs par spyan drangs shing 6ri/ /gsang sngags rgyas par byas nas ni/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'dod pa kun/ /gzung 7ba yang ni bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gtso bor 'dzin/ /dad cing mnyam par gzhag yi/ /mi ni dam tshig 'dzin du gzhug /des na de la mkhas pa yis spyo/ /bslab gzhi 1 lnga ni sbyin par bya/ /ming 'di zhes ni bya ba bdag /phyin cad 1lhanam 'tsho'i 1 bar dag tu//srog gcod log par g.yem pa dang / /rku 1 dang brdzun 'du smra ba dang / /'bru dang sbyar ba'i chang 'thung skab/ /rtag tu bdag gi spangs lazhes smros1 / /bslab gzhi nyusnyemachog dang ldan pa de/ /blo gros rdo rje kyi bsrung bar bya/ /'bogs par 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir/ /byin gyis rlabs na kyi cho ga'ang bya / /de nas der ni bum pa bdun/ /chu ni rab tu blugs nas kyang / /blo gros rdo rjes bsngags ri lhapa des/ /bdud rtsi zhes 22ni brjod pa yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya na ni/ /dril bur bcas pas dran byed brjod/ /lag pa gnyis ka bla 'og 2 7sbyar/ /mthe'u chung mthe bo na sbrel bya zhing / /bdud rtsi'i chu ni blug ri 5par bya/ /gos gtsang na bgos shing 2 /rab bsdams pa/ /skra bshig pa la ngu 'bod che/ /mi bzad 29rnams ni bsgo bar bya/ /'di ni ngu 'bod chen po ste / /'khrug cing sdug bsngal 1chen po'i gnas/ /'di yis khyod ni dam tshig 95—471

las / /nyams na myur du gdungs par 'gyur/ /khyod ni dam tshig shes gyur na/ /rkyen du bab 1par ma lus sbyin/ /des na khyod la mkhas pa 'di/ /'khrug (5)pa'i sdug bsngal byed mi 'gyur/ /dam tshig spangs pa gang yin dang / /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs pa/ /de la dam tshig gzhan med pa/ /bstan bcos kyi ni gzhung lugs yin/ /dmyal ba yod pa 'di la ltos/ /nad rnams thams cad tshogs pa dang / /'byung po ril sogs rnams kyis rgyas/ /khyod ni de nyid ltung bar byed/ /gdon mi za yi 4sdog pa'i las/ /'di la dpyad par bya ba med/ /rtag tu khyod kyis dam tshig 5sungs/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor mchod pa gyis/ /'on kyang 6'byung po sha za sogs/ /sdig byed de dag 'jug mi 'gyur/ /slob dpon la ni gus par bya/ /de 7ni rdo rje 'dzin nyid yin/ /da 8ni khyod tshe 'bras bur bcas/ /khyod kyi 'tsho ba 'bras bu yod/ /da 9ni dam tshig lha rnams dang / /khyod ni mtshungs pa nyid du 'gyur1 sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di/ /ji ltar rtag tu mdzes pa bzhin/ /de ltar khyod ni yon tan gyis//dam tshig nges par gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje de blangs la/ /lag pa g.yon pas dril bu bzung 11/ /lag pa g.yas pas de yi g.yas/ /bzung 12nas kyang ni spro bar bya/ /'di skad rtag tu grub pa 'di/ /sdug bsngal 15dag las sgrol ba ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen nyid dang ni/ /lhan cig tu ni 'jug par 'gyur / /de nas grur ni zhugs 14nas kyang / /'khor sayug las ni brgal glubar bya/ /lag pa btang nas de la ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bstan par bya / /'khrul pa med par 1 me tog gis/ /mdun bzhugs bde gshegs man chad dang / /dkyil 'khor gang dang gang mthong ba/ /de dang de la bde bar

mchod / /de nas thams cad mthong nas kyang / /yon gyi bum par dbul bar bya / /blo can gyis ni mtshan yang bzung (1ri/ /dam pa gzhan yang bdag gis bshad / /rdo rje stangs (5)thabs 'gro ba dang / /gad mo bcas par bsgyur ba dang / /g.yon pas kyang ni brdab rinasapar bya/ /seng ge'i sgra sgrogs ri 'gying ba dang / /mdzub mos hūṃ yang bsgrags byas te/ /thams cad shin tu byed pa'i mchog /de nas gzhan yang mi shes par/ /cho ga bzhin du mnod 6par bya /slob dpon gus par legs bya zhing / /dam tshig kyang ni nges par bstan / /til zan la sogs mon sran gre'u/ /bdag nyid kyis ni legs par bza'/ /lhag (rigapar bla mar gus byas dang / /de la dga' bar byas nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang / /rig sngags rnams la sdug par 'gyur59/ /de nas rig sngags tshogs rnams la/ /de yis 7rig sngags gang 'dod pa/ /de ni bsgrims te bklag bya zhing / /dngos grub 'dod pas rtag tu mchod/ /de ltar slob dpon rgya chen tshogs rnams dang / /lha dang lha min mchog gzugs du ma yis1sto / /mthong zhing thos la 'brang bar 'gyur ba dang / /rtag tu legs mchod rjes su bstan 3lheb yin/ /rdo rje'i rigs dpal dang ldan pa las mnyes pa dka' zhing me dang nyi ma las lhag pa de kho na nyid kyi mi dang dam pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa mchog tu gyur pa gang dang gang yin pa de dag ni dkyil 'khor dang dam tshig rab tu rtogs pas rtag tu mthong zhing thos pa'am/ bsgrub pa'i tshul dang ldan par byas na dngos grub 'grub pa'am/ phan pa yang thob par 'gyur ro / /rdo rje chen po thogs bzhin du rtag 1 tu bdug pa dang / me tog dang /dri dang / lha bshos rgyas par dbul zhing sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de ltar gnas bzhi 95—473

pa tshul 'dzin cing nyi ma'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di 0)ni dpal skyed cing mchog tu myur ba'i cho ga yin pas na dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po nyid yin no/ /lag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po ②lag na rdo rje dbang phyug chen po gnyis kyis dam tshig bshad pa las gnas bzhi pa rdzogs so// //de nas rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /rdo rje yi ni rigs kyi yum/ /bsgrub pa yi ni don rnams kun/ /sgrub pa byed pa gang yin bshad/ /na mo rat+na daratra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā ca pa ta ye/ na maste badz+ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi 5 badzā ya6/ na maḥ7su badzā 8ya/ na mo badz+ra dru ta le59ni/ na mo badz+ra shā na ye / na mo badz+ra hro 1 da yā ya/ na mo brdzu ku shā ya12/ 1snyen mo badz+ra ko ṣā tsoya/ na mo badz+ra pā shā ya/tsha na mo badz+ra labi dza yā ya1 / na mo brdzu 18ku sha ko ṣa pā tsho/smusha bi dza yā ya/ na maḥpra brta ā brta/ brdzu ku 21shi/ mi li mi li/ hi li hi li / hi ri hi ri/ ki ri ki ri/ ā kusbyo/ ā /sgyeri 2/ gi ri gi ri/ khi ri khi ri/ bhi ri bhi ri/ ki li ki li/ badzā ku lam̐ da so sma ra/ gi ri gi ri/ ti ri ti ri/ bhi ri bhi ri/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha/ ā na ya me hi rat+nasage/ su bar+ṇa 24dha na dha s+t+ya/ a ta pa ya ma/ ba ru ṇa ku be ra/ in+d+ra nasnyenā /sbyo —rte ya / yan+t+ra dā 1ma ni/ gro: ku she ri na/ tan+t+ra / ki li ki li/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍi / ki ri ṇi brah+ma na 5ba de ho birgyu dzin ba de ho /sri/ ko ṣa sa /khri/ni li bi la ni lilbi ri ku mā 9ro ad+dha ru tri ma 1de ho tsan+d+ra 0pa de ci ho shukra 4 ba de ho / srur+ya 5ba de ho/ ya rma ba de ho/ talta ba de ho/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bī ri bī 95—474

ri / a kum+bha/ ā na la 91)a krazhunas/ i hi tu rā hi/ tu ru tu ru/sarba kā lo ( su/ di (4)gra bī (5)ra/ ki li ki li/ mi li mi li/ ti ri ti ri/mi li mi li/ tsa ka tsa ka /ki ni ki ni/ bi ri bi ri/ sha tha ku shi sa ha 6sra/mi la bi sha tsaṅku shi/ brdza ba he 7 badzā ṇi pri rinaye/ ma ti ma ti/ ti ri ti ri/ki ri ki ri/ a kuspya/ri/ a n+ya kurmi ma 1 rin/ ba ra ka na ma nā 11ya/ ya she ya shi na/ ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ghi ni ghi ni/ khi ri khi ri/ bi tsa ra bi tsa ra/ ko shaṃ ko 15shi ni/ ku be ra 1 ma kraṣ+ṭi ka sakra ma gadha/ la la la la/ha si ni pri tshan/ pri yaṃ ka ri/ tsak+ṣurma dziti/ tsak+ṣuḥ1 pra bi 18sha /ma na ma ki 19ri / sha yasne tsan+dha ni )ni/ bhi la 1gi li/ pā gsha de ba ra de lha/ tsaklade / ha ra ha ra/ ba su ba su/ mi si mi si 5/ he he hi hi ha ha/ ki ri na ka la ka la / ba la ba 2 la/ tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥ ta me ka thā 29ya sarba sarbe shasku ru ku ru/ba ki me duḥka ta ya/ mi li mi li/ tsi li tsi li/ tsu lu tsu lu/ pri yaṃ pri ye na/sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ bi ri bi ri/ bi mi 2ya shaṃ ya she na/la bha la bha/ ki ri ki ri/ mi ti mi ti/ lo ke ri/ ra ma ra ma/ ra ti ka ri bhi ti ka ri/ ma ma su kha ka ri/ nir skṛ da ti ka ra/ kiṅka ri kiṅka ri/ ka ra ma ri/ bi ti bi ti/ 5mi ri mi ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ hi ri hi 0ri/ bi ri bi ri / ghi ri ghi ri/ bhi ri bhi ri/ hi ri hi ri/ badzi ṇi/ bstobyu ri shi pa ra māt+pa ri )shi ha re badz+re spyi pā ṇi ka 'ol shi ba ni/ bhak+ṣa pā ṇi/ tsak+ṣu rī ku shi pā ṇi nya / bha ra bha ra/ ma ma pi ri pi ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ tu ru tu ru / ta ra ta ra/ brdzu ku shī ye naswā hā/ ko ṣāṅku shrī ye rnyiswā hā/ pā shāsku shī ye byuswā hā/ bi dza lngasku shī ye 5swā hā/ k+ṣe māt+pa shī phaye swā hā/ ādz+nyā āt+pa shī ye 95—475

swā hā/ saṅgāsku sha ā kur+sha tī 1)ye swā hā/ de bāsku shī (g.ye swā hā/ sdi (kyis ru ṣāṅku shī ri45ye swā hā/ hro da āt+pa shrī riganoye swā hā/ dharmāṅku shrī yiye swā hā/ sarba lo ka dza yāṅku shī 7yi swā hā/ sarba satā nā mā kun+ta ṇa ba shī ka ra 'osku shī (0ye swā hā/rdo rje lcags kyu de nyid ni/ /'di ltar rnam pa gzhan (9)du yang / /rdo rje rigs chen gtso mo ste/ /'bar ba chen mo mchog sbyin mchog /rigs kyi yum ste rigs kyi mchog /las mchog kun gyi byed pa mo/ /bcing tshadang bgrol /lhab thams cad kyi/ /las kun la ni thub med pa/ /dam pa ci 'dra de bzhin 'dra'o //bar ma ci 'dra de bzhin 'gyur/ /snying po dang ni ming 'di yang / /gtso bo dang ni mchog tu bshad/ /lag na rdo rje nyid kyang ni/ /skad cig gis ni 'di bkug 1lhan/ /phyi rol rgyal po pho nya sogs/ /tshogs rnams lta la 8ci zhig smosa'i / / lha yi lorigs ni mthong ba yi/ /rig sngags 'chang ba de la ni/ /'grub par mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /gang zhig rab tu bsgrims nas ni/ /yum 'di rtag tu 'chang byed pa/ /de la mchog kun 'grub par 'gyur/ / bcing ba 1 dang ni grol ba la/ /rig sngags gsang sngags kun bdag 'gyur/ /nang dang phyi rol bcas pa yi/ /'khor dang ldan par byas na ni/ /gcig pu 'jig rten gsum mchog dang / /rnam pa gsum du 'gyur bar bshad/ /de dag thams cad khyad par du/ /stobs dang ldan par skye bos brjod/ /mdor na yum 'di thams cad kyi/ /mchog gi dam par bshad pa 42yin/ /de dag bsgrubs pa'i dus dang ni/ /tha mal dus su rtag tu yang / /ji skad bshad pa de bzhin du/ /rig sngags 'di ni sbyar bar bya/ /na maḥtsu ru kun+da/rte/ tsu ru kun+dan / tsu ru kun+da/ 1 badz+ra pā ṇi na/ na mo bud+dha 2 su swā hā/ lan nyi shu 95wa 476

rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas pa'i yungs kur gyi phye 51)mas gzhag par bya/ na maḥku ru tsu ru badz+ra pā ṇi/ na mo bud+dha su swā hā/ 'dis ni me tog dang bdug pa dbul bar bya'o/ /na mo dusmo dusmi/ u dusmi dusma dumarinano/ tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/'dis bshos dbul lo/ /na mo brdzu brdzu/ badz+re ṇi badzi ṇi / ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ e tai ri sarba bigha ṭ+wāṃ bi nā ya rka5tsho/ sa ma mā ra ya'/ha na ha na/ ur+sā ri skad ya/ nā 8sha ya/ bi t+t+waṃ (9)sa ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa tsista: 1 ma me / hu ru hu ru/ siṣ+ṭhañtsaṇ+ḍa /lhabadz+ra pā ṇi/ rādz+nyā 12pa ya ti swā hā/ me sbar 1ril sngags 'dis shing 'o ma can gyi yam sreg shing ngam/ ka ri ma nga la ka ri'i yam d+kusreg shing dang ske tshe tshadang / lan tshwa dang tsha 1 tshob gsum rnams lhan cig tu sbyar te4snye / sbyin sreg byas na bgegs dang log 'dren gyi gnod pa thams cad sel bar byed do/ /de nas de yi bsgrub pa ni/ /rig sngags 'chang ba kun gyis mchodam/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni gang gis su/ /stobs chen 'di ni grub pa bshad/ /thams cad mkhyen pas 16thams cad gzigs/ /sangs rgyas 'grub byed mgon po dang / /'jig rten dag na ya mtshan gsang / /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas / /lha rnams dang ni dri za dang / /rig sngags 'chang dang lto 'phye che/ /shin tu ya mtshan gsang ba 'di/ /don kun 'grub byed mnyan par gyis/ /gang zhig gsang ba'i rgyal po'i mchog /'di ni so sor 'chang byed pa/ /de la 'jig rten thams cad na/ /bka' las 'gal bar byed pa med/ /ci ste sgrub pa'i de nyid shes/ /yang na dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /cho ga bzhin du kun byas na/ /sgrub pa pos ni thams cad 'thob/ /lha 'am lha ma yin rnams dang / /gnod sbyin yang na 2 rig sngags 'chang / /gzhan yang gang dag su yang rung / /95—477

'gal bar byed pa gang yang med/ /sangs rgyas sha 1)ra dwa ti'i bu/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang / /rig sngags bdag gi bla ma la/ /ci ste mchog tu dang byed na/ /de ni kun las lhag pa nadang / /sems can kun gyis mchod pa dang / /rtag tu dngos grub kun byed dang / /gzhan gyi dngos grub 'jig gepar nus/ /dus kun du ni gtsang ba dang / /gsang ba thams cad 'chang byed la / /rig sngags 'chang gi go 'phang mchog /shin tu sems par byed pa yi/ /cho gar ldan zhing rgyas par bcas / /de ni ma lus bshad par bya/ /de nas lha dang lha ma yin/ /mi dang rig sngags 'chang rnams dang / /'byung po'i tshogs dang klu rnams dang / /gnod sbyin rnams dang srin por bcas/ /gsang ba'i mchog ni mnyan pa'i phyir/ /thams cad thal mo sbyar nas 'khod/ / de nas 55citshig don rtogs pa yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas de dag la/ /gsal bar bya phyir tshig 'di smras/ /nga ni dkyil 'khor dam pa dang / /bla ma'i rigs ni sngon zhimathong la / /rdo rje dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /rig sngags sgrub pa rtogs 7byas nas/ /zla ba phyed gsum bar du ni/ /zla gcig pas ni bsgrub par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rdzogs pa 'am/ /sku gdung ldan pa'i mchod rten der/ /rig sngags rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /rig sngags rigs kyi tshogs bskor 8ba/ /cho ga bzhin du byas nas ni/ /yid dang 'thad pas mchod par bya/ /mtshams bcad 9 dang ni 7phyogs bcings 11dang / /chus ni kun nas bcad 12pa dang / /thams cad du ni bsrung ba rnams/ /cho ga bzhin du legs par dgod/ /sna gsum rdo rje bkra shis dang / /lcags kyu kha gdengs yungs kur gyis/ /tshul bzhin dang por mdun dag tu/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i gzugs su bri/ /kha zas kyang ni dkar 95—478

gsum gyis/ /cho ga bzhin byas bza' 1bar bya/ /dus gsum yang na nub bdun du/ /zlas ri chibarjod mchog gi brgyad brgya bya/ /de nas der ni rdo rje dang //lcags kyu 'bar ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /der dani gzugs las grub pa po/ /lha yi rig sngags 'chang bzhin ca'agyur/ /'jig rten gsum yang snang bar byed/ /sa steng snyedag kyang 'bar ba dang / /'jig rten gsum yang g.yo bar ni/ /bdag nyid kyis rdo ni der mthong 'gyur/ /rig sngags rdo rje lcags kyu dge / /de nas de la 'grub par 'gyur/ /ri dgas kyis bskor gzhon nu ma'i/ /thad de dga' ba rtsen 87par 'gyur/ /de nas lha dang 'byung po ri9dag /rgya mtsho nam mkha' sa gnas pa/ /dang ba med cing ma grub rnams/ /de ltar dga' bar gyur nas ni/ /don rnams kun yang byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin du ni ji 1 ltar yang / /kun tu dngos grub ya mtshan can/ /mkha' la 11de bzhin byed par 'gyur / /de nas ci dga' rgyu ba dang / /de yi dga' mgur de bzhin byed/ /rtse dga' mchog tu shes par bya/ /de ni yun du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /de ni dga' bzhin mkha' la 'gro/ /lha yi rig sngags 'chang gis bskor/ /de ni gcig pu ci dga' bar/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa yin bzhin du/ /lhag par dga' ba'i gnas rnams su/ /rig sngags 'chang bas bskor 12bar 'gyur/ /de ni na da ku ber 1 bzhin / /dga' bar gang yang rtse bar 'gyur/ /dus min 1 par ni shing rnams dang / /me tog tshal dang 'bras bu'i tshal/ /khang bzangs 15yid du 'ong ba rnams / /thams cad kyang ni sprul bar byed/ /'on kyang 'di ni mdo tsam ste/ /'dir ni de las bshad mi bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu grub na ni/ /tshig tu brjod pa thams cad grub/ /las kyi dam pa 'di nyid kyis/ /thams cad kyang ni 'grub 95wa 479

par bshad/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin mthong nas ni/ /dam tshig dag la mkhas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas rig sngags rdo rje 'dzin/ /bla ma tshul bzhin mchod par bya / /bsgrims te mchod pa byas na ni/ /lha bshos dag kyang tshul bzhin dbul/ /de nas 'dod pa kun sbyin pa/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rig sngags gdon/ /lha bshos de yi cho ga dang / /me tog bdug pas mchod byas nas/ /sgrub pa pos ni ci nus kyis/ /dus gsum bzlas brjod byas na ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pas kyang / /gdon gyi las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /des na gdon ni stong phrag rnams / /dga' mgur yang ni gzhig par nus/ /yang na g.yul ngor mi bzad ri 1ri'ajig /gdon dag gi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /myur du gdon ni 'bebs pa dang / /de bzhin gzhig dang bsad pa tshanadang / /bcing (gyidang brdeg dang gzir ba dang / /ku co 'don du 'jug yang ( rung / /grong khyer dang ni gnas rnams dang / /smas pa'i rma ni spo ba dang / /rig sngags dam pa bshad pa (5sku'adis / /thams cad kyang ni byed par 'gyur/ /babs pa de dag thams cad kyang / /pi wang tsidag kyang len 7du gzhug /de bzhin gar gyi tshon cho ga rnams/ /yid 'ong ya mtshan byed du gzhug /dgug dang rmi lam cho ga dang / /de bzhin lcags sgrog gzhom pa dang / /rgyal po'i pho brang dag na ni/ /rtsod pa dag las lhag par rgyal/ /gzugs dang stobs chen ldan pa yi/ /rig sngags rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /gang gi snying la tshul bzhin rtag /de yi don kun 'grub par 'gyur / /skyes pa'am yang na bud med dam/ /klu 'am lha yang dga' ba yod/ /der ni kun tu thams cad la/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyal po dang ni blon po dang / /blon po chen po mdun 9na 'donam/ /zhag 95—480

bdun yang na lnga yi bar/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas dbang du 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'chi bar bya 'dod na/ /de yi 3)gzugs de der na bris la/ /lag pas mnan la bzlas brjod bya/ /gdon dang klu yi gdon yang rung / /'byung po 'byung po'i gdon dang ni/ /khar ni rdo rjes dgazir byas na( ri/ /zhag bdun gyis ni brlag 95)par 'gyur/ /bran (ne mo dang ni mi rnams kyang / /zhag gsum 7gyis ni brlag par 'gyur/ /dbang du bya bar 'dod na ni/ /der yang nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas(na / /brgyad 97brgyar bzlas brjod byas na ni/ /bu dang bu mo chung ma dang / /khyim thab tshadang ni nor 'jog dang / /khyim dang bzhon 37pa glang chen rta / /ma he dang ni grong yang rung / /zhag bdun gyis ni myur bar 'thob/ /gzhan gyis 12rig sngags rigs kun dang / /gdon rnams kyang ni brlag par 'gyur / /khye'u dag dang nya ni bu mo rnams/ /nad kyis kyang ni ma rung 7'gyur/ /ro bsregs sol ba'i ri mo yis/ /dgra yi gzugs ni der bris la/ /de yi steng du 'dug nas ni/ /gang du gzhom par 'dod pa der/ /gzir bar byas te zhag bdun du/ /bzlas brjod dang ni sbyin sreg bya/ /de ltar byas na gzir bar 'gyur/ /ci ste bu mo thob 'dod na/ /des ni zhag bdun bya bar bstan / /zhag bdun 'bum du bzlas na ni/ /bu mo'i mchog kyang thob par 'gyur / /rig sngags 'chang ba bdag nyid kyis/ /khros nas bzlas brjod byas na ni/ /grong khyer dag ni 'bar ba dang / /gser dang de bzhin 'jig pa dang / /gdon tshadag gis ni 'debs par 'gyur/ /gang las rgyal 'dod dmag gi nang / /'dug nas kyang ni bzlas tshabarjod bya/ /grong khyer dbus 'dug bzlas na ni/ /nad kyis dzigong khyer dkrugs par 'gyur/ /grong gi 95—481

dbus 'dug bzlas na ni/ /grong mi nad kyis dkrugs par 'gyur/ /dgon par 'dug nas bzlas na ni/ /gdug pa kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /de nas yid ni zhi ba yis/ /zhi ba'i rig sngags brjod par bya/ /zhi phyir rig sngags brjod na ni/ /thams cad du ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /bsad (3)phyir rig sngags bzlas na ni/ /phan tshun du yang gsod par 'gyur/ /'thab tu gzud ( phyir rig sngags bzlas/ /'thab mo mngon du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /shing skam phyir ni chu la bzlas/ /zla ba gcig gis lo ma 'byung / /kun dga' ra ba yid 'ong yang / /zla ba gcig gis bshig par 'gyur/ /ci ste nyi ma rangs par bzlas/ /chu dang zas dang bag lachos dang / /'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs kyang / /de ma thag tu sgyur 5bar byed/ /gzhan gyis bzhon phyinodang de bzhin du/ /shing rta'i bzhon snye pa 'joms 8par byed/ /ci ste chu klung chen po yi/ /'gram 9du song nas bzlas brjod byas / /las rnams gang dang gang 'dod dang / /gang gang cho ga ji bzhin gang / /de bzhin cho ga gtor ma dang / /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg gtsang byas na/ /des na don rnams thams cad kyang / /byed 'gyur de la the tshom 11med/ /rtag tu bden smra bslab la dga'/ /dngos grub mchog chen thams cad ldan/ /'byung po sgrub par 'dod na ni/ /zhag gsum smyung nyu2byas mar gyi ngo / /bcu bzhi la ni gtor ma sbyin/ /zla ba drug gam zla ba phyed/ /shing drung yang na dgon par gnas/ /gcig pu bsrung ba mchog byas la/ /slong 15mo yi ni zas kyang bza'/ /zla drug yang na zla ngab gcig /lha 'am gdon kyang gnas kyang rung / /zla gcig phyugs 15kyi lhas su gnas/ /zho dang 'o ma samar yang bza'1 / /sku gdung ldan pa'i mchod rten drung / /zla gcig sna tshogs 95wa 482

zas kyis mchod/ /zla ba gnyis ni dur khrod du/ /gtor ma bdug pa gtsang sogs mchod/ /thang ngam mchod rten drung du bzlas/ /de nas 'byung po brlag par 'gyur/ /der ni 'byung po dam pa gang / /yang na thog mar gang 'ongs dang / /gang tshe de la nye bar 'gyur/ /gang na gang zhig sems kyis 'dod/ /de tshe shin tu bsnyen nas ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rtag tu bzlas/ /de yi ming ni dris 1)nas kyang / /de nyid ming ni gzung nabar bya/ /gcig pus dkyil 'khor byas na ni/ /rig sngags rdo rje lcags kyu'i 5tshogs/ /dri la sogs pas legs mchod nas/ /des ni 'byung po de dag dgug /de yis ming brjod 'byung po rnams / /dga' nas der ni 'ong bar 4'gyur/ /de nas des ni legs par 5mchod / /gzhan yang 'ongs nas mchod par bya/ /ming ni legs par brjod bya zhing / /skrag 'byed ming la brten 7nas ni/ /'byung po sgrub tu grub 'gyur na / /mi ni 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas de la 'byung po rnams/ /kun nas nye bar 'khor bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i zham ring namathun 9byed bzhin/ /las kun yang ni byed par 'gyur/ /de ni rgyal po'i dmag 1 rnams la/ /rgyal po chen pos byas pa bzhin/ /stobs chen 'byung po'i sde dag la/ /bka' ni kun tu stsol 11bar byed/ /sa stengs 12kun tu rtse byed cing / /'byung po'i bdag po kun gyis lha mchod/ /'byung po dag gis phul ba yis/ /kha zas la bosogs thams cad za/ /grong ni gang la rgyal 'dod cing / /yang na phan par 'dod kyang rung / /bsgrub phyir yang ni gzhig sapa'i phyir/ /der ni 'byung po rnams kyang gtong / /des ni ming gang ma 1 bkug pa'i/ /'byung po'am 'byung po'i tshogs kyang rung / /de yi las mchog 'dod na ni/ /de yi 1 ming yang smos par 95—483

bya / /ming ni smos pa de yis ni/ /snyems (1)pa med pa'i 'byung po yang / /bkug pa med par myur du ni/ /bka' bzhin byed par 'gyur ba bstan/ /de ni mi yi 'khor dag tu/ /sgyu 'phrul du ma byed par 'gyur/ /lhag par 'byung po'i 'khor dag tu/ /spyod pa sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /srog (9chags mi la sogs rnams kyi/ /srog la dbang bar des 'gyur ro/ /'byor par bya ba'i phyir yang rung / /yang na lus ni gzhig phyir des/ /ming gis bkug pa'i 'byung po la/ /dga' bzhin bag brkyang (5)smra bar byal/ /ming la (5)sogs pa 'di dag gis6/ /sna ni shin tu che ba dang / /shin tu ring bar byos shig ces/ /bsgo 7rin de bzhin byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rkang lag bzhin mdog bsgyur/ /rid pa dang ni skam 8pa dang / /ma rung bar (9)ni byos shig ces/ /bsgo na de tshe de bzhin byed/ /de bzhin rnam pa mang po dang / /shin tu 'jigs pa sna tshogs stonas/ /de bzhin zhi 11byed sna tshogs kyis/ /'byung po sgrub pa rtse bar 'gyur / /mi 'dod na yang mi rnams dang / /'byung po mang pos mthong mi 'gyur / /rig sngags 'chang chen bzhin du 'gyur/ /gang zhig rig sngags rtag tu zlos12/ /lha la yang ni phyag 'tshal zhing / /rtag tu 'byung po rnams la yang / /kha zas ci 'dod sbyin byed por ri/ /de ni lhag par bde 'gyur zhing / /tshe yang lhag par bskal par thub/ /'byung po mang po'i rgyal po tshamachog /gtso bor yang ni 'gyur ba dang / /lha yi lorgyal po 'dra ba yang / /rkyen tshedu bab par bshad pa yin/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ma yi 1 bsgrub pa rdzogs so// //rdo rje lcags kyu'i rigs la ni/ /rig sngags don kun grub byed pa/ /lha mo 95—484

mchog 'gror grags pa 'di/ /sems can rnams kyis bsten 1par bshad/ /zla ba drug gis 'grub 'gyur te/ /tshig gis don kun byed par bstan/ /rtsi sman thams cad blangs nas (5)ni/ /srang gcig nges par gzhag par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra 95)ya su/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi (4)su/ ba ti ba ra ti5/ ku sha sasbanam nen se/ a (7ta ra te58)/ ba te/ ye saṃ tse bhū (9te/ aste lathe/ rū pi ta a smṛ mi yiḥswā hā/ sku gdung sna ldan pa'i mchod rten drung / /dus gsum bzlas brjod brgyad brgya bya/ /gtsang tu zhing tshangs par spyod pa yis/ /lha bshos me tog bdug pa dang / /de bzhin mtshan mo mar me dang / /mchod pa ci nus ci dga' bya/ /mtshams bcad 77phyogs bcing bsrung ba rnams/ /rtag tu rdo rje lcags kyus bya/ /de ltar rtag tu brtson pa la/ /de ni zla ba drug gis 'grub/ /de nas 'dod chags la sogs dang / /sman chen mnyam par 'jog tshapar 'gyur / /nad dang sman kun ston pa dang / /gtam rgyud tshathams cad smra bar 'gyur / /sgrub pa po la legs nyes rnams/ /tshig gis ston cing smra bar byed/ /gsang sngags de'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ ras ma nyams pa la tshon rtsi spyin med pas bcom ldan 'das dang lag na rdo rje'i sku gzugs bris te/ lha mo yang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'dud par byas nas/ yar gyi ngo tshes gcig la brtsams te/ zas su 'o ma dang phye'i lde 1 gu za zhing dus gsum du sna ma'i me tog brgyad brgya la lan re re bzlas brjod byas pas lag na rdo rje la bsnun par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dang lag na rdo rje la mchod pa yang rtag tu byas te/ mjug tu zhag gsum smyung 18bar byas nas/ zla ba nya'i nub mo brgyad stong gis bsnun la ci 'byor pas mchod na 'grub par 'gyur te/ don thams cad ston par byed 95—485

do / /gzhan yang tshes bcu gnyis nas brtsams te/ nya'i bar du gtsang zhing nges pa dang ldan par byas te/ ras la bcom ldan 'das dang / lag na rdo rje dang / lha mo dang / sgrub pa po rnams dge bsnyen (1)la 'drir (5)bcug ste/ sku gdung dang ldan pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchod pa byas nas/ sna ma'i me tog brgyad brgya la lan brgyad brgya sngags kyis btab nas phung po lngar bcad de/ de rnams las cha gcig bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya'o/ /lhag ma rnams ni phyogs bzhir gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la phul ba de dag las kha cig blangs te ras dkar po'i dkyinang du phur nas sngas su bcug ste nyal bar bya'o/ /'o ma dang phye'i 'de cag dang zas dkar po za zhing me tog dkar po dang / dri dkar po phul na zla ba nya la 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gang gi nyin par yang rung ste/ cho ga de bzhin du sna ma'i me tog brgyad brgya la lan brgyad brgya bzlas brjod byas te/ mchod pa byas la lhag ma yang de bzhin du gtor nas nyal na rmi lam du thams cad ston par byed do/ /cho ga gsum pa ni me long la bsgrub par bya'o/ /mchog 'gro ma'i rig sngags spyo) cho ga cardogs so// //na mo rat+na ratra ya su/ na ma ñtsaṇ+ḍa 6badz+ra pā 7riṇi su/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 8pa ti su / e h+ye hi 9badz+ra pā ṇi/ i rda 1 bā ha na/ ma nu sma ra shī s+t+waṃ 11ma na tsa ba la li ta ga ti/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 12pa ti badz+ra pā ṇi/ hi 1 nyi he ti he hi hi hi/ he ku ru he ku ru/ ku ku ku ku/ ku badz+ra pā ṇi/ sa ra sa ra/ be+e ri be+e ri te hi he hi he hi/ ku ku bha ku ku bha/ badz+ra pā ṇi ngaswā hā/ 'di ni sasnying po spyan 95—486

drang ba'o(1)/ /de la 'di ni lag na rdo rje'i snying po yin nonas/ /sarba tra a pa rā dzi te④/ sarba tra a pra ti ha tai/ sarba tra 5arba sā phyiradha ne/ o dza ste mdzo gā 8ma 〉(9)/ swa rū yipa mu pa dar+ṣa ṇ+ḍaṃ/ tī li tī 1lhali/ mo ku la shabhā ru tai badzo tut+ta ka ra skoka ra kṛ kyu nyu ka ra na ra ṇa 'dza rna/ ad+dha 15na sid+dhi 7pa ra ma sid+dhi / pa tsa lo tsaṇ+ḍi nyu pi tra/ pa kai sa rka 1rtor ka 2 ta ka raṃ shī ti ka raṃ 1/ puṣ+ṭi ka raṃ/swa pa no pa ra das snye/ tsa ra dan/ sarba kurma 2nasarba sā 2 dha kai/ ā kur+sā shā ri/badz+ra pā ṇi (lhasu/ bo la lā pa rna/ badz+ra pā 2 ṇi su/ ha sa pā rna/ badz+ra pā 2 ṇi su / pa ra ma skṛ zhu)da ya mi rda na rme/ badz+ra pā ṇi su/ badz+ra pā ṇi ra ma hā yak+ṣa se nā (7pa ti rādz+nyā 22pa ya ti badz+re ṇa lha/ ha na ti/ da ha ti/ pa tsa ti/ sbyin ti/hrīn+da tsho )ti/ bid dā 2pa ya ti/ ā dzilo ka bi lo da rka ka ro ti/ hi li ni/ li mi li/ o ci u ho u bha badz+ra pā ṇi/ hu ru hu ru/ saṃ r+ghaṃ ra badz+ra bhañdza ye duṣ+ṭi /ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa/ ba sh+yi ka 1ro hi ha 2la ha ta/ ya swā hā/ hu lu hu khu/ ya swā hā/ hi li hi ta/ ya swā hā/ ka la ka lā ya 5swā hā/ ku lu ku ta/ ya tshig hā/ tī li tī 95 ya swā hā/ ki li ki ta/ ya 0swā hā/da ya ma sri )na sma ra badz+ra pā ṇi/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 51pa ti sa ma ya pra ti griṇ+ḍi ri hu te rinahu ti dhū ni )pa pā 55sha pa garnya 57ma snyi 5 tsa ra swa ma dru pa twa swa ma yaṃ bh+ya ti ga kra ma mād gyi ma / sa ma yo bi ti shu ti61/ hi li hi ri na i lisnyon/ ku ru rka du gyi pra sa gyi da shasto 5smin du ru me ha ra ba rā glunyi ri li/ ni ri gyi li/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ti li ti li/ba shi ma nu brta hi ri ṇi/ ni ri ṇi badz+ra pā ṇi spyonas ma yā 69nu brta r+shanyi ri mi ri i bha ha 1ya ni/ sanywa badz+ra pā ṇi ma ma hi/ swa ya mu pa tiṣ+ṭha 'aswā hā/ 'di ni de'i bdug pa'i sngags so/ /li rnyihi li hi —pi li tu u bh+yos/ u bha/ hu ru hu /95—487

bhañdza bhañdza〈17/ ba sh+yi mye ka ri ro haṃ rda na swā hā/ lag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bcas/ /rtsed hūṃ )mo can zhes bya ba yi/ /snying po 'di ni 'jig rten grags/ /de na 95)'dod dgur 6bsgrub pa yin / /gang zhig dngos grub mchog 'dod cing / /'di yi bsgrub pa'i don shes pa/ /des ni rdo rje bsgrub pa'i mchog /ya mtshan 'di ni bsgrub par bya/ /de nas na rim pa ji bzhin du/ /bdag gis legs par bshad par bya/ /dam pa'i don gyi rjes mthun 9)pa/ /thub la spyi bos phyag 'tshal ba/ /gser ram ra gan zangs la sogs/ /yang na tsan+dan bedamar po las/ /rdo rje rtse mo brgyad pa 'am/ /yang na rtse mo bzhi par bya/ /sor gsum yang na drug gam brgyad/ /yang na sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /zur brgyad shin tu rdzogs pa 'am / /yang na zur ni drug tu bya/ /de nas dgon pa'am rang gi khyim/ /gtsang zhing mnyam pa'i sa phyogs su/ /ba lang lci bas dkyil 'khor byugs(1/ /sku gdung mchog dga' gtsang ma yis/ /de yi steng du dri zhim pa'i/ /spos kyis (ge dkyil 'khor byug 1 par bya/ /yungs kur phul thag bzhi rnams 8kyang / /dbus dag tu ni gzhag par bya/ /de yi steng du rdo rje de/ /dri dang me tog phreng bas brgyana'i/ /rtag tu yang ni dus gsum du/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs bya/ /tsam pa ka dang tsam pa ku'i/ /me tog sna ma'i me tog rnams/ /yid du 'ong bas sangs rgyas dang / /rdo rje 'dzin la tshenges par mchod/ /du ruska 1 dang a ga 18ru/ /bdug pa'i mchog ni rtag tu bsreg /sku gzugs cho ga bzhin bris la/ /cho ga 'di ni bya ba ste/ /sangs rgyas gser gyi kha dog 'dra/ /sangs rgyas thad na gnas pa yi/ /lag na rdo rje g.yon phyogs bri/ /rgyal po bzhin du brgyan bya zhing / /ha cang dmar bar 19mi bya ste/ /sku gzugs nub 95—488

phyogs logs su bstan/ /shes rab can gyis cho ga 'di/ /bya ste de ni rim bzhin bshad/ /dang po yang ni tshes gcig brtsams/ /nges par gnas shing gtsang ba yis/ /khrus ni ba lang lci ba dang / /ba gcin /1btsags pas dus gsum bya/ /mdun du rtag tu gos phrugs ni/ /bdug pas rab tu bdugs pa bgo / /tsam pa ka dang tsam naka yi9 / /me tog rnams kyis rtag tu mchod/ /sna tshogs dri dang me tog phreng / /mdzes shing yid du 'ong bas tsho mchod/ /lan grangs brgyad brgyar bzlas brjod bya/ /du ruska dang a ga pa ru/ /bsreg cing mar me gnyis kyang dbul/ /rtag tu 'chi bar mi bya ste/ /de bzhin mar gyi mar me gzhan ri/ /nyin gcig 7bzhin du bskyed par bya/ /de tshe 'o ma'i 'dag /gu rnams / /za zhing mnyam par gzhag pa dang / /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad ldan pas / /tshes ni bcu gnyis bar du yang / /rtag tu ku sha'i mal stan 'dug /de nas zhag gsum smyung byas nas/ /zla ba nya la cho ga bzhin/ /dpe med pa yi mchod pa bya9ri/ /der ni tshon rtsi 1 sna gsum gyis/ /grong khyer dag kyang bri bar bya / /gru bzhi lham pa sgo bzhir 11ldan/ /phyogs cha legs par gcad 1 bya zhing / /mnyam byas de yi 1rinang dag tu/ /lha bshos dkar po dpe med dbul/ /phyi rol du yang sna tshogs pa/ /ci 'dod thams cad gzhag par bya/ /de nas ku sha'i stan kha'adug cing / /bsrung byas cho ga shes pa des/ /rdo rje 'bar bar gyur gyi bar/ /a ga loru dang du ruskas / /bsreg cing dga' bzhin bzlas brjod bya/ /nyi ma las lhag de yi gzi/ /rdo rje de ni legs par blangs1 / /cis kyang mi 'jigs mkha' la 'gro/ /rig sngags grub pa'i stobs dang ldan/ /rig sngags bdag po thams cad dang / /lag na rdo rje rigs 1 skyes pa'i/ /95—489

rig sngags tshogs ni kun gyis mchod/ /don mang dag la brten 6)bya zhing / /rnam pa mang du ci zhig smos/ /lag na rdo rje mnyam 'gyur te/ /'di la the tshom (gyici yang med/ /de nas dga' ba ma yin pa'i/ /las de dag kyang 'dir bya ste/ //de dag gi ni mdor bstan pa/ /snying po bsdus pa bshad par bya/ /gang zhig mi yi gtso bo 'am/ /blon po dbang du bya 'dod des/ /de yi bsgrub pa gang yin pa/ /'di 4yang rab tu bshad par bya/ /zhag bdun gtsang mar byas nas ni / /nas kyi zas ni dus su bza'/ /de nas seng ldeng me bsangs la yam sreg shing dang sbrang rtsi zho/ /mar blangs brgyad brgya tshang bar ni/ /dus (snyegasum du yang sbyin sreg bya/ /dus kyi lhag ma rtag tu bzlas/ /lan gsum khrus byas nges par gnas/ /dbang du bya 'dod gang yin pa/ /de dang yang ni phrad par bya/ /de yi ming ni smos pas kyang / /de ni bran bzhin dbang du 'gyur / /mi ni gang zhig 7 bran nor 'dod/ /des ni ri nor gyi tshad bsams la/ / de yi 9bsgrub mchog 'di bya zhing / /lan gsum khrus byas ⑩bil ba yi11/ /bdug pa mar dang ldan pa bsreg /de nas lag na rdo rje'i mdun / /der ni ba lang lci ba'i mer/ /sngar bshad pa ni gang yin pa'i/ /sbyin sreg mnyam par gzhag pas bya/ /yang na bil ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ /mar dang yungs kur ldan pa 'am/ /yungs kur mar dang ldan pa'ang rung / /yang na mar ldan bil ba 'am/ /mar dang yungs kur ldan pa yi/ /sbrang rtsi bzang po bil bar ldan/ /yang na re re sbyin sreg mchog / brgya rtsa brgyad du bya ba ste/ /15seng ldeng yam sreg shing bzang gis/ /dus gsum du ni rnam gsum byas / /phye dang ba gcin 'de 15gu dang / /phye dang 'o ma'i 'de 'gu'ang rung / /95wa 490
