dus gsum bza' zhing yang na ni/ /mi smra (1)mi bza' rig sngags bzlas/ /yang na sbyin sreg yid kyis bya/ /gtsang zhing brtson par gnas pa des/ /nor ni yid la gang 'dod pa/ /zhag bdun gyis ni thob par 'gyur/ /zla 5phyed yang na zla ba gcig /( )yang na zla ba phyed gsum gyis/ /rnam 4)pa kun gyi thabs rnams kyi(5)/ /'dod pa thams cad ma lus sbyin/ /yang na gdon 6gyi las rnams 'dir/ /sbyin sreg bzlas brjod brtson pa dang / /gtsang zhing dam tshig mkhas pa yis/ /thams cad rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtsed mo can gyi snying po rdzogs so// //de nas gtum po'i snying po'i 7cho ga rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /na maḥtsi li / kunas tsi ri ni(9)/ i li ku ru hati 7sra sid+dha bhasto /1mi ku ru me ha ba raṃ ki li bi li / hi ri ṇi nya su ru ku ru/ sa ma ya ma nu brta skṛ da yaṃ 1lhaswā hā/ snying po dran par byed pa'i tshig 'di dag gang du brjod pa der dga' bar gyur nas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /na maḥgī li gī salā ya swā hā/ ma hā tī li tī lā ya daswā hā/ kro dha tī li tī lā 7ya swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa gī li tī lā 1 ya swā hā/ de 1 ba ti khri li tī lā 10ya swā hā/ badz+ra tī li tī lā 2 tshoya swā hā/ badz+ra dha rā 21ya swā hā/badz+ra mo ta nā ya swā hā/ badz+ra stam+bha nā na ya swā hā/ badz+ra pra bhan+dha 22nā ya swā hā/e sa nyi ste badz+ra/ e hi su sti badz+ra/da e hi pra ti pra ti ra badz+ra/ e hi a pra ti ha ta badz+ra snye/ e hi a mo gha badz+ra/ e hi shī r+ghaṃ nī 29la be tshog badz+ra/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 87pa ti/ badz+ra pā ṇi 2/ mu ne mu ne mu ne/ ri lham ti/ ma hā ma ti/su ma ti/ e dzo gnyi pa ni tsiti li/ sau haṃ di li pirta ra ma ti ri9to ni ra ti ra 95wa 491

gsum ba lang lci bas bskus(1/ /las kyang dag cing sems dag nadang / /rdo rje 'dzin la gus pa dang / /rkang lag la sogs bkrus nas kyang / /dgon pa'am rang gi khyim yang rung / /gtsang ma'i phyogs su mchod rten nam/ /sku gzugs yang na sku gdung gi( no/ /mdun du rtag tu mnyam par gzhag /mi ni gtsang sbrar gi spyod pa yis/ /bdug pa me tog la sogs pa/ /mchog dang khyad par 'phags pa yis(5ra/ /dus gsum rtag tu mchod par bya/ /de la rab spro de la gus / /srog kyang de la bstan byas nas/ /lag na rdo rje gzugs kyang rung / /ji skad bstan bzhin ri mor bri/ /dri dang phreng ba byug pa yis/ /rtag tu de la mchod par bya/ /mar dang 5ldan pas dus su bza'/ /sbrang rtsi 'o thug bza' bar bya/ /ri mo'i sku gzugs nub phyogs bstan/ /rtag tu shar phyogs kha blta 7'dug /mar gyi mar me mi 'chi 8bas/ /nyin par mchod pa legs par bya/ /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla phyed dam/ /yar gyi ngo yi 9tshes brgyad la/ /brtsams te brgyad stong bzlas brjod bya/ /yang na nyin re 1 tshodus gsum du/ /lan grangs brgyad brgyar bzlas brjod bya/ /thang chu yang ni bsreg par bya/ /dang zhing rtse gcig sems kyis 11ni/ /bsrung ba'i mchog byas bzlas brjod bya/ /zla ba phyed ni lon nas kyang / /des ni zhag gsum smyung bar bya12/ /mchod pa la sogs kun rgyas shing / /shin 1 tu mang por byas nas kyang / /'dod pa yid la gzhag bya zhing / /de nas gus pa mchog gis sasu/ /oṃ ni tshig lostong bzlas brjod byasal/ /de nas rdo rje can yang mthong / /de la mchog sbyin gtso 1 bo de18 / /dam pa'i mchog ni 19sbyin par byed/ /bsgrub pa'i cho gas 2 spyan drangs nas / /mchod sbyin mchog la ci 'dod smros 1/ /tshig gis gang dag gang brjod 95—493

pa'i / /bsgrub pa'i dam pa thob par 'gyur/ / de yi 0)slar btang (gyicho ga de/ /rnam pa thams cad bshad par bya/ /des ni phyag dang mchod pa dang / /mchod yon me tog la sogs dbul/ /'dod pa'i rig sngags lan cig brjod/ / des ni na rdo rje 'dzin par ca'agro/ /na maḥhi li hu la/ ni li hu la/ a ha ha ha ha ha sa/ bri 5ti gats+tsha/ tu bha ga blo(6)/ badz+ra pā ṇi re tha su khaṃ (7༄tsu lu tsu lu swā hā/ 'di ni gcig gam gsum du brjod/ /lnga 'am bdun nam nyi shu gcig /brgya 'am yang na brgyad brgya'am/ /lan stong cho ga bzhin du brjod/ /'byung po'i gnas sam gzhan dag tu/ /rdo rje dang ni lha yi 58)mdun/ /dri kun gyi ni sbyor ba dang / /bcing dang 9grol la bzlas brjod bya/ /dgug dang slar btang lngathams cad dang / /bcing dang grol ba thams cad la/ /der ni lan cig brjod par bya/ /11des na rdo rje 'dzin par 1ge'agro/ /'di ni rtsed mo ldan pa yi1 / /bsgrub dang slar btang ba yang 9yin/ /'di gnyis la ni khyad par du/ /dbye bar bya ba mang po yod/ /gang gis rtag tu gtsang dbyas la/ /lo gcig bar du dus gsum dul/ /bzlas brjod rnam pa gsum byas na/ sna/ /de yis bde bar 'dod pa 'thob/ /gang zhig zla drug sgrub byed cing / /bzlas brjod nyi shu rtsa gcig byed/ /legs byas de ni mkha' la rgyu/ /'bring dang lhag ma nyid du 'gyur / /gang zhig zla gsum bzlas brjod 512byed/ /yang na yid kyis 17sbyin sreg las/ /byas na cho ga 'di dag gis/ /de ltar de yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /zla ba phyed gsum za gcig zos/ /des kyang dngos grub tha ma'am/ /'bring dang khyad par 'phags pa thob/ /khyim gyi don rnams grub byed cing / /nad rnams kyang ni sel bar byed/ /don rnams ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /de dag 95wa 494

thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /zla ba gcig tu bzlas brjod byed/ /'o thug sbrang rtsi mar bcas bza'/ /dus gsum brgyad brgya bzlas pas ni/ /gsum brjod mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ /legs par ma byas gdon la sogs/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /bcing dang dgrol ba thams cad dam/ /bsgrub pa'am gzhig pa bcang bar 17byed/ /zla phyed nas kyi kha zas zos/ /gdon gyi las rnams byed par nus/ /ba gcin nas kyi kha zas zos/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par nus/ /zhag bdun du ni dus gsum du/ /de bzhin brgyad brgya bzlas brjod byas/ /dbang du bya 9padang bcings la sogs/ /bsad ②par yang ni nus par 'gyur/ /gang zhig zhag lngar zas mi za/ /nyin gcig bzhin du bzlas brjod byed/ / des na 47mo rnams gzhig 5pa 'am/ /dgrol 6)dang dbang du bya bar nus ri/ /zhag gsum bar du dus gsum du/ /gang zhig sbyin sreg rnam (8gsum byed/ /lhag ma'i dus su khros nas bzlas/ /des ni gzhan yang gzhig par nus/ /drag po yi ni las byed na/ /zhag gcig smyung byas dur khrod du/ /khrag gi sbyin sreg byas na ni/ /des ni gdon dang mi rnams gzhig /de dag bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ /dang por zhag gsum smyung byas nas/ /mar gyi ngo ni bcu bzhi la/ /sum brgya lnga 9bcu skagatsang mas bzlas / /sngar bstan 'di dag byas na ni/ /de nas nges par gnyis gas kyang //tshig gis gang dang gang smras pa/ /bsam pa'i las ni byed par 'gyur/ /de ltar rtsed mo ldan pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor snying po mchog kyang bshad/ /'gro lding snying po gsum po yang 11/ /cho ga dag dang bcas par ni/ /las kyi dam pa 12thams cad dang / /de bzhin 'bring dang tha ma la/ /rdo rje rdzogs par khru gang 95—495

byas na/ /de nas rdo rje can yang mthong / /de nas gzhan yang stong gi phyed/ /ci ste gus pas 'dun 3)pas mchod/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen mngon sum du/ /mthong 'gyur de la the tshom (5med/ /mchod sbyin mchog gi gtso bo des/ /de la dam pa sbyin par 'gyur/ /yang na 'khor los sgyur nasab nyid/ /'dod pa gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga dang / /ji skad bshad pa'i slar gtang 4dang / /ji skad bshad pa'i las rnams kyang / /mjug 95tu legs par bya ba yin / /'gro lding gi cho ga dang bcas pa rdzogs so// //sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde'i bdag po chen po lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo / /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa na tsho ste/ de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde'i bdag po chen po lag na rdo rjes bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus (75mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs (8rinas/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar te dul ba mchog gi (gnas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis skye bo mang po la sman pa'i slad du bdag nyid kyi snying po 'jig rten dag la bshad lags te/ bdag gi snying po ni 'di lags so/ /gang gis snying po 'dis bdag bkug na de'i 1 thad du bdag myur du mchi 11bar 'tshal 'o ci ste bdag snying po 'dis bkug pa las ma mchis na 'jig rten las 12mtshams ma mchis par 1 bgyid cing dge 'dun gyi dbyen 7bgyid pa gang lags pa de dag gi skye gnas su mchi bar da'agyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bas na zhag gcig smyung bar bgyis pas bdag bkug na de las bcom ldan 'das kyis slar gtang tsha95wa 499

du gsol/ lag na rdo rjes de skad ces gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yid tsam 'dzum 1pa mdzad de 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten dag la khas 95)blangs pas khyod la nga mnyes kyis / /gnod sbyin gyi sde'i bdag po chen po (45khyod song song 5la dad pa dang ldan pa yi chad par snyom byed cig /de lta mod kyi nga yang khyod kyi snying po nyan par ni 'dod do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde'i bdag po chen po lag na rdo rjes gdong yid tsam phab nas 'dzem 7ribazhin du bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gi snying po cho ga dang bcas pa gsan du gsol/ 'di bsgrub par 'tshal zhing bcom ldan 'das la mchod par dga' bas yar gyi ngo tshes gcig la brtsams te zas su 'o ma dang phye'i 'de 8ku 'tshal te/ dus gsum du ba lang gi lci bas khrus bgyis 9 kyil/ gtsang mas gos gtsang 1 ma bgos nas bdug pa bsreg cing sku gdung dang ldan pa'i mchod rten nam11/ sku gzugs kyi mdun du mchod pa rgyas par bgyis la snying po brjod par bgyi ste/ gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag gis 12thog mar bdag nyid bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /na mo rat+na tra 1 ya su/ na mo mubadz+ra pā ṇi gesu/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā lopa ti su/ shrī nu aḥ 1 bha/ badz+ra pā ṇi 12ma ti 19shi ba mā 2 nā ya/a byo n+ya badz+ra a sha ni ra na maḥ 1 sarba gra ha 2duṣ+ṭa a pa ra ti 2 shu rak+ṣa yaṃ 2 ma na: a bha yā 5ka ri hi hi badz+ra pā ṇi hi hi he ha hi/ hi ri ku ku bu zhe/ hi ri ku pi sa ra sa ra 2 su bi 8ri tsi ri badz+ra pā ṇi 9 dunan+ta ṭ+wāṃ / da ma ka da ma da ma swā hā / lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis nas lag pa la btags na sems can thams cad kyis mi thub par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra 7ya su/ na mo badz+ra pā 95wa 500

ṇi 3)su/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 9 pa ti su/ e hi badz+ra pā ṇi/ i rda e bha ha na ma nu sma ra ma hā sbri (4ra badz+ra/ e hi su sbi mur badz+ra/ e hi na ma 'apā badz+ra/ e hi a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ e hi shī r+ghaṃ 7ma na tsa ba la ga ti ma hā yak+ṣa se nanā 9pa ti/badz+ra pā ṇi 0nyi hi he hi hi he hi hi he hi hi he hi hi 11he he/ ku tu ku tu ku 1 tu ku tu yi badz+ra pā ṇi e nyiñtsatsho/ hi hi he/ hi hi hi hi hi/ hi hi hi hi hi hi hi hi/badz+ra pā ṇi boku ku bu ku ku bu ku ku bu/sa ku bh+ya ku bh+ya/ ku ku bh+ya/ badz+ra pā ṇi/sa ra sa ra/ e bai ri/ e bai ri/ e bai ri/ e bai ri/1 ha ra ni li/ a ba ha ya mi ྅nyu8/ ma ma hi sa mā 19ye no pa tiṣ+ṭha 5 swā hā/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis tsho 1pa'i thang chu'i bdug pas spyan drang bar bgyi'o/ /na mo rat+na tra 32ya su/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi su/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa na ti su / hi ri hi ri ni/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ pra ti groṇ+ḍa/ ā hu ti/ pudz+dza dhū baṃ gan+dha mā 257/ ma tī /525 sa ma yo bha dhi sh+yi ti swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig bgyi ba dang /de dag gi me tog dbul ba lags te/ me tog rnams ci nas kyang sku gzugs kyi dbu la bab par gyen du gtor bar bgyi ste/ ba ru ra'i yam sreg shing brgyad brgya sbrang rtsi dang mar gyi nang du smyugs 28pas sbyin sreg 29bgyi'o/ /na mo rat+na tra ya su/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi su/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa 1ti su/ mu ne mu ne mu ne mu ne mu ne mu ne/ snye ri ma ti ma ti ma ti ma da hā ma ti su ma ti/ sma ra sa ma yaṃ badz+ra pā ṇi e rarnyi li sgu ti pha te phuḥ/ bhi li 5kyi ridziti/ tsi ri li ti ti ko t+t+waṃ ra la nyinyi 8)li si ri pa la ti/ ba di phu tsinyi 1/ ma re te phuḥ snye/ khu khu ti khu ti li li ti ri swā hā/ mu ne mu ne badz+ra pā ṇi/ gan+dha mā 5lha a nu le pa na ma 0pra tīts+tsha / ku tu li ku tu ku tu li swā hā/ tsa ti li rnaswā hā/ tu tu bha ri swā hā/95wa 501

bit+yā 1ma tu ti li swā hā/ a ra li ma ra li/ sha li ni badz+ra mā (geli ni/ bi lin+ti na / si ri li bi/ ghur+ṇa ghur+ṇa 4sharba sarba narba brah+ma/ bhasta purgya (5)narba sarba(9) / harba darba rarba tsarbarnga 7ska hā/ e hi shrī phroṃ 8)badz+ra pā (9༄ṇi he he ho hoyi/tu ru/ tu ru/ tu ru/ tu ru/ tu ru/ la hu la hu la hu la hu nyu1swā hā/ sma ra tai / nā 12ga ri/ yan+t+ra so1 / pra ti dz+nyā rtatsha/ bud+dha sa kā 7she/ ut+ta hre da 7ya/ mi ti ri ti/ mi ti ri ti/ ma ti ma ti ti ti/ la ri tu snaswā hā/ khu la lu lu khu khu ti lu ti swā hā/ e hi two ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa 18nyi/ hi li ri ri ti bh+yo / ma ri ki ri rdza sa ri dzam+bha/ shu ri tsi ti/zhe/ tsu ru tsu ru tsu ru/zhu ) li ti swā hā / narba sharba bharba khu khu lu khu khu 21ti ti swā hā/ tu ru tu ru sma ra rta( rnye/ pra ti 〉(22 / badz+ra pā ṇi swā hā/ ha la ha lā ya swā hā/ ku lu ku lā ya swā hā/ ka la ka lā ya swā hā/ tī li tī lā ya swā hā/dge ma hā kri li tī lā ri lhaya swā hā/ gro dha tī li tī lā ya swā hā/5 tri pa ta khri li tī lā 28ya swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa tī li khri lā ya 2tsheswā hā / badz+ra tī li tī lā ri ya swā hā/ badz+ra dha rā sa1ya swā hā/ badz+ra bhañdza 6rteya swā hā/badz+ra pā ṇa ri ye swā hā/ hi li mi li ni li/ o sum+bha sum+bha/ phu ru phu ru saṃ bhañdza nā so ma bha be bh+yaḥ 5swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das snying po 'di ni las thams cad bgyid pa lags te/ don thams cad la gzhan gyis mi thub cing don mchis pa dang / zhi ba dang / zhi bar bgyi ba dang / dgra 'joms shing dmigazhan gyis mi tshugs pa ri lags te/ thang chu dang / sra rtsi'i ristepog dang / pog dkar po dang / a ga 9ru'i bdug pa bsreg cing brjod par bgyi'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni snga ma nyid de/ ha ri ha ri ṇi / 1badz+ra pā ṇi/ su.udha 2/ ha sa rin swā hā/khi ri khi cir zhes smos pas dgod par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na 45sdo yā ya/ na mo 95—502

hi li mu li li mu badz+ra pā ṇi tsu ru tsu ru/ dzalpa dzalpa (15swā hā/ bdug pa de dag nyi 90shu dag dang sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /na mo rat+na tra sgyu )ya su/ hi li ha ri badz+ra pā ṇi pa ti su/ sidha (4/bhasto ( smi swā hā/ ba dan dmar po phyar te dbul bar bgyi'o / /lag na rdo rje'i snying po 'di ni sems can thams cad la bde ba'i phyir las thams cad byed pa yin no/ /lag na rdo rje'i snying po rdzogs so// //sngar bshad blon mo 65'bar ba gang / /de dag kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /'dod pa yi ni rdo rje ma/ /'bar ba de ni bshad par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lag na rdo rje dang / 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 7la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan du yod pa'o/ /de nas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug rig sngags 'chang (8dang bcas par bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rig sngags byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /tshobacom ldan 'das bdag gis 7rig sngags kyi blon mo zhes bgyi ba de bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis bshad par 'tshal na/dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen 11ma rnams la tu sman par 'gyur ba dang / rtsed mo dang las thams cad bgyid pa dang / las thams cad bsgrub pa'i slad du bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug nga'i nyan thos dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma 'dod chags dang ldan pa dag yod de/ de dag gi bar du gcod par 'gyur gyis thong 1lhashigang /de ltar rki'adod pa'i dbang phyug gis tshalan gsum gyi bar du bcom ldan 95—503

'das la gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong dang 'di/dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma 'dod chags dang ldan pa ma 2mchis pa de dag la rig sngags kyi rtsed nanomor 'gyur na/ bdag gi de bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rtag tu zham ring can 'dug cing g.yon phyogs na gnas pa/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la gzigs so/ /de nas gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la bltas 5cinas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba'i phyir rig sngags de shod cig shod cig /de nas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dga' zhing mgu la yi (phyirangs te/rab tu dga' nas dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te de'i tshe rig sngags 'di bshad do/ / stad ya 7tho dan/ i ti 8yo pa pa ri9)ti saspa 'iti bha ya ni/ tsi li ta ni tsa/ yo 1 ta na dharma ma bi dza ni 1 ti pra ban+tu rna/2/ a ti kra rna tai be+e sam de ba nā ma se na ti bosarba sid+dha tsa yo gi ni/ ye na sin+t+ra lan/ bha ga bī/ shā 1 sta lo ke a nut+ta 1 ra/ a te na saṃ traṃ bā 19tsa ne na/ a yi ma bitru sa mu )dza sa ma 21yu bi da / khi ni khi ni/ kuṇ+ḍa ril mu khu ki swā hā/ ku tiñdza re ku tiñdza ye/tam+bu le/ sum̐ de rku phe 2 ba ste/ pra 25se a ga ste baṃ ga ti sa0ni pa ka sidha kurma bi nā sha ni ya ya rkarma 2 ma hā sra 9ni/ pra yuk+ta ni ba na ye ta/ kṛ tai ya ma/in+d+ra ga ni/ masgri ṇa/ tsit+ta ro ri sha ba/ tsa tu'i da sha na su kṛ tai kun+da/tsūr+ṇa yo go ba di ye 5te/ su hro dra dre/ ṭ+wāṃ skṛ 54da yaṃ/ ba sham+bi/ bstsa ṣ+ṭṛ da ya/ bi bye shwa na rte/ dzam+bha rna/ stam+bha rna/ mo ha rna/ tsa ka ri shī ti/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī bsgo dzā/ bi te pra yuk+ta /mū la kurma su pā jisnyeta r+pā su rā padzā na tsi 7ba 95wa 504

sarba me 0)da ni kā 95)ra yed da( no/ e ka ut+ta 4)ba 5)ne to/ de 56 na ri ba ra bi nā 7sha ne sarba kurma ri bir+ya (8)de marda dat+ta/ pā she r+sānye99)/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ma te gau 1 re / bir+ya rā dzā 41a nut+ta ra32/ oṃ dzasgyu tsho ya swā hā/ stasgyu geya swā hā/ mo hā d+kuya swā hā/ mā tsolnga ya swā hā/ ya 1 mā ya swā hā/ ya ma ma mā ya yinaswā hā/ badzā ya yi swā hā/ ma hā badzā ciya swā hā/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ badz+ra pā ṇa na ye swā hā/badz+ra hastu ya swā hā/ badzo sa gra hastu 22ya swā hā/ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa 2 ciya swā hā/ badzo gra daṇ+ḍa ya swā hā/ bi shwa pā ṇa dgele swā hā/ na maḥkā ri me shwa ra badz+ra pā ṇa 2 ye swā hā/rig sngags 'dod pa'i rdo rje ma/ /'di ni rlung gi shugs zhes bya/ /'dod pa'i khams ni kun gyi mchog /rig sngags rgyal mo bla na med/ /'dod pa'i khams gnas ci yang rung / /'dod pa'am 'dod pa zhig bar rung / /rab tu bsgrubs na de dag ni/ /don du mi sgrub na gang yang med/ /las kyi dam pa ji bzhin dang / /khyad par dang ni bsgrub pa'i mchog /de nyid thog mar bshad par bya/ /rang byung la ni phyag byas nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub shing drung du/ /shar phyogs blta 36zhing 'dug par bya/ /kur ni ka ra'i me tog dang / /de ni btso ma'i gser mdog 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni g.yas logs su/ /rigs mchog rab sbyin shes nyen can/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug rma bya yi 1/ /mgrin pa bzhin du sngo bar bri/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni g.yon logs su/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin chen ni/ /sprin dmar mdog 'dra 'od dang bcas/ /dpal mchog pad+mar bzhugs pa rdo bri/ /de nas mar gyi brgyad la brtsamasar / /nas kyi zas bza' dus sum cu/ /dus gsum du ni bsgrim bya zhing / /cho ga 'di ni rtag tu bya / /me tog dkar po sngon po dang / /dmar po dang ni rnam pa gsum/ /95wa 505

blangs te gnas der zhugs nas ni/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod par bya/ /der ni lnga bcu gcig bzlas pas/ /tshes grangs bcu gnyis bar du yang / /dkar po sangs rgyas bsnun par bya/ /sngon pos 'dod pa'i dbang phyug la/ /pad+ma dmar po la sogs pas/ /lag na rdo rje bsnun pas kyang / /zhag gsum khrus byas gso sbyong ldan/ /bcwa 1lnga yi ni gtsang ma yis/ /lha bshos sna tshogs kun tu dgram//du naruska dang a ga daru/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni bdug mchog bsreg /thang chu'i snod ni tha dad gzhag /lag na rdo rje gu gul dbul/ /sangs rgyas rig sngags rdo rje 'dzin/ /slob dpon la ni gus mchod bya/ /de nas sems ni bsdus zhi rinas kyang / /mchod pa dag ni rgyas par bya/ /bden pa bzhi ni ston pa pos/ /me tog dkar po bcom ldan la/ /bzhi brgya'am brgyad brgya (5)dam pa yis/ /bzlas shing bzlas shing bsnun par bya/ /sngo ba'i nang na mdog sngon mchog /sum brgyas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug la/ /dmar ba'i ri rinang na mdog dmar mchog /sum brgyas rdo rje 'dzin la bsnun ri/ /bsrung ba la ni khri lam 8du/ /zla gcig brgyad brgya bzlas brjod bya/ /bsgrub pa thog ma tha mar yang / /skud pa nag pos bcing 9bar bya/ /ba 'iti bi da ra 11rak+ṣa dha re rak+ṣanyu2/ ma hā dha ni rak+ṣa / ta thā ga ta sa ha dzā ha ta rak+ṣa/ put+pa 7ke tu rak+ṣa/ a pa ta rak+ṣa swā hā/rtsa ba'i skud sapa gtsang 7byas nas/ /bsgrub pa de ltar bsrung byas la /mtshams bcad pa ni 'dis byas na/ /mtshams bcad kun gyi nyu8mchog tu 'gyur / /dha ni ka ni 19n+ta ne ke 2 ni sarba sī ma ban+dha 21ni swā hā/ mtshams bcad 2kyi ni me 'di yang / /brgyad brgya bzlas sam yang na ni/ /de bzhin tshon /skud sna tshogs kyis/ /gnas rnams kun tu bskor bar bya/ /dngos grub bsgrub cing 95wa 506

nor 'dod pas/ /dngos grub ltas ni blta ba'i phyir/ /rig sngags rgyal dbang grub rnams kyi0)/ /bsgrub pa'i tshig 95)ni bzlas brjod bya/ /a gi de sā dha ya a mo ghi sā pyadha ya/ sa pa le sa dhā 5)ya ut+pa de sasat+ya 6)ge prasto u pa sha ṇi sā dha 7ya swā hā/ /de nas rig sngags sgrub pa na/ /mtshan ma dag ni rtogs par bya/ /sku gdung ldan pa'i sku gzugs de/ /nyi ma bzhin du 'bar bar 'gyur/ /dad dang mchod pa'i nyes pa dang / /rig sngags nyams pa'i nyes pa yis/ /ci ste der na nam grub na/ /yar gyi ngo la'ang bsgrub par bya/ /dad dang mchod dang cho ga yis/ /de bzhin rdzogs par brtsam 59par bya/ /dus gsum gtsang sbra rdzogs bya zhing / /nas kyi kha zas dus su bza'7/ /bzlas brjod 'dun 11pas mtshan ma gsum/ /ma byung bar du bzlas brjod bya/ /sangs rgyas zhal nas an+da tsho rnyil/ /yang na mthon ka chen po 'byung / /'dod pa'i dbang phyug kha nas kyang / /bzang po lha dkyil 'khor steng du lhung / /lag na rdo rje'i kha nas kyang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i dbyig rnams 'byung 1 / /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba yi/ /nor bu legs sdug mgo la gdags/ /'dod na g.yas pa'i mkhrig 15mar yang / /cho ga bzhin du gdags par bya/ /sa dang nam mkha' snang byed cing / /'khor los sgyur 7ba gzhan bzhin 'gyur/ /nor bu'i mthus ni 'jigs byed cing / /rig sngags grub 1 mthus stobs chen 'gyur/ /des ni mun par 'jigs 1 byed cing / /rgya mtsho chen por 'jigs pa med/ /'dod pa dag la mchod par 'gyur/ /rig sngags mchog bsgrubs skyabs kyi mchog /de yang rin chen spyod kun gyi/ /nang na tshugs par nus pa med/ /mu stegs rnams kyis kun rig bzhin/ /ji ltar dbang phyug 'dod la 19spyod/ /'dod pa 95—507

lhag ma de bzhin du/ /rig pa'i rgyal po mchog bsgrub ste/ /'dod la mngon du spyod par 'gyur/ /ci ste dad cing gus pa dang / /lag na rdo rje cho ga shes/ /de yang rdo rje 'dzin bzhin du/ /'jig rten gsum na 'jigs med rgyu/ /dbyig rnams dang ni dong tse 1dag /'phags pa la las bsgrub na yang / / gnyis ka 2des bsgrubs 'jigs pa med/ /bde can dag dang ldan pa dang / /nag mo che dang ldan pa des/ /mngon du yid bzhin nor bu 'chang / /grong khyer rgyal po bzhin du 'thob / /bya ba mang las brten pa dang / /rnam pa mang po sna tshogs pa/ /mang po 'di dag ci smos te/ /mdo tsam 'di ni mnyan par gyis/ /'dod pa yi cani rdo rje ma/ /'di ni las kun bsgrub pa ste/ /blon mo (5)rnams kyi dam pa'i mchog /las rnams kun la don yod pa/ /ci ste yid la 'dod pa yitsi / /dngos grub bde mchog dgongs na yang / /bya ba'i don kun grub pa yi7 / /'dod pa'i rdo rje ma nyid bsgrub/ /rtag tu rang dgar bde ba sbyin/ /rang dgar 'gro ba'i gzhi 8yang yin/ /rang dgar rtse zhing spyod pa yang 9ri/ /'chang ba la sogs rang dgar 'gyur/ /'di ni spro ba'i ngang can la/ / nams kyang 1 rgyab kyis 11phyogs mi 'gyur/ /bsgrub pa de yang 'joms mi byed/ /'bras bu med par mi 'gyur la/ /bgegs kyang byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor las ni nyams gyur dang / /dam tshig 12dag kyang spangs pa dang / /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin mchog sogs1 / /ma dad rnams la grub sgomi 'gyur/ /de phyir dkon mchog gsum po dang / /de bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /rig sngags rang gi bla ma la/ /gus byas mchod cing bsgrub par bya/ /bsgrub pa dag ni ma byas kyang / /rtsa ba'i rig sngags stobs ldan pa/ /las rnams stong dag 95—508

'grub nyu)byed pa/ /gang yin de dag shes par gyis/ /kri na)ka ma la ka yi 3shing //yam sreg shing ni brgya rtsa brgyad/ /gtsang ma'i phyogs su me sbar te/ /cho ga dag 4)ni rgyas par bya/ /zhag bdun bar du dus gsum du/ /de bzhin bzlas brjod brgyad brgya bya/ /mar bcas 'o thug sbrang rtsir ldan/ /me mchog sbyin sreg byas na ni/ /'dis ni rgyal po'am yang na ni/ /'khor los sgyur 5ba'ang dbang gyur na/ /rgyal srid dag la phan pa yi/ /rgyal po'i 'khor lta ci zhig smos / /lan tshwa las ni gzugs byas nas/ /rkang pa nas brtsams 6sbyin sreg bya / /cho ga des ni bud med dang / /skyes pa dbang du 'gugs 7par 'gyur/ /bu mo yi ni gzugs byas nas/ /rkang pa nas brtsams sbyin sreg bya/ /cho ga des ni 8)bud med rnams/ /dbang du bya ba bstan pa yin99/ /lo ma'i sbrang ma'i dpung byas nas/ /yungs 1 tshokar me tog bsregs pa yis/ /de bzhin zhag bdun dus gsum du/ /rab tu bsgrims te mchod par bya/ /de ni yungs kur me tog gis/ /zhag bdun bar du bsgrubs na ni/ /lan bdun bzlas pa 'grub rtso1'gyur te/ /lo ma'i sbrang ma 'phro 12bar 'gyur/ / cho ga 1 dag ni mchog dang ni/ /de bzhin man ta ka blangs nas/ /bzlas brjod brgyad brgya bzlas bya zhing / /thog mar legs par mchod byas nas/ /gang gi ming ni brjod pa de / /skad cig gis ni dbang du 'gyur/ /de bzhin cho ga byas nas ni/ /nan ta ka ni phyi nas blang ska/ /a ga tsharu dang tsan+dan dang / /ma ru pa ka rlon pa blang / /dri la sogs pa de dag gis/ /khrus byas skye bo thams cad dgra/ /thog mar mchod pa la sogs pa/ /byed cing byed cing zhag bdun du/ /dus gsum brgyad brgya bzlas brjod bya/ /phyi nas mkhas pas khrus kyang bya/ /mar gyi ngo ni 95wa 509

bcu bzhi la/ /bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byas na/ /rgyal pos de la mchod par bya/ /bong nga yi ni rtsa ba yang / /byang phyogs blta 91)zhing brko bar bya/ /de nas de yi nashun lpags ni/ /mar gyi ngo yi ri4)bcu bzhi la/ /phye mar byas nas bzlas brjod bya5/ /de bzhin brgyad brgya bzlas nas ni/ /phur mar (6)byas te bcang bar bya/ /bud med la ni des (7)gtor na/ /de ma thag tu dbang du 'gyur / /thams cad dbye bar bya ba ni/ /nim pa'i yal ga na bsreg bya zhing / /'di dang 'di gnyis rtsod gyur cig /ces bya cho ga gsang ba yin/ /de las phyir gso dam pa ni/ /gsang sngags 'dis ni bkru bar bya/ /dri la sogs pas snying nas mchod/ /bzlas brjod brgyad brgya byas na ni/ /byad stems 94nodagrol ba'i mchog yin te/ /ci dga' bar ni brtsam bya zhing / /zhag bdun bar du bsgrubs na ni/ /mi song 'jigs med 'bab par nyu 'gyur/ /kuṇ+ḍa 67pi lu li gcig dang / /ske 1 tshe'i 'bru dang lan tshwa dang / /nim pa'i 'bru dang ras bal gyi / /sa bon de dag sbyin sreg bya/ /'di nas gzhan du che ge mo/ / song shig bros shig 15med gyur cig /ces ni ming yang brjod byas na/ /'gro 'gyur 'di la the tshom ngamed/ /de las slar ni gso ba dang / /bzhag par byas na lan bdun du/ /de la bsrung ba mchog byas na/ /gnas su dga' bar byed par 'gyur / /pa ta la yi 15lo ma dang / /bel ba 'dzam bu a mra dang / /skyu ru ra la sogs pa yis/ /skal chung de ni khrus byas na/ /skal dang ldan par byed pa'i mchog /gos 'dod pa sha'i me tog rnams/ /sbyin sreg byas na gos rnams thob / /hiṇ+ḍa slone mu li ki rnams/ /sbyin sreg byas na sna dbyig rnams 'phel/ /gser 'dod pas ni su baṇ+ḍa na/ /tshul bzhin sbyin sreg byas na 'thob/ /gser 95wa 510

bsgrub pa yi 3)nang na ni/ /cho (5)ga 'di ni mchog tu bshad/ /'dod pa'i rdo rje ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// //de nas rdo rje 'og pag (85can/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi snying po ste/ /'phrog ma zhes kyang rab grags te / /'bar ba de ni bshad par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin sde'i bdag po lag na rdo rje gsum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lngas rtsen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin mo chen mo 'phrog ma 5rdo rje'i 'og pag 67can rigs thams cad dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gnod sbyin thams cad kyi snying po brjod par bya yis7)/ khyed kun nga la nyon cig /mthong na don yod zhi ba dang / /gsum mchog blta na mi bzad dang / /'byung po thams cad rab zhi byed/ /lag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /nor gyi bdag po rnam ri thos bu/ /gnod sbyin kun gyi mnga' bdag rje/ /gnod sbyin gang dag ri la gnas/ /sa ti ri dang ri bo che/ /zho gdong dang ni gdong rgyas dang / /'dod pa'i don sbyin gnod sbyin gang / /mtshon cha 'thab cha sna tshogs can/ /stobs ldan rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ba dang / /pad+ma dkar dang dgra 'joms dang / /rgyan phreng 9rgyas dang rgyan phreng che/ /bdud rtsi snying rje snying rje 1 grong / /gnod sbyin chen po lngas rtsen dang / /gnod sbyin na la ku be ra/ /nor bu'i sul can gnod sbyin gang / /nor bu bzang zhes grags pa dang / /rdzogs ldan dang ni rdzogs bzangs 11dang / /rab tu bzang dang bzang po nyid/ /bdag gi snying pos bkug pas na/ /de dag thams cad 'dir gshegs 12shig /95—511

ma smos gnod sbyin de dag dang / /bdag gi don grub 1de dag dang / /rtag tu dge dang phan byed dang / /gnod sbyin gdon ni skyed na byed dang / /gnod sbyin mo ni 'phrog ma mo/ /bu mangs la khyod ni 'dir shog shigazhar /gzugs chen ldan zhing stobs che ba'i/ /bu de dag kyang 'dir shog shig6) /khyod ni rtag tu gnod sbyin dang / / bu yi 7'khor dang lhan cig tu/ /lag na rdo rjes rab bskul bas/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub par gyis(8ri/ / dgra yi 59)phyogs dang mdza' khobo'i phyogs/ /de bzhin rgyal po sa gang dang / /nags dang brag khrod rdzong rnams dang / /g.yul du rgyal bar bya ba dang / /rgyas pa yi ni las rnams dang / /rtsod pa dang ni 'thab pa dang / /bsrung ba'i las dang dbang bsgrub dang / /bag ma dag ni len pa la/ /lag na rdo rjes bshad pa bzhin/ /rdo rje dbyug sogs lhan cig tu/ /dam pa 'chang ba'i 11'og pag 12mas/ /don rnams thams cad myur 1 te gyis/ / stad ya the 1 dan/ a ma le/ bi ma le/nir ma le/ rma 15ga l+ya los hi te/ ha na ha na/ sa ra sa ra/ a sha 1 ne be ga 1 nā ma tiṣ+ṭha 19'o dzā dru 2 ti/ de ba dru 21ti/ yak+ṣa dru na ti/ badz+ra dru na ti/sarba gra ha nā sha ni 2 sha t+t+waṃ 25pra marda 27ni badz+ra dru 2 ti i rda/ kurbu ri 2nyi badz+re sā dā ya 29ār+ya ma ma pa re shaṃ dhu bha ga kār+ya ma bhi dusbyi ka dumu khe dumu ri 1kha da me ma ma/sha tra bo nā tha bhan+dha bi dza ye pabi dza da yo me bha ba ra tu/ a pa rā dzi te/ a shepa rā 9dza yo me bha ba tu ba la ba la/ brnyo s+t+waṃ bā ri1mi ma ti dhi ti 2marnyo bha ba ni rige.a ma le rma ga phye 5/ ma re hi haṃ ༷bi ma phye/ na she ha haṃ rma ga phye / ma re hi 8haṃ bi ma phye 9/ na she hi haṃ dan+ta 5 da 5 kurma darnyo rinahi da na la ghu pā sha ni pra she hi haṃ/sarba rā dzā dā ra bi rā ri dzā ni a pa rā 5 ridzi ti/ sar+pā 55yak+ṣa hro da ya brta ni ni/95—512

a ba yā 1 mi bā pi tsa a nu sa ra sa ra sarba yak+ṣa ṣ+ṭṛ da yā ri ni a bi ri ba pi tsa so ni so ni54)/ sa ra sa ra/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ a yā na/ ya na saṃ tsa la ni/sarba yak+ṣa skṛ da yā 5 ni/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa ri/ bhañtsa bhañtsa / bha na bha na/ mu ru mu ru/ tu ru tu ru/ bha ba bha ba/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ 8kurma dru 9) ma ma kurma/ pra bhi 1 sha /sarba sarba sā dha ni/ sarba arba sā dha ma me sā dha 11ya/ i dañtsa 15me/ kār+ya 1 ku ru ku ru 1 swā hā/ rig sngags rdo rje 'og pag 8can/ /gnod sbyin kun gyi snying po ste/ /'phrog ma zhes kyang rab grags pa / /shes ldan de ni bshad pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni las mthong dang / /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa byas pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga tshade bzhin du/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor mchog mchod nas/ /nyin zhag gcig tu smyung bar bya/ /yang na zhag gsum smyung byas la/ /gtsang mas gtsang ma'i sa phyogs su/ /gnod sbyin dkyil 'khor rab gsal bri/ /yang na zhag gi ngo gnyis las/ /gang 'dod pa yi 1 mtshan ma ni/ /gru bzhi lham pa sgo bzhir ldan/ /khru bcu pa la dbyibs legs pa/ /sangs rgyas dbu gsum shar phyogs gzigs/ /yang na chos kyi dkyil 'khor bri/ / de yi 12g.yon phyogs rig sngags kyi19/ /stobs 'chang lag na rdo rje bri/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni g.yas logs su/ /nor gyi dbang phyug gnod sbyin bcas/ /de dag mdun du 'phrog ma ni/ /'og pag rig sngags sna tshogs mchog /de yi rig sngags tshogs kun ni/ /g.yas phyogs ngos su gnas par bya/ /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung / /dri za mchog gi dpung gis 21bskor/ /shar phyogs sgor ni 22rab gnas shing / /nub phyogs su ni blta bar bya/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ /grul bum mchog gi dpung gis 95—513

bskor / /lho phyogs sgo yi nang na gnas/ /lho phyogs nas ni byang du lta1)/ /rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang / /klu dag dang ni nam mkha' lding / /mchog rnams kyi ni mdun du 'dug /nub phyogs nas ni shar du lta75)/ /rgyal po chen po ku be ra/ /gnod sbyin mchog gi dpung gis bskor/ /byang phyogs kyi ni sgo na gnas / /lho phyogs phyogs su blta 4bar bya/ / kho ra khor (5)yug thams cad nas / /gdon rnams brgyad brgyas bskor bar bya/ /me rnams kyang ni shin tu dgod / /bshos rnams kun tu dgram par bya/ /de nas gnod sbyin gtor ma yang / /sha bcas dkyil 'khor nang du dgram/ /mar me la sogs dri rnams dang / /me tog 'bras bu kun gyis bskor/ /de ltar byas na rig sngags che/ /rgyal mo yi ni dam pa 'di/ /bzlas brjod byed na bshos rnams dang / /bdug pa dri la 6sogs pa dbul/ /bzlas brjod bsnyen pa grangs med par/ /bzlas brjod bya zhing kun nas mchod/ /bdug pa thams cad nang du bsreg /bzlas brjod brgyad brgya bkra shis pa/ /mkhas pas sngon du byas na (7)ni/ /de nyid bsrung ba'i mchog yin no/ /de nyid rab tu bsgrub pa yin/ /phyogs bcing ba nayang de nyid de/ /de nas 'di yi 9rabazlas brjod rnams/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni bzlas pa na / /bsgrub pa'i 'phrog ma 'gul 11ba dang / /sa gzhi dag kyang g.yo bar 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin rnam pa sna tshogs dag /kun nas der ni snang bar 'gyur/ /g.yo zhing sgra 'byin lta 12bar byed/ /rab tu 'du zhing nyida'aphungs pa dang / /'jigs pa'i gzugs rnams mthong 'gyur zhing / /gzugs so cog ni du mar ston/ /de ni de yis nga'ajigs mi bya/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni drung dag tu/ /rig sngags tshogs ni bzlas brjod bya/ /rig sngags rgyal 95—514

po rab 'bar ba/ /rdo rje 'og pag rnams bsgrubs 1)pa/ /de tshe bdag nyid 'ong bar 'gyur/ /de mthong de ni sde ponadang bcas/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /gzhon nu la sogs gnod sbyin gyi/ /tshogs mchog kun gyis de la mchod / /gnod sbyin bzhin du'ang rgyu ba dang / /ji bzhin stobs dang ldan par rgyu/ /de srid du ni mkha' la 'gro/ /yang na tshe dpag med par gnas/ /dkyil 'khor mngon par mchod nas ni/ /rnam pa kun gyis rig sngags bzlas/ /ma grub na yang gdon la sogs/ /las rnams thams cad byed par nus/ /yid dang tshig tsho rigis bzlas byas nas( )/ /don rnams rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /thams cad kyang ni bsgrub par nus/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod sbyin sreg dang / /mchod pa kun dang mnyam gzhag dang / /rtag tu mchod pa dga' ba yis/ /don rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje 'og pag (5)can gyi cho ga rdzogs cas / //de nas sngags 'chang kun gyis mchod/ /lag na rdo rje'i sras gtum pa6/ /rdo rje'i sde ni stobs po che/ /mthong na don yod zhi ba po/ /gtum po rdo rje 'dzin dga' ba/ /'bar ba chen po mchod 7sbyin mchog /don kun grub dbyed bshad par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra ya 9su/ na mo ma khohā satwa su/ satwa satwa 11su/a ti ba la su/ a pra me tshaya ba la su lha/ badz+ra se nā ya su/ badz+ra kā nga ma da su/tu ru tu ru/ badz+ra se nā ya swā hā/ ku ru ku ru ma hā se nā ya swā hā/ hu ru hu ru/sarba satwa/ pū dzi mitā tshaya swā hā/ su ru su ru/ satwa kā 1 ma tā 18ya swā hā/mu ru mu ru ma hā pu 19ru ṣā 2 ya swā hā/ ma hā se nā 21pa ta ye/ sarba rkarma dā 2 95wa 515

ya swā hā/ sarba dza ya dza ya dā ya swā hā/ sarba sirnyi sirnyi 1nidā ya swā hā/ sarba dā na dā ni dan pra dā ya swā hā/ badz+ra se nā ya swā hā/ a pra me ya ku nā ya (gyiswā hā/sarba ba ti satwa pū dzi 5tā ya swā hā/ pra ti griṇ+ḍi māṃ (5skurak+ṣa māṃ (6)sarba kā ma da(chu/sarba kā nam ma me pū 9r+sha ya swā hā/ / 'di yi ngocho ga bshad par bya/ /ngas bshad de ni mnyan 11par gyis12/ /cho ga bzhin du rdo rje sde/ /ri mo'i gzugs ni brgya 1 byas nas/ /bdug 1 pa'i mchod pas mchod bya zhing / /bsgrims te rtag tu bzlas brjod bya/ /sku gdung ldan pa'i mchod rten nam/ /gang na sku gdung yod pa der/ /ci nus kyis ni rab bsgrims 7te/ /sngar ni bsnyen pa 'di dag bya/ /de nas zla phyed yang na gcig /yang na zhag ni bdun yang rung / /dus gsum khrus byas dkar gsum bza'/ /mnyam gzhag rtag tu bzlas brjod bya/ /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad ldan pas/ /nas kyi kha zas dus gsum bza'/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag dus gsum du/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni bzlas brjod bya/ /der ni mar gyi mar me gnyis/ /ma shi bar ni gzhag par bya / /phyi nang gzhag pa'i smyung ba bya/ /zla ba nya la rab bsgrims te/ /bza' dang btung ba mang po yis/ /lha bshos mnyam par gzhag pas dbul/ /cho ga dam pas bsrung bya zhing / /cho ga brten tshapa nges 1 byas nas/ /rdo rje'i 18sdo ni stobs po che/ /lan grangs brgya stong bzlas brjod bya/ /de nas stobs chen rdo rje sde/ /de la yang ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /yid la ci dang ci 'dod pa'i/ /don rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /nad kun yang ni kyi sel byed cing / /'dod pa tham sa cad sbyin par byed/ /yungs kur nas dang lan tshwa dang / /shu ti dang ni nye'u shing dang / /pri 2 yaṅku dang shu dag rnams/ /mnyam par 95—516

gzhag pas zhag bdun du/ /seng ldeng mdag (17ma dud med la/ / de yi dming smos sbyin sreg bya/ /zhag bdun bar du lan cig ni/ /dus gsum du ni brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sbyin sreg rab tu legs byas na/ /skal /chung gis kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /tshul 'dis sbyin sreg byas na ni/ /sems can kun kyang 'khrugs 4par 'gyur/ /don gang yid la bzhag nas ni/ /stobs chen 'di ni bsgrub byas na/ / de yi 5)las de 65byed 'gyur te/ /'di la dpyad par bya ba med/ /cho ga gzhan yang rtag tu yid la lan gsum bzlas brjod byas te/ bsrung ba yang lan gsum bzlas brjod byas nas/ gang 'dod pa de bslangs 7na thob par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa thams cad brjod pas 'grub par 'gyur te/ 'di ni de'i rtsa ba'i bsgrub pa yin no(8/ /zhag gsum smyung bar byas te9/ yar gyi ngo tshes bcu gsum la mchod rten gyi 1 7drung du ba ser mo'i lci ba las gnod sbyin gyi gzugs byas la/ sna ma'i me tog gi phreng ba phyogs bzhir spyan drangs nas/gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma dang / tsan+dan dkar 1rtapo dang / ka 1 ra bī 1 ra dmar po dang / rnam pa sna tshogs gzhan dag gis kyang sku gzugs mchod par byas la/gu gul tshadang / a ga 7ru dang / du ruska'i tshabadug pa bsregs shing / mar me dang / dri dang me tog gi phreng bas mchod pa rgyas par byas nas/ dus gsum du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ yar gyi ngo tshes 1 gcig la brtsams te tshes brgyad dang / bcu bzhi'am/ nya'i 1 bar du dus gsum du grangs med par bzlas brjod byas na don grub 19par byed do/ /rdo rje sde'i 2 snying po rdzogs so// //95—517

na mo budhe /bh+yaḥ/ ma hā pu natsu sha /ka bhe bh+yaḥrinas/ na maḥsarba lo ka pa bha bisnu be/ khri shwa rā ri a masta yak+ṣa se nā 5)pa ta 56)ye pra bar dā 97)ya/ ma hā satā (8)ya a na ni ni 59 dā nā 1 ya ma hā dak+ṣi tī yā 11ya sarba/ bo dhi satā (snyerna/ pra ba ra tsā tsho pra ba ra/ yi mi tre brta 7ya ba rilha maya/ sarba satā tshan ma skṛ nyu ta/ pū dzi 1 tā 197ya ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta na tshon/ badz+ra se nā (7ya ba ( 2ru/ be gu gezu bu ru bu ru / mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ du ru du ru/ hu ru hu ru ya/ hu ru hu ru/badz+ra se nā ya swā hā/ ma hā se nā ya swā hā/ sarba kā ma dā zhugaya swā hā/ sarba su kha dā 20ya swā hā/ sarba arba sā dha 2 nā ya swā hā/ sarba kurma kā ( snyem ba ra ba ra dā ya 29su hā/ na mo badz+ra se nā yastu sa1se nā ru ya/ ma hā se nā ya/ sarba kā ma dā g.ya/ sarba su kha dā ya/ sarba at+pa sā dha sa nā ya swā hā/ saṃ 39sgo shati dṛ nā bha ya ti ye swā hā/ bṛ go 8sha sum̐ ne ga ra de/ ba dā zhu ya swā hā/ rādz+nyā mā kur+sha na maḥ e ༷r+sha ḍā ya swā 1hā/ pra ti groṇ+ḍa nā nyam ma lharak+ṣa/ na maḥ ri risarba kurma da rib ra da 0/ sarba kā ri ma ma me pū rā naya/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa i rda 9me kā: sā 5 dha ya ri swā hā/ sa phyogs gtsang ma'am/ bdag gi khyim du ras ma nyams pa la tshon rtsi spyin med pas rdo rje sde bri bar ri bya ste/ gzhon nu'i gzugs 'chang ba gser gyi mdog can rgyan phreng dang / do shal dang / dpung rgyan dang / cod pan dang / rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan ri pa pad+ma rtsa ba ne byedamar po'i steng na 'dug ste/ lag pa 55g.yon pa na pad+ma bsgreng ni ste 'dzin/ lag pa g.yas pa dbugs 'byin pa'i tshul du 'dug pa bri/ /de'i steng du 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o/ /mya ngan las 5 'das pa ni zhi ba'o zhes rtogs 95—518

pa brjod pa rnams bri bar bya'o/ /de nas yar gyi ngo 1tshes gcig la brtsam 5zhing bsgrub par bya ste/ des de'i drung du dri thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor byugs 5kyil me tog dri zhim po dang / bdug pas mchod nas bstod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /mar gyi mar me gnyis kyang dbul bar bya ste/ gcig ni sangs rgyas la/ gcig ni gzhon nu la dbul lo/ /dus gsum du sbyin sreg sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis tsho4)bya zhing 'o ma dang / bu ram sbyar ba dang / zho dang bu ram sbyar ba dbul bar bya'o/ /til zan dang 'byung po'i zas kyi gtor ma yang sbyin no / /zas su 'o ma'am phye'i 'de chi5)gu'am/ 'o ma rjen pa'i 'de 'gu za zhing /nas dang / yungs kur dang / shu ti 7dang / nye'u 8shing dang / shu dag dang / pri lasku dang / lan tshwa dang / til rnams cha bsnyams 9te btags pa'i phye mas sbyin sreg byas na zhag bdun pa'i nyin par bsod nams chung 1 ngu la yang lung nges par ston par byed do/ /phyi de nyin 11par yang kha zas mi bza' zhing grangs nges pa med par bzlas brjod bya'o/ /bzlas brjod byas pas thams cad bsrung /rtab la sogs pa byed do/ /cho ga gzhan yang mar gyi ngo zhag bcu bzhi la kha zas mi bza' bar byang chub kyi shing drung du ba rog mo'i lci ba sa la ma lhung 1ribs rdo rje'i gzugs byas te kha nub phyogs su bltas nas 'byung 1 po'i gtor ma byas la/ me tog dri zhim po phul te/ mar gyi mar me gnyis kyang mtshan mo sbar la / shar phyogs su kha bltas lote 'dug nas/ thog mar shu ti dang / nye'u shing tshadang / yungs kur dang / nas rnams mar dang sbyar ba'i sbyin sreg lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas gu gul 1 dang / bil ba dang / a ga 1 ru'i bdug pa rnams kyi sbyin sreg lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas lan sum cu rtsa gnyis byas te/95—519

dngos grub kyi 1mtshan ma ma 2byung gi bar du ka ri nor bī (4)ra dmar po'i me tog la lan re bzlas brjod byas pas mtshan rangs par snying gar bsnun (5rin nges par (3'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mi'i gtso bo'am mi chen po dbang du bya bar 'dod na nyin gcig bzhin du lan tshwa 7las de'i gzugs byas/ rkang pa g.yas pa nas brtsams la sbyin sreg lan sum cu rtsa gnyis byas te 98)thog mar (9shu ti dang du ruska 1 mar dang sbyar bas lan gsum sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas gu gul mar dang sbyar ba'i bdug pas lan gsum bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu sbyin sreg lan sum cu 11rtsa gnyis byas na zhag bdun gyi 32dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sde ni blo ldan gyi/ /gsang sngags gnyis pa 'di dag ni/ /snga ma bzhin du bsdam yinabyas na/ /las rnams thams cad byed par kha'agyur/ /de skad sngar bshad sman rnams kyis/ /sbyin sreg sum cu rtsa gnyis byang/ /zla ba gcig tsam byas na ni/ /'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /dri dang me tog la 9sogs pas/ /lha dang lha min klu rnams dang / /sems can kun kyang dbang du 'gyur/ /zhag bdun bar du dus gsum du/ /sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad byas shing / /bzlas brjod brtson par byas na ni/ /rgyal po'i yid du 'ong ba dang / /'jigs pa kun las bsrungs pa dang / /skal ldan nor rnams 'phel bar byed/ /de bzhin me tog 'bras bu dang / /dri dang bdug pa la sogs dang / /zas dang skom la sogs pa rnams/ /bsngags 1 nas gang dag byin pa yi18 sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /sngar bshad sman rnams bzlas brjod byas/ /sems can gang la phye mas 19gtor/ /2 yang na gang la zas skom byin/ /de ni dbang du khugs par 'gyur/ /yungs kur nas dang lan tshwa 21dang / /shu ti 95—520

dang ni nye'u shing dang / /pri lngasku 1)dang shu dag rnams/ /cha ni mnyam par byas nas kyang / /seng ldeng mdag 95)ma dud med la/ /de dag gis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /zhag bduyang na zla ba phyed/ /dus gsum khrus byed nges par gnas/ /dus gsum brgya rtsa brgyad byas na / /sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /yang na zla ba gcig tsam gyis/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /cho ga 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /lha klu de bzhin gnod sbyin dang / /dri za mi dang mi 'am ci/ /mnyam par gzhag pas dbang du 'gyur/ /snga ma bzhin du 'di bsgrubs na/ /snga ma bzhin du 'dod kun sbyin/ /'di ni bsgrub par ma gyur kyang / /las rnams thams cad byed 'gyur te/ /rnam pa gang dang gang dag gis / /gang gi las ni gang gang sgrub/ /rnam pa de dang de dag gis/ / de yi 4las de byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sde (5yi chad pa 'di/ /don yod gzhan gyis mi thub la/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa dang / /'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa yin / /bum pa zhabs med mi gnag sgrupa/ /dri dang sman rnams thams cad ldan / /rin chen kun dang ldan pa dang / /sa bon kun sgyu gyis mchod byas shing //go tsa da nas dkris (8)pa'am/ / de yi gzhi 9tshol bzhag tshanas ni/ /lan grangs brgyad stong bzlas brjod bya/ /bsdams shing legs par gnas 17byas nas/ /rdo rje sde la rab bsgrims te/ /dri la 12sogs pas legs mchod nas/ /zla ba nya 15la mnyam gzhag pas/ /bum pa des ni khrus kyang bya/ /bum pa de 7yis khrus byas nas/ /mtshungs pa med par skal boldan 'gyur/ / de yi tshadon rnams thams cad 'grub/ /rgyas shing dpal yang skye bar 'gyur/ /lig bu mig dang tsan+dan dang / /ba bla lha dang ni ldong ros dang / /nā 1 ga put+pa 19pa tra dang / /de 95—521

bzhin bo la brgyad pa ste/ /'di dag cha ni mnyam 1)byas la/ /phye ma zhib mor btag tshon par bya/ /rgyal gyi dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /mchod rten drung du bsgrub par bya/ /dri bsung rnamang po dbul bya zhing / /lan grangs brgya (shestong bzlas brjod bya/ /de dag gis ni lus bskus nas95/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la dang ba (6)dang / /gus par byed pa de dag ni/ /don rnams thams cad byed par nus/ /'di la dpyad par bya ba med / /'phags pa rdo rje sde'i cho ga rdzogs so// //na mo rat+na tra 7ya su/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇi su/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 8dpa ti su/ha re ha re/ gats+tsha ha ra pā ṇi/ shī r+ghaṃ 59nobha ba na ba si ni dru 0ti kā mispel kulpe/a mu kun tsaṇ+ḍa/ tī 12li su ra li/ ni ri ni ri/ ba she ma ma/ ku swa ba shārnyi snye/sum̐ bha ri sum̐ bha ri/ pa ru ṇa pā she 1 na ban+dha/ la hur ā tshan ya ti ro ti si/ ru ru tsan+de tsāk+ṣi ṇi badz+ra ha khe16/ hi hi hi hi/ hi he hi/ ya hi ba dhe hi la1 / hūṃ ba na yā 18nyi/ da me dhi/ dam bi 19ni/ de hi 2 ho/ badz+ra rā dz+nyā 521pa ya ti/ tsaṇ+ḍi tsaṇ+ḍi/ tsaṇ+ḍi gaṇ+ḍi / ghu ru ghu ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ha ha ka re ṇa/ e gi ri ṇi/ a sho ba da ni/ sma na ra ba raṃ go ni pa 2 ta ni/25 tsaṇ+ḍi gabadz+ra pā ṇi ṣ+ṭṛ da 2 ya / mā 28brta ṇi 9/ ma ye ma ye/ ma hā ma ye/ ma hā sa rim yī lhaku shi/ kau 82shi ka /bid badz+ra rā 5dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ blon mo gtum mor grags pa ste/ /gzhal med khang na gnas par grags/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga mthong ba yis ge/ /don kun rab tu sgrub byed pa/ / 'di yi da las rnams mi bzad pa/ /mang zhing rnam pa sna tshogs yod/ /de las gces pa bsdus pa yi/ /mdor bstan pa ni 95—522

bshad par bya/ /nor 'dod pas ni bsdams byas nas/ /rdza mkhan 'jim pa'i 1bur ma blangs/ /che ge mo ni 'di yin zhes/ /de nas de yi gzugs brnyan bya/ /gtsang mas bzlas brjod byed bzhin du/ /bram mang ( ku ra blangs nas ni/ /de yi lte bar gzhag par bya/ /de yang snod kyi nang du gzhug /rig sngags mchod pa la ( nisogs bya/ /de yang casalan stong rtsa brgyad du/ /sbyin sreg byas nas zin pa'i mjug /de nyid phyi rol bor nas ni/ /rang gi gnas su 'gro bar bya/ /gang tshogegi ming gis sbyin sreg bya/ /des ni nor kun sbyin par byed/ /sbyin byed de yi (phyiramadun dag tu/ /sngar ni dran byas de bzhin byed/ /me tog brgyad brgya bzlas brjod byas / /lha chen mtshan gyi steng du gzhag /kha zas 'dod pas kha zas dag /gang 'dod de ma thag tu 'thob/ /grong khyer nang du 'gro 'dod pas/ /bzlas brjod byas pa'i rdul dag gis/ /sgo yi them par bsnun 8byas na9/ /grong khyer bsgrub pa 'grub 'gyur zhing / /der ni 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /yid du 'ong bar der 'gyur ro/ /rtsod 1 tshopa dang ni 'thab pa la/ /shags lan yang ni thebs par 'gyur/ /bud med yang ni 11skyes pa gang / /dbang du bya bar 'dod na ni/ /rig sngags blon mo gtum mo ni/ /zhag gcig smyung byas 12bzlas brjod bya/ / be shaṅka ta'i 1 yam sreg shing / /bzang po stong phrag brgya rnams kyang / /zhag bdun bar du dus gsum du/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sbyin sreg bya/ /dbang du bya 'dod gang yin pa/ /de dag dang yang phrad par bya/ /lan cig zhag ni bdun gsum bya/ /skal 'chung la yang 'grub d+ku'agyur te/ /gnod sbyin mi 'am 7ci mo 'am/ /dri za mo yang dbang 1 'gyur na/ /gzhan dag lta ci zhig smos te/ /de yi cho ga bshad par bya/ /cho ga snga ma de nyid 95—523

kyis / /ming bcas me tog sbyin sreg bya/ /de bzhin be 6)kaṅka ta'i shing / /brgya stong yang ni sbyin sreg byas/ /ci ste gzhal med khang mchog gam/ /ci ste ri bo man dā nara'i/ /steng na snatshorig sngags rig sngags rgyal/ /byas nas ④nges par dbang du 'gyur/ /arga 5yi ni yam riphyi sreg shing / /gzhig par bya ba'i dam pa yin/ /snu ha dang ni dri ldan kun/ /yam sreg shing rnams sngar bshad pa / /gzugs kyi drung du 'dug nas ni/ /de bzhin rgyun du sbyin sreg bya/ /gi'u 7wang gis ni lus byugs na/ /lha rnams kyang ni dbang du 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs kyi drung 'dug cing / /sbyin sreg rgyun du byas na ni/ /lig bu mig ni dam pa yis/ /mig tu bskus na dga' bar 'gyur/ /gyad rnams brdab 8pa'i mchog yin te/ /bzlas brjod byas nas brgal na ni/ /gnam lcags brag la bab 9pa bzhin/ /des ni rgyad zla bcom par 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan red 1 par gdags pa 'am/ /skud pa sngon po bzlas brjod byas/ /de bzhin tshon 11skud btags na ni/ /de yang rgyal byed srung byed mchog /las rnams rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ci yang rung ba gang dag dang / /de dag kun ni thams cad la/ /rnam pa thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /gtum po gzhal med khang gnas pa12/ /'di ni thams cad 'ching byed dang snan/ /bcings pa thams cad grol byed cing / /las kun byed de sko'agrub pa yin/ /gsang sngags 'di ni de yi logrogs/ /lag na rdo rje'i sagrogs mchog yin/ /gdon dang gdon 'grol 1 la sogs pa/ /las rnams kun la mchod pa yin/ /sgrub pa'i thabs dang cho ga ni gser dang dngul dang / zangs sna gsum las mdung rtse gsum pa byas la/ de'i dbus su rdo rje'i dbyibs byas nas/ sku gdung dang ldan pa'i 95—524

mchod rten gyi drung ngam/ khang pa'i nang du ri mo'i gzugs nub phyogs su kha bstan pa'i mdun du/ ba lang gi lci ba sa la ma lhung 1)bas dkyil 'khor skyong nul du byugs te(2)/ de'i steng du spos kyi skyong nul byas nas de'i dngos casu yungs kur las mdung rtse gsum byas la55)/ de'i steng du bzhag ste/ dus gsum du khrus byed cing dus gsum du mchod pa rgyas pa byas nas lan brgyad brgya bzlas brjod byas la/ de nyid du rtswa drar snyoba'i stan gyi 7steng du nyal bar bya'o/ /yar gyi ngo tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi la/ zhag rinagacig gso sbyong gi yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas rang bzhin gyi 79tshul gyis ma 'ongs pa'i bar du bzlas brjod byas na/ las thams cad byed par 'gyur te/ yid ldan ma ka ta ya na zhes bya ba'i las rnams kyang grub bopar 'gyur ro/ /rdza mkhan gyi 'jim pa'i 11bur mas gzugs byas te/ snod du bcug 15la be 1 kaṅka ta'i yam sreg shing brgyad stong gis rgyun ma chad par sbyin sreg byas nas/ de'i 'og tu yungs kur mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar bas rgyun ma chad par sbyin sreg byas na/ gang gi ming nas smos te sbyin sreg byas pa de dbang du 'gyur te phrad par yang sabya'o/ /bya ba zin nas gzugs brnyan yang phyi rol du dor bar bya'o/ /kha zas 'dod pas 5me tog brgyad brgya la bzlas brjod byas te salha chen po'i steng du phul na kha zas ji lta bu 'dod pa thob 1 par 'gyur ro/ /rdul la bsngags 18te sgo'i them pa la bsnun na grong khyer 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'thab pa dang 'khrug pa dang / rtsod pa thams cad la shags lan thebs 19par 'gyur ro/ /nang par langs te/ chu'i nang du lte ba tsam zhugs la 5 snalan brgyad stong bzlas brjod byas te 21mi'i gtso bo 'am 22mi chen po nadabang du 'gyur ro/ /gzugs byas pa'i nang du rdo rje'i rig 95—525

sngags bcug la de'i steng du be 17kaṅka ta'i bud shing gis me sbar te ske 0tshe dang /yungs kur dang / lan tshwas sbyin sreg byas na zhag bdun gyis dbang du 'gyur ro / /gsang sngags 'di ni de yi ri grogs/ /lag na rdo rje'i grogs mchog yin / /gdon dang gdon las dgrol la 5)sogs/ /kun la de ni mchod pa yin / /gzhal med khang gnas kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //na mo rat+na tsitra ya su/ na maḥs man+ta ṭ+wāṃ/ saṃ myakle bud dhā dzā(7ri/ na maḥ.a pra ti ha ta ta 8ba la pa rā 9ka ma yo ga 'igra te 1/dzā se ti 1 ṭa sa ma ya satā 1)ya sarba lo ka su dzi hā 7ya ma he shwa 15ra su khā 57ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā yi 7pa ta ye badz+ra pā ṇa nyunyeye / na mo dṛ sgye 19badz+ra su/ na ma sbri 2 cir badz+re 21snya ra su/ sarba bo dhi sa tā ye rte/bhū na ta ga ṇa da ma ka 2 su/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye ge/ badz+ra pā ṇi ma hār+ṣa yā mi/dā ma yā 27mi/ dā ma yā mi/2 mo ha yā 28mi/ bai sha yā so/mi/ t+t+waṃ ma hā 6 swāyak+ṣa se nā 1pa ti da n+ya su badz+ra pā ṇa ci ye/ oṃ ru nyi me ya ha hi sa be 4 )to bha dgeg ba to budhe da na ta thā ri pra ti sa t+ya/ i sa rda na tsa te su badz+ra badz+ra muṇ+ḍi chenaswa le yu yā ti mā tī la 2ye yā mi/ tar+ya thā/ da ma da ma/ da ha da ha/ ghur+ṇa ghur+ṇa snye / tar+ṇa shasma shasma / bhab nab getha ma sas nas 7/ naza bza dzasba maṇ+ḍa rab ā ra li / ma dā li/ bi rī khri na dze+e/ ha na ha na/ da ma da ma / sasmo hā 5 ya a mu 1tshe ba sha mā 51ya swā hā/ gsang sngags 52mchog 'di gtum pa ste/ /lag na rdo rje'i ri grogs su bshad/ /dbyug 'dra stobs 54dang ldan pa ste/ /gdon la sogs 55pa 'dul ba'i mchog /de ni dbang chen dga' ba ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin gyi grogs po yin/ /las kun yang ni 57byed pa ste/ /rdo rje 95—526

dbyug pa rab dbyug bzhin/ /de nas lag na rdo rje yi1ri/ /pho nya mas rinani blo gros bzang / /tshogs bcu 'bar ba'i rig sngags kyi/ /tshogs kun gyis mchod bshad par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra ya su/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa rin badz+ra pā ṇi su/ ma byuhā yak+ṣa se nā pa (5)ti su/ ma ti badz+ra badz+re ṇi snyono/ sma ra sa ma yan/ ti li ti li/ ki li ki li/ brnya ban+dhari / ka la ka la/ ba la ba la/ ra la ra la/ badz+re ṇi naha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa/ dru ti rda ri9ku ru hu ru 1 ru/ sid+dha tsaṇ+ḍa 1lhabadz+ra pā ṇi/ rādz+nyā 12pa ya ti swā hā/ pho nya mo ni bcu po 1lhalas/ /las kun byed pa dang po 'di/ /blo gros rdo rje grags pa ste/ /rig sngags chen mo thustobs chen yin/ /na mo ma 5ti haṃ bho badz+ra samā ṇi pa ri brta ga na ta na ta kā sna la hūṃ/ khu ru khu ru/ hi ri hi ri/ hu ru hu ru/ si li si li/ pi ri pi 18ri / ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ badz+re ṇi badz+re 1 ṇi/ ā bi sha yo r+ya te na rū paṃ dar+sha 21ya bi grwan+ta gan+dha ta/ ar+ṇa 22la li ti na ni la li ti ni/ garnya shasdo na de 25ba / gra ha yak+ṣa/ bhū 7ta sha ku ni/ skan+dha / a pasmra ra/ ku ṭa pū /ta na/pi shā tsa rāk+ṣa sa/ ā 29be sha na/ sma ra sa ma ya/ ka ta ka ta/ ma ta ma ta/tu ru tu ru/ ti ti ti ti/ dzhai dzhai dzhai rnyi 1/ li li li li/ hu la hu la/ hi li hi li/ hu ru hu ru/ thā thā thā thā/ thi thi thi thi/ pa ta pa ta/ hi ni 2gyi ni/nī la ma hā nī la/ badz+ra ri ri ri ri ra nar ra ri ri/ kum+bhaṇ+ḍa / a pasmra ra ā 5be sha na/ pu ru pu ru/ da ra da ra/ ka ra ka ra/ sarba gra ha nā ridzim ba ha ya asmi zhu sha rī re/ a mu ka su 2gri na nyi he/ gri hi he 0bha sakye 1/ satre / ba ra ba ra/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsi ri ri lhari/ e hi e hi / badz+ra pā ṇi/ pi ni pi ni / si ri si ri/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ su ru su ru/ dru gti spyorda/ ku 95—527

na mo rat+na tra 1)ya su/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa nabadz+ra pā ṇi (da su/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa cati su / su khi bha pa tu badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri bā 5 ra badz+ra pā ṇi/ bā ri tsa ne na bā tsa 7rine na satre na badz+re ṇa/ ādz+nyā 8pa ya ti/ badz+re ṇa sbyin (9)ti/ badz+re ṇa bhin+da 1 ti/a lo la gha lo hu1la/ ga lin+ta lha/ bad+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa / badz+ra pā ṇi/lha/ ma hā yak+ṣa 7se nā pa ti rā dz+nyā 15pa ya ti swā hā/ zla ba phyed kyi bar du zas su 'o ma dang phye'i lde gu tshaza zhing bsgrub par bya ste/ lag na rdo rje 1 ri mo'i gzugs tshon rtsi 12spyin med pas 'drir gzhug 17go/ /ri mo'i gzugs kyi drung du ras ma nyams pa'i stan la gser dang dngul dang zangs sna gsum las 2 byas pa'i rdo rje bzhag ste steng g.yogs 1par bya'o/ /pog 22dang sra rtsi'i 2 pog sbyar ba yang dbul lo/ /na maḥku ru badz+ra pā ṇi pra ti grit+na hi mye dhū pa hu 2 ti ma baspa 22tu ti ma 'am ma tsa/ rak+ṣa rma t+t+waṃ sa ma yo byā 28rnyi shu 2 ti swā hā/ gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos te/ dus gsum du bdug pa thogs shing lan brgyad brgya bzlas brjod byas nas/ phyi de nyin ra par mchod pa lhag 1par bskyed de bzlas brjod bya'o/ /mar me yang ci 'byor pas bskyed 2par bya'o/ /de nas lag na rdo rje 'ong bar 'gyur te/ bya ba gang yin pa de byed par 'gyur ro/ /grub nas kyang zla ba phyed kyi bar du cho ga bsrung bar bya'o/ / tsho dam tshig ma mthong bas byas na ma rung bar ri4'gyur ro/ /slob dpon la gus pa dang mchod pa byas nas gdod cho ga rgyas par mnod 5par bya ste/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi dzidabus su kār ṣā pa ṇa brgyad kyi 'gron ra bus rdo rje 9byas nas slob dpon la dbul bar bya'o/ /de lta bus cho ga rgyas pa bsgrubs na gdod 'grub par 'gyur te/rig sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon ma yin zhing bu ma 95—531
