dzo /'phags pa rdo rje'i ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/(1)༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā badz+ra me ru shi kha ra kū ṭa gā ra dhā (mir tī / bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje'i ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa casadus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i lhun po chen 55po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa rdo rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sa'i gnas rdo rje chen po'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pas legs par brgyan 6 pa/ rdo rje chen po'i rdzing gi rin po che'i pad+ma'i 'od kyis snang bar byas pa / sa phyogs rdo rje chen po'i bye ma bdal ba/ rdo rje chen por byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'khor gyi khyams rdo rje chen po las byas pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi 7skurdo rje chen po'i seng ge'i khri bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag stong gis rnam par mdzes pa/ chos bstan pa dang / cho 'phrul can/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 95—792

byin gyi rlabs nya)kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis nanges par 'byung ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu /rtsa bzhi thams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa/ mthu chen po thob pa/ rdo rje chen po'i rnam par thar pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par 'phrul ba dang / cho 'phrul chen po kun du ston pa/ sems kyi skad cig thang cig 4yud tsam cig 5la sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i chos bstan pa sna tshogs mnyam pa nyid snyan cing rgya che la zab pa dang / spobs pa dang / cho 'phrul dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa 6chen po'i sprin gyis mchod pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / gzungs dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / dbang dang / mngon par shes pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / sa bcu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / byams pa'i stobs dang / dben 7pa dang / yongs su byang ba'i sems kyi rgyun dang 8ldan pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje'i mig dang / rdo rje'i lus dang / rdo rje blo gros dang / lag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje 'dus pa dang / rdo rje mthu bo che dang /rdo rje rnam par 'phrul ba dang / rdo rje brtsegs pa dang / rdo rje phung po dang /rdo rje nga ro dang / rdo rje bzang 9po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems 95—793

dpa' chen po rdo rje tog ces bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang / nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ srid par 1kun tu sbyor ba chad 2pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang / cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ rnam par 'phrul ba'i mthu chen po thob pa / lta ba chags pa med pa/ thams cad kyang dri ma dang bral ba/ kun nas nyon mongs 4pa'i bag chags kyi sa bon nges par bsregs pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha (5skur dwa ti'i bu dang / tshe (neradang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 7gyi bu chen po dang /tshe dang ldan pa skul byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga yā na'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung dang / de dag la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu grangs med dpag tu med pa 9gzhal du med pa dag dang / mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / lha'i bu tshangs pa bzang 1 po la sogs pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i bu rab 'thab bral g.yog 'thab bral gyi lha'i ris kyi lha'i bu dang bcas pa dang / yongs su dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 11dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha'i bu thams cad kyi 'khor can dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs 12ris dang / stobs can dang / rab sim /dadang / sgra gcan dang / rnam par 95—794

snang byed dang / de dag la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi dbang po tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / ma dros pa dang /'jog po dang / nor rgyas kyi bu dang / dung skyong dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang /pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang / mtha' yas dang / de dag la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa dag dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa mi'am (1)ci'i rgyal po'i rinagayog du ma can dang / dri za'i rgyal po gtsug phud lnga pa dri za'i rgyal po'i g.yog du ma can dang / rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po don thams cad grub pa rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po'i g.yog du ma can dang /nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po'i g.yog du ma can dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / nor bu bzang dang / gang ba bzang dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po lngas rtsen naganod sbyin gyi rgyal po'i g.yog du ma can dang / 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya'i g.yog can dang /'jig rten gyi ma bdun dang / sring mo chen mo bdun dang / drang srong chen po bdun dang / bar snang la rgyu ba'i rgyu skar dang / gza'i lha thams cad dang /phyogs kyi lha rnams dang / phyogs mtshams kyi lha rnams dang / sa'i lha dang /dbyangs can dang / 'byung po rnams dang / bgegs rnams dang / log 'dren rnams dang / yi dgas 4 dang / 'byung po rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams dang /ri'i rgyal po thams cad dang / 'jig rten skyong ba chu lha g.yog rgya mtsho'i lha thams cad dang bcas pa dang / 'phags 5skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang /lag na be con dang / bden bral dang / me'i lha dang / rlung gi lha chen po bdun dang / dbang bdag chung ma dang bcas pa tshogs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum 95—795

phrag du ma'i 'khor can dang / sred med kyi bu g.yog dang bcas pa dang /byin pa po dang / phreng ba can dang / lcags can dang / tshogs kyi bdag po chen po da nga / sprin ta la dang / log 'dren dbang po bgegs log 1ci'adren gyi g.yog du ma can dang / shing gseb kyi lha drug cu dang / sring mo bzhi ming po dang bcas pa dang / ma bdun dang / rdo rje lcags kyu can 2dang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang / rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / rdo rje'i sde dang / lag bzangs dang / gtsug cagis 'gro dang ci / rdo rje'i rigs kyi 'khor du ma dang bcas pa dang / de ma yin pa gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dgas 6dang / sha za dang / smyo byed dang / brjed byed dang / sgrub pa dang / sbrul 7'dzin bcas dang / gnon po tshad med dpag 8tu med grangs med pa rnams dang / lha'i bu nyi ma dang /lha'i bu zla ba dang / dus tshigs kyi lha dang / nub ma'i lha dang / dus kyi lha thams cad dang / gnam sa'i lha thams cad dang yang thabs cig 9go/ /de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das de chos kyi 'khor lo ni shin tu bskor/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ni shin tu yongs su mthar phyin/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ni shin tu yongs su rdzogs1 / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / byang chub chen po dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang 11/ sa ni 1 brnyes pas ni shin tu yongs su bzung 13/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan mnga' ba 1 sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ni sku brgyanas/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus ni yan lag dang nying lag 95wa 796

thams cad rnam par spras/ spyi gtsug ni sems can thams cad kyis ltar 1mi mthong / bdud kyi tsher ma thams cad ni dkrugasan/ de kho na nyid mkhyen pa nyid ni rim par thugs su chud/ spyan rnam pa lnga ni mnga'/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog dang ni ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ni ldan/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang ni ldan/ bdud dang phas kyi largol pa dang /ngan pa'i tshogs can gyi tshogs thams cad ni bcom/ brjod pa'i sgra dang /tshigs su bcad 5pa ni 'phags/ khyu mchog dang / seng ge'i sgra ni sgrog /ma rig 6pa'i mun pa ni kun du bsal / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag grangs med dpag tu med par sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs dang / stobs dang / smon lam dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /dka' ba spyad pas mngon par grub pa'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus sku brgyan pas ni mdzes shing rin po che rdo rje'i pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la ni bzhugs te/ gdan rin po che dang /rdo rje'i pad+ma'i seng ge'i khri ri rab tsam rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / mu tig dang ldan pa'i dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba du ma sil sil sgra 'byung ba/ rdo rje dang rin po che du ma'i stegs bu la rtsa ba 8legs par brtan 9pa/ rdo rje dang rin po che du ma'i chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i snam rten 1 dang bcas pa/ rin po che du ma'i pad+ma'i snying po la chags pa'i rin po che ke ke ru dang / ke ke ru chen po dang / an da rnyil dang / mthon ka chen po dang / dun 11las du ma'i 'od zer 'bar bas snang bar gyur pas kun 95—797

du mdzes pa/ rin po che dang rdo rje'i thur mas brgyan (17pa'i gdugs yu bas bstod pa/ bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas grib mar bsgribs shing bskyabs pa/dpag bsam gyi rinashing du mas mdzes par byas pa rgya che ba la bzhugs te/gser gyi ri bo ltar dpal gyis 'bar ba/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'byor pas sa phyogs mdzes par gyur pa/ zla ba nya ①ltar 'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa chen po ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyis yang dag par rgyas pa (gechos ston te/ tshangs par spyod pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po / tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa dang 5/ yongs su dkar ba yang dag par stone to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyi gtsug gi mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kun du ston pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po byung ste/ 'od zer gyi dra ba des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bas gsal bar byas par gyur to/ /gang gā'i 6klung gi bye ma ji snyed pa dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyang snang ba des gsal bar snang bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa de dag kyang seng ge'i khri du ma bkod pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang rnams na chos ston to/ /nyan thos chen po de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag dang thabs cig go/ /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /95—798

mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang yang thabs cig go/ /de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje'i lhun po chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /de dag thams cad kyang kun du snang ngo / /skad cig de la sems can de dag thams cad bde ba thams cad kyis tshim par gyur to/ /'on pa rnams ni sgra thos so/ /long ba rnams ni mig thob (1bo/ /smyon nasapa rnams ni dran pa rnyed do/ /nad pa rnams ni sos par gyur to/ /sbrum ma rnams ni bde bar btsas so/ /sems can dmyal ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rnams ni med par gyur to/ /yud tsam de la dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /yi dgas dkyi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten rnams kyi 4ming yang mi grag 5)par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi bar gang dag mun pa mun nag dang /mun pa mun nag chen por 'dug pa de dag thams cad kyang zhigasal bar snang bar gyur to/ /der sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag thams cad dang /sems can gzhan 'dir skyes pa rnams kyang gcig gis gcig shes so/ /de nas sems can de dag thams cad kyi 7ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi dga' ba thob ste bde ba namachog gis tshim par gyur nas kun du bltas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong ste/de dag gis gser gyi mchod sdong ltar dpal gyis 'bar zhing rang gi gzi 9brjid kyis mngon par 'phags pa de mthong nas de nyid la skyabs su dong ngo / /skyabs su dong ma thag tu de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid du bdag 1 son pa snyam du shes so/ /snang ba des bdud kyi khyim thams cad kun du 'bar rab tu 'bar kun du rab tu 11mched cing 'bar te me 95—799

lce gcig tu gyur par kun du snang ngo / /bdud kyi ris kyi lha de dag kyang skad cig de la nyam thag pa'i sgrar ngu zhing skrag nas byer ro/ /bdud sdig can yang bzhin bzang po rnyi rnyi por gyur cing lus rdul nas bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad la smras pa/ grogs po dag bdud kyi khyim thams cad kun du 'bar rab tu 'bar kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur pa dang / dge sbyong gau 1ta ma ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa na chos bstan pa 'di la ltos/des bdag cag phung ngo / / mtho btsams naso/ /phyogs gang na gnas su gtol med do/ /longs la dge sbyong go ta ma de'i gan du dong ste/ bdud kyi yul ca'adi thal bar byas par ma gyur gyi bar du gzhom mo/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu de dag thams cad kyis rje bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes smras nas/ rang rang gi gnas su dong ste/ lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs can / lus la go cha 5sna tshogs pa/ cha byad dang / rgyan sna tshogs can/mche ba mi bzad par 'jigs su rung ba/ bzhin mi sdug par bsgyur ba/ mig dang / bzhin dang / skra kun du 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba dag skad cig de nyid la gcig tu 'dus nas bdud sdig can ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bzhengs bzhengs thog 6mar bzhud la ji tsam du dge sbyong gau 7ta ma nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa de ci nas kyang phyis bdag cag gi yul du gnod pa cung zad kyang mi skyed pa dang / bdag cag gi yul gnod par mi 'gyur bar deng 1 nyid du phye mar brlag 1go/ /rnam par gzhom mo/ /de nas bdud sdig can dga' zhing mgu ste shin tu dga' bas spu'i khung bu khyab nas skad cig de nyid la bdud kyi 95—800

ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad dang lhan cis tu bdud kyi rnam par 'phrul ba chen po dang / bdud kyi sde chen pos bar snang dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir khyab par byas te/ dung dang / rnga dang / rdza rnga dang / 'khar 1rnga dang /rgyud gcig pa dang / lcags kyi sil 725dkrol mo nodang / rnga bo che rdung 4zhing hu hu zhes bya ba dang / bi tsi 5zhes bya ba dang / zung shig zung 65shig /sod cig sod cig ces bya ba'i sgra 'byin cing gshol dang / gtun shing dang / gtun rked nyag pa ri dang / phur bu dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mda' bo che dang / mdung thung dang / rtse gsum pa dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / gzhu dang / mda' la sogs pa'i mtshon 985cha lag na thogs shing bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ skad cig de nyid la a la la zhes bya ba'i sgra phyung nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 9mtshon cha thams cad kyi char phab pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi mthus 1 mtshon cha de dag thams cad me tog gi 11gdugs kyi sprin chen por gyur par 12snang ngo / /bdud kyi sgra de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra dang / yang dag par bgro 18ba'i sgra rnams su grag go/ /bdud sdig can ni zhags pa lnga'i bcings pas 1 bdag nyid bcings par mthong ngo / /de nas bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 1 rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ngo mtshar chen po de mthong nas ngo mtshar du gyur cing dga' ba thob ste/ bcom ldan 'das de nyid la skyabs su dong ngo / /bdud sdig can ni bdag nyid dgrol sa bar 'dod na 'grol ma nus te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi khyams su bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar shing rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rdo rje 1 'khor gyi 1 khyams chen por 95wa 801

'gyel to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe byams pa chen po'i thugs dang / thugs rje chen pos brlan pa'i spyan (1gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi khyams thams cad du gzigs nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bdud sdig can 'di 'khor gyi khyams 'di nas slong nasal stan la zhog ri )ste/ rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul ba'i byin gyis brlabs ri bsam gyis mi khyab par bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms 5par byed pa zhes pa ri rigang gis bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu 'di dag dang / bdud sdig can 'di sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'dong ba dang / gzhan yang gang dag sdang ba bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / yi dgas 7dang / brjed /byed dang /'byung po dang / gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / sgrub 9pa dang / sbrul 'dzin bcas dang / gnon po dang / zas su btsas pa za ba la sogs pa sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ rab tu sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la ma gus pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid khong du ma chud pa de dag thams cad gang gis 'dzud pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar byed pa yang ston cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ des nyu tshongan 'gro 11log par ltung bar 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi nyu2bka' mnyan nas/ rin po che'i pad+ma'i rdo rje'i stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la bzhugs nyanate/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud 95—802

nas / bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /sems can kun gyi nyon mongs pa/ /gzhig pa'i slad du 'dren par hu)byung / /khyod ni bdud rnams kun las rgyal/ /'jig rten rtsa lag gcig pu khyod/ /thar pa'i grong khyer 'jug pa'i lam/ /ye shes ma lus khyod gcig pus/ /yang dag brnyes (minas thugs rje yis/ / brlan pa'i thugs kyis ②bstan pa mdzad/ /khyod sngon sbyin dang tshul khrims dang / /bzod dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan dang / /shes rab la sogs yon tan gyis/ /bdag mdzad slad kyis sems can btsud/ /khyod kyis chos rnams skye med par/ /bshad cing de bzhin rnam phye yang / /'bras bur dogs ( pa ma mchis pa kye ma mgon po khyod kyis bshad/ /'khor lo yan lag bcu gnyis pa/ /khyod nyid mkhyen nas rab tu bskor/ /mu stegs tsho can dang bdud btul te/ /chos kyi snang ba gsal bar mdzad/ /nyon mongs brag 56)chen rnam (7)kun du/ /ye shes rdo rjes rab bcom nas/ /sus kyang thob par 58)ma gyur pa'i/ /byang chub bla na med pa brnyes6)/ /gang gi mtshan yang rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub sa bon nyid 'gyur ba/ /khyod ni 'jig rten mchog gcig pu/ /dam yopa rab sbyin bdag po lags/ /khyod ni mgon po khyod ni /nyapa/ /khyod skyabs khyod ni dpung gnyen lags / /thugs rje chen po ye shes nyid/ /mya ngan 'das nas gcig pu khyod/ /khyod nyid gshegs nas sems can rnams/ /sems can dmyal las rnam par bkrol3ge / /rang gi sku yang yongs btang nas/ /khyod kyis hu srog chags rnams kyang bsrungs/ /lus can kun gyis ma thob pa'i/ /ye shes khyod kyis brnyes gyur nas/ /grol te 'jig rten rnams kyang grol/ /kye ma khyod ni rtsa lag 95—803

bzang / /mgon po khyod kyi 'od zer gyi1/ /dra bas 'jig rten khams khyab ste/ /mya ngan 'das las lhag pa 92)bde/ /lus can kun gyis thob par mdzad/ /khyod kyi 'od kyi gzis bcom pa / /gza' rnams kun dang dgung zla dang / /gdugs rnams dang ni zhugs rnams dang / /nor bu lam mer cam gyur to/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i 5bdag po lag na rdo rjes tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas yang rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol nas rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms 6par byed pa zhes bya ba 'di la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos te/ shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/ nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma'/ lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma'/ byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ mtha' 7mtho na dbus nadama'/ dbus 9mtho na mtha' 1 dma' bar gyur to/ /phyogs thams cad dang / phyogs mtshams thams cad kyang dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nga/ra gyur nas/ lham 11me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i 12yan lag dang nying lag gi mtshams thams cad nas rdo rje kun du 'bar ba / rab tu 'bar ba/ kun du rab tu mched cing 1lha'abar ba/ me lce gcig tu gyur pa dag byung bar kun du snang ngo / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba des phyogs 95—804

bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa ji snyed pa dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes 1la chos kyang ston te/ tshangs par spyod pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ yang dag par ston pa/nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa de dag gi 'khor gyi khyams rgya che zhing rgya che ba dag na kun du snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang (nade bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi spyan snga na ri rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba rgya chen po des snang bar gyur nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la so sor zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba rgya chen po kun du gda' ba 'di su'i lags/ de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis so so'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na ri rab kyi steng na chos ston te/ bcom ldan 'das des bdud sdig can zhags pa'i bcing ba lngas bcings te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gyel ba gzigs nas / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje zhes bya ba la 'di skad du/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje khyod kyis rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyis 4rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul ston cig ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 5dag 'di ni rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de'i rdo rje'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po'i 95—805

byin gyis brlabs 6)so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis gnang nas/rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir lhags (minas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la mchod pa'i sprin dang /gdugs kyi sprin dang / rgyan phreng gi sprin dang / dbu rgyan gyi (8)sprin dang / me tog gi sprin dang / na bza'i sprin chen pos mchod pa chen po byas nas/ nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod bzhin du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la lan bdun bskor ba byas te/ pus mo g.ya sa pa'i lha nga rin po che'i pad+ma'i rdo rje'i stan la btsugs 4 nas/ bcom ldan 'das la (5)logs su lta (7zhing bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pas gnang nas rang rang gi rin po che'i pad+ma'i rdo rje'i stan de dag la 'khod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs logs na 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje tog ces ri7)bya ba de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos (8)rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba da 9ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes 1 tshote/ 'di ltar rdo rje'i ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs 'di nyid ches tunyebartsams te chos kyang ston to/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kun nas snang bar gyur to/ /de nas 'jig 95—806

rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i 1 snying po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa de'i 'khor gyi khyams su 'dus te 'dug par gyur pa des ngo mtshar de mthong nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms ( pa zhes bya ba de la zhus te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba 'di lta bu gang gis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad snang bar gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad cing sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / yi dgas cadang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad mi gda' bar gyur/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rin rdzu 'phrul che zhing dbang che bar grags pa thams cad kyang kun nas mchod pa'i sprin chen pos dga' ba dang /yid bde ba skyes te/ nub phyogs su mchi (6bar gda' 7)ba 'di su'i lags/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms 8pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 9snying po de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu nub phyogs kyi logs na mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba rdo rje chen po'i ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa na rdo rje chen po'i ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs zhes 1 bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ston to/ /bcom ldan 'das des spyi gtsug gi mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po byung 1195—807

ste / 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po des 'jig rten gyi khams der bdud sdig can bskul ma thag 1tu kun du khros nas lha'i bu thams cad dang / gzhan yang bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / dpung gi tshogs chen po dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das de la gtse rinaba'i phyir lhags pa dang / de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi khyams de nyid du zhags pa lnga'i bcing bas bcings nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gyel te/ de la thugs brtse ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la ston cig par bka' lung byin nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje des rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ yan lag dang nying lag gi mtshams thams cad nas rdo rje rnams bstan te/ 'di ni rdo rje de dag nyid kyi cardo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba des kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams su 'jig rten gyi khams rigang gā'i 65klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa ji snyed pa snang bar byas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang bskul/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag kyang bskul bas ngo mtshar thob par gyur pa dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la yang so sor zhus 7so/ /rigs kyi bu de nyid kyi mthus bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de'i spyan snga na 'dug cing bsnyen bkur byed pa yang mthong ngo / /de skad 95—808

ces bka' stsal pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms 3)pa de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la blta ba dang / phyag bgyi ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje de yang blta bar bgyi ba'i tshon/slad du mchi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i dus la dbab par shes na song 8)shigs /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms 5pa de la lan bdun bskor ba byas te/'jig rten gyi khams de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ nam mkha'i dkyil gyi lam nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad lhan cig smra ba na/bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po bsags 6pa las 7grub pas byin pa'i rin po che de dag las 'od zer 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po 95—809

dang ske/ ljang sngon dang / ljang ser dang / btsod ka dang / shel dang /dngul dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / gser dang / pad+ma rā 0)ga dang /rdo'i snying po dang / ke ke ru dang / ke (mike ru chen po dang / an da rnyil dang —/ mthon ka chen po dang / dun las dang / go mu ta ra ga dang / mu tig dmar ①po'i kha dog lta bu rnams byung ste/ de dag gis thams ④cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la ⑤lan 'bum phrag du mar bskor ba byas te/steng gi bar snang khyab par byas nas/ lha'i snang bas snang bar byas te/ 'dus nas 'ja' lta bur gyur te(5)/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhabs mtshan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa/ 'jam pa/ mnyen pa/ rab tu gzhon pa/ sha rgyas pa / snum pa/ long bu gnyis kyi rtsa mi mngon pa/ pad+ma gsar du kha bye ⑦ba lta bu / dung dang / nya dang / rdo rje dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lcags kyu dang /pad+ma dang / chu srin ma ka ra'i mtshan dang ldan pa gnyis la lan 'bum phrag du mar bskor ba byas nas nub par gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'od zer re re'i rtse mo las pad+ma bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu/ tshad shing rta'i phang (nyelo (9)tsam pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyu las byung ba 'di lta ste/ gser gyi rgyu las byung ba dang / an da rnyil dang / dngul dang / byi ru dang / shel dang / ke ke ru dang / dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba dag 'thon kyito/ /de la gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ma ni an da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las 95—810

byung ba'o/ /an da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ma ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni dun las kyi rgyu ①las byung ba'o/ /dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ma ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ma ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni an da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ma ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni ②dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni zhon da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ma ni dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni an da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ma ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni an da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te de ltar rin po che rnam pa du ma'i rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma dag go/ /rin po che'i pad+ma re re la yang sa bcu la (mirab tu gnas 95—811

pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du mdzes pa'i spyod calam phun sum tshogs pa dag ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' re re'i lte ba nas kyang 'od zer 'bum 'bum byung ngo / /'od zer gyi rtse mo re re las kyang rin po che thams cad kyi rgyu las byung ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa nor bu dang / rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi stegs bus bskor ba/ shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'i zla bas spras pa'i khang bran 47gyi rtse mo la seng ge'i rna ba'i steng na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan dpyangs 2pas nam mkha' kun du khebs pa/ pad+ma rā ri steg dang / an da rnyil dang / margad cadang / be+e ḍūr+ya (5nyedang / rdo'i snying po dang / spug dang /ke ke ru las byas pa'i ka ba chen po'i klang (6)la 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi shing las tsho gcod pa lta bu'i tshogs bkod (8)pas rnam par spras te/ mdzes par byas pa(9 / dngul 1 tsholas byas pa'i phug ron /kāgyi phreng gi mtha' mu tig dmar po dang ldan pa'i dril bu g.yer ku'i sna dra ba dpyangs / pa'i sgras sad par gyur nas/rab tu dga' zhing dregs pa'i phug ron dang / bya bang dang / ne tso dang /ri skegs dang / rma bya'i nga ro dag gis nyams dga' ba khyams dang / 'dun khang chen po'i nyen kor stegs bus bskor bas mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las byas pa'i sgo khang /gecan/ shel gyi rgyu las byas pa'i stegs bu dang ldan pa/ bkra shis kyi gser gyi 15bum pa tshadu ma nas spos hu 7chu dri zhim pos chag chag btab pa/ rdzing chen po 'gram gyi ne'u gsing 12margad kyi rgyu las byung ba/ ka tsa 19yin da'i gos ltar reg na bde bas mdzes pa'i phyogs na bde bar nyal ba'i ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / ngur pa dang / ka lan da ku'i 95—812

khyu gnas pa/ gser gyi bye 1ma bdal ba'i gtos 2chen po rin po che sna bdun gyi them skas kyis phreng bas brgyan 9 pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba grangs 'bum phrag du mas kun nas yongs su bskor ba dag byung ngo / /rdzing bu re re nas kyang rin po che'i pad+ma bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu rtsa dgu ri byung ngo / /rin po che'i pad+ma re re'i snying po la yang sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / glu tshogacidabyangs rnams kyi sgra byung bas lha'i bu mo dag glu tsilen gar byed cing yongs su spyod do/ /sil snyan dang / pheg 7rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs kyi sgra byung ba de dag las kyang tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu 'di —dag byung ngo / /sbyin dang tshul khrims kyis ni gang zhig dpag med cing / /de bzhin bzod dang brtson 'grus dag gi stobs ldan la/ /bsam gtan gyis ni zhi zhing dbang gis (8rikun 'byor pa/ /ye shes sgrol (9)ma de la skyabs su 'dong bar gyis/ /bsam gyis mi khyab stobs dang smon lam rnams dang ldan/ /thabs dang byang chub yan lag ting 'dzin rnams kyi bdaganya tsho /rnam par grol ba'i lam dang stobs bcu ldan pa yi/ /thub pa gang yin de la mchod phyir 'dong bar gyis //'dam rdzab nas ni pad+ma rgyas pa ji bzhin du/ /gang zhig nyon mongs 'dam gyis rtag par mi gos pa/ /'chi 31dang skye ba'i sdug bsngal rnam par bsal ba yi/ /rgyal ba 3)'jig rten mgon po de la blta phyir dang 1 / /gcig (7kyang mi ldan min par gyur pa gang zhig gis/ /skye dgu 15rnams kyi gti mug sgo glegs rnams bshig cing / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 9spyod pa 1 rab zhi ba/ /shākya'i tog ldan de la skyabs su 'dong bar 1)gyis/ /de ltar khang pa brtsegs pa dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pas legs par brgyan pa39/ rnam pa sna tshogs bye ba khrag 95—813

khrig 'bum phrag du ma nam mkha'i dkyil na kun du snang ste/ kha cig tu 0)ni rin po che'i sprin gyi char 'bab par (mikun du snang ngo / /kha cig tu ni ③me tog gi gdugs kyi sprin gyi char/ kha cig gtu ni gor shir ṣa'i ⑤tsan+dan dang / spos dang —/ byug ⑥pa dang / phye ma'i sprin gyi char/ kha cig tu ni ⑦gros kyi phreng ba'i sprin gyi char/ kha cig tu ni ka shi ku'i ras dang / du ku la'i ras dang /za lug 6)gi sprin gyi char/ kha cig tu ni dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa'i sprin gyi char / kha cig tu ni me tog pad+ma dang / ut+pa la dang / ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / dri mchog dang / a ti ⑨ mug ta yika dang / ka tsa lin da dang / ma hā ka tsa lin (sped dang / btang bzung dang / btang bzung chen po dang / mañdzu ṣa /rtaka dang / mañdzu ṣa tunyeka chen po dang / man dā 8ra ba dang / man dā skor ba chen po'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /me tog gyi 8char de dag las dri gang byung ba des sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med grangs med pa ⑩dag gang gā'i sna klung gi bye ma'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams rgyas par khyab bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sems can gang dag 'gro ba drug tu skyes pa de dag thams cad dri des mchog tu bde bas tshim zhing sems dga' bar gyur te/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas phan tshun 'dri tsob dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed de na/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /de dag gis de mthong nas kyang phyag 'tshal to/ /skyes bu dam pa de na phyag btsal ( )ma thag tu sems can gang dag ngan 'gro log par ltung bar dong ba de py-i nyadag kyang mchog tu bde ba dang / dga' ba dang / rangs pa dang /95—814

dad pa thob nas skad cis de nyid la ngan 'gro log par ltung ba las grol te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes nas bar snang la 'khod de(1)/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po la mchod pa'i sprin chen pos mchod nas lan 'bum phrag du ma mtha' yas mu med par bskor ba byas te / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje 'khor gyi khyams chen po thams cad dang (5)ldan pa la lan bdun bskor ba byas nas lha rnams bar snang las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rang rang gi rin po che'i gzhal med khang gi khang (55pa brtsegs pa dag na/ lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu sil snyan dang / pheg ④rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs kyi sgra 'byin cing tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /gang slad ngan 'gro mchog tu sdug bsngal 'khrugs pa yi/ /ming yang bde gshegs stobs kyis deng du med mdzad (5)dang / /bsod nams mi ldan sems can rnams la'ang rgyal ba mchog /byams par mdzad pa kye ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /bdag cag rnams kyi rmongs pa'i snying (6)gis bsgrubs pa yi(7) / /sdig pa'i las gang shin tu bgyid dka' (8)sna tshogs pa/ /de dag thub pa'i bya dga'as yi)de ring glo yibur du/ /skad cig tu ni ji ltar rnam par zhig par gyuraXte / /ji ltar gdugs kyis timun pa mun nag kun bcom dang (rte/ /ji ltar zhugs 'bar bas ni ras rnams sreg yipa dang / /bser tsoms shing bal ltar yang sprin 'thor ji bzhin du/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i sdig pa bde bar gshegs kyis 95—815

bcom / /bde gshegs sras po mthong ngam thos sam dran gyur na/ /lhan cig skyes dbang 'od zer dra bas tsho1)sdig 'phrog pa/ /'gro ba yongs kyi srid pa'i spros pa zhig pa yi/ /thugs dang rtag tu ldan zhing skyo bar 'gyur mi mnga' mig dang mgo dang snying dang sha khrag tshil rnams dang / /srog dang sdug dang bu rnams rtswa rtenanaltar bor nas ni/ /mi mtshungs sems can don phyir thugs rjes thugs brlan pa/ /'jig rten mgon sras de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo yi dgas ciltogs la chu dang ro brgya'i zas rnams dang / /de bzhin skye bo nor 'dod snying dang ldan pa la/ /thugs rje spyod cing rnam pa sna tshogs tshim mdzad pa//byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog de la skyabs su mchi/ /gang dag mnar med pa yang rab tu bsil mdzad pas/ /mchog tu tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba'ang bsil bar 'gyur/ /rang bde mi gzigs sems can don (4)brtson ⑤thugs ldan pa / /'jig rten mgon sras mnyam med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dag srid par 'khor ba'i srid pa'i skyon las grol/ /stong pa gsung 6)yang las kyi 'bras bu mi 'dor zhing / /ye shes me (75yis rnyog pa bsregs kyang thugs rjes brlan/ /spyod pa rtag 8med dbang ldan de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ma dpal ldan rdo rje snying po bde gshegs sras/ /mtshan gyis mtshan btab sku las 'od stong mang byung ba'i/ /dri ba rnams dang sna tshogs glu yis bdag cag sim(9)/ /skad cig gis ni dmyal las sum cu'i 1 lha dbang gyur/ /bdag cag rnams kyis rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams dang ni/ /de dag rnams kyis gsungs pa mchog tu zhi chos la/ /gus bstod dge ba rgya chen de ring gang thob pa/ /des myur 'jig rten thams cad bde gshegs thob par shog /de ltar tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 95—816

rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la bstod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste/de dag rang rang gi 0)rin po che'i gzhal med khang gi ②khang pa brtsegs pa rnams su 'khod de chos nyan pa'i phyir phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje ④snying pos byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po 'di lta bu 'di bstan (4)nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i 'khor gyi khyams chen po dang ldan pa la mchod pa'i sprin chen po rnams kyis mchod nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs te bar snang las babs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang lhan cig tu lan 'bum phrag du ma mtha' yas mu med par bskor ba byas nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga 5༄rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la btsugs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das la blta'o(6)/ /rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes nas de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la blta'o sku/ /bltas nas kyang sgra skad kyi nga ro gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra ba'i 98)tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /dran lharapa'i gzhus 'phangs pa yi shes rab mda' mang gis/ /ma 'phangs mthur ldan 3 ribadud bzhi pham mdzad cing / /'jig rten nyon mongs nyen pa'i 11mun pa bsal 512mdzad nas/ /bla ma sprin med zla ba bzhin du lhang nge'o/ /dam chos 'od mang gti mug bcom pa'i dra ba yisanyan//'dul ba'i pad+ma'i gnas rnams kha phye nas/ /ye shes nam mkha' che la dri med 'bar ba'i gzugs/ /nyi ma ji bzhin gdung bar bgyi ba'i bdud sde gdungs/ /95—817

mu stegs can gyi nga rgyal mtha' dag pham mdzad cing / /'gro ba'i 'dod chags rab gdung ma lus rab zhi mdzad/ /dge ba'i lo tog rtsi chen yang dag 'phel mdzad pa/ /dge ba'i char pa phab cing 'brug ltar bsgrag tu gsol/ /mgon po mu stegs can gyi wa brgya pham mdzad cing / /bdud rnams bcom ste byang chub dam par rab brnyes nas/ /ma 'dres bsags pa'i bden pa'i stobs kyi mthu mnga' ba/ /skye ba'i 'jigs lam 6)rab grol seng ge ji bzhin sgrogs(gyi/ /spyod pa zab cing brtan la brtag (0pas ④mi dpogs ⑤pa/ /sems can gnas gyur stobs dang ting 6)'dzin nor bu bkram/ /dri med chos lhun 'dul ba'i ri bo rnam 77'dzin pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog khyod skye dgu mchog gtso bo(8ste/ /tshul khrims bzang po'i 9)rtsa ba sbyin pa'i chus btab 'phel/ /byams dang bzod pa'i me tog yal ga 'khrungs pas mdzes/ /byang chub lam gyi yan lag 'bru chags 'dod byas bsten/ /bsod nams dpag bsam tsho /shing khyod de ring ga las byung / /sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bar ba'i mtshan gyis 11yan lag brgyan32/ /dpe byad bzang mchog rin chen man shel gyis bskor cing / /sa dang dbang dang dam chos phur pa brtan btab pa/ /lhun po bzhin du mi g.yo khyod ni 'gro la mdzes / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying pos byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste/ rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod do/ /de bzhin du sbyar te de 95—818

ltar lho phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po brtsegs pa rnam par bsgrags pa'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams dpal 'byung 6)ba nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i tog ces bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te/ mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rigs kyi bu de dag dang lhan cig tu rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du nub phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can zhes bya ba de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen ②thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing / rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan ①pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du byang phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos mchog rang bzhin gyis rnam par nges pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba thams cad 'byung ba nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du 95—819

mas yongs su bskor te mdun 0)du bdar nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing / rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan ( pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du byang shar gyi phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas rab gsal dbang phyug rgyal po'i sangs rgyas (0kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams dpal brtsegs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros brtan pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing / rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du du shar lho'i mtshams na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog ༷5༄gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams the tsom ⑥dang bral ba nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros bzang po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du lho nub kyi phyogs na 95—820

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che brtsegs pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen blo gros zhes 0bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas (ge'ajig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas chos nyan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang lhan cig tu rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /zo de bzhin du nub byang gi mtshams na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ( 'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas chos nyan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang lhan cig tu rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 47'dug cing rigs kyi bu de dag kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /7557de bzhin du 'og gi phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen pad+ma la rab tu gnas pa'i ri dbang gi rgyal po'i 6risangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams pad+ma bkod pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i blo gros zhes (77bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag 3khrig 'bum phrag du 95—821

mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 6)'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing / rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du steng gi phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing ②'jig rten gyi khams bdud kyi tsher ma dkrugs pa ②nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud kyi sgrib ④pa las rnam par rgyal ba ⑤zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 6)'dir 'ongs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing /rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 9)'dir byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu ⑧'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa du ma bstan pas gzhal med khang dang / me tog gi sprin (pedang / rin po che'i sprin dang / phye ma'i sprin dang / spos dang / byug pa dang /tu ) gdugs rtsormedang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan gyi sprin dang / rin po che 8spug dang / rdo'i snying po dang /bai ḍūr+ya yirnyedang / yon da rnyil tshudang / byi ru dang / margad dang / mu tig dmar po dang / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi sprin dang / dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa dang / rin po che'i pad+ma du mas khebs pa'i rdzing 8gis legs par 95—822

brgyan par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'di ji lta ba de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med pa gzhal du med cing brjod du med par gtogs pa gang gā'i klung (1)gi bye ma snyed ②las shin tu 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyis brlabs ①kyis de bzhin du legs par brgyan (shepar kun du snang ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa de dag thams cad de na bzhugs bzhin du phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu brkyang ste 'jam ⑤zhing mnyen la rab tu gzhon zhing pad+ma dang yal ga gzhon sha chags shing 'jam pa'i sor mo'i ngos can gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /lcags kyu dang / bum pa dang / nya dang / sgo gang (6)dang / gzhal med khang dang / dung dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / dpal be'u dang / 'khor lo'i mtshan gyis brgyan 4)pa/ tshe rabs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i rgyu mthun tshonapas mngon par grub pa'i dpe byad bzang pos rnam par spras pa/ sen mo zangs 'dra zhing rgyas la snum zhing srab pa'i nor bu'i mdongs kyi me tog gi 'od zer gyis mkhrig 6)ma mdzes par gyur pa/ sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / yang dag par mthun ⑩pa'i phyag rnams kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la yang dag par gzengs (stobastod pa dang / yang dag par dga' bar bya ba'i phyir spyi bo la ()byugs nas dus gcig tu sgra skad kyi nga ro gcig gis 'jig 95—823

rten gyi khams thams cad go bar mdzad cing 'di skad ces kye rigs kyi bu gang gi phyir bdud sdig can dang / gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la ma dad cing sdang ba'i bgegs dang log 'dren drag shul can drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gcod pa'i phyir zhugs pa thams cad tshar gcad (1)pa dang / rnam par gzhig pa dang / de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa ②sems zhum pa brtson 'grus brtan po ma yin pa'i go cha bgos pa rnams kyang yang dag par gzengs ri rabastod pa dang / rab tu dga' bar bya ba nas khams gsum par gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi bar dag kyang mya ngan las 'das pa thob par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi rigs mi gcod pa'i phyir/ khyod rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsags rigapa yongs su rdzogs pas grub pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos spras pa55)/ ting nge 'dzin dang / dbang dang / gzungs dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / 'phags pa'i lam (6 yan lag brgyad pa'i mthu grub pa/sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa nye bar zhi ba / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / yi dgas (pedang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du lhung ba'i 'jigs pa'i dus kyi tsher ma ma lus par 'don pa dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen 95—824

ma la sogs pa'i 'khor mngon par dga' ba can dag la ngo mtshar rmad 1)du byung ba'i dga' ba du ma kun du skyed pa la snyoms par zhugs pa ni legs so legs so tshonazhes bka' stsal to/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje gzengs bstod ( )de rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas rang rang gi (༄phyag bskum ste/ rang rang gi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos nyan du gzud pa'i (5)phyir 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir bkye'o/ /de dag gis gnang bas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la phyag 'tshal nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs tsho6 chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul (7)chen pos ji tsam du skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas lag pa bskum pa las brkyang ba dang / brkyang ba las bskum 587pa tsam gyi skad cig thang cig 9yud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la phyogs gcig tu 'khod pa'i bar du'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas de'i tshe gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bdud sdig can 'di rdo rje'i zhags pas bcings pa 'di las khrol la ji 1 nas kyang sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / chos la skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan yang gang dag lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma 95—825
